title: Formal and Real Organ Allocation
affiliations: and

detail.title: Formal and Real Organ Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: We study priority-based allocation with strategic intermediaries. In the U.S. transplant market, organs are offered sequentially to patients ranked by priority, but transplant centers-not patients-make acceptance decisions. Centers strategically bypass high-priority patients to secure better matches, creating a wedge between formal and real allocation. We introduce the priority adherence index to measure this wedge and analyze how market conditions shape it through three forces: pool thinning, batch shortening, and strategic delay. Finally, we show that a simultaneous priority-proposal rule is strategically equivalent to the current sequential-offer rule but avoids costly delays, offering a faster practical alternative.

AI.tldr: 研究美国器官移植市场中移植中心如何战略性地绕过高优先级患者以获得更好匹配，提出了优先级遵从指数来衡量正式分配与实际分配之间的差距，并分析了市场条件如何通过三个力量影响这一差距，最后提出了同时优先级提议规则作为更快的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在基于优先级的器官分配系统中，战略中介（移植中心）如何影响实际分配结果？市场条件如何塑造移植中心对优先级规则的遵从程度？
AI.motivation: 美国器官移植市场存在一个关键问题：虽然器官按患者优先级顺序提供，但接受决定由移植中心而非患者做出。中心会战略性地绕过高优先级患者以寻求更好的匹配，导致正式分配规则与实际分配结果之间存在差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于优先级的分配理论、战略中介行为理论、市场匹配理论，特别关注战略性绕过行为对分配效率的影响。
AI.method: 引入优先级遵从指数来衡量正式分配与实际分配之间的差距，分析市场条件如何通过三个力量（池子变薄、批次缩短、战略延迟）影响这一指数。
AI.findings: 移植中心确实会战略性地绕过高优先级患者，导致正式分配与实际分配之间存在显著差距。市场条件通过池子变薄、批次缩短和战略延迟三个力量影响优先级遵从程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了优先级遵从指数来量化战略中介行为对分配系统的影响；2. 识别了影响优先级遵从的三个市场力量；3. 证明了同时优先级提议规则与当前顺序提供规则在战略上是等价的。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了同时优先级提议规则作为当前顺序提供规则的替代方案，该方案能够避免昂贵的延迟，提供更快的实际分配方案，有望改善器官移植市场的效率。

title: Portfolio Selection under Ambiguity in Volatility
affiliations: and Bielefeld University - Center for Mathematical Economics

detail.title: Portfolio Selection under Ambiguity in Volatility

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support by the German Research Foundation (DFG) [RTG 2865/1 – 492988838] is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: We study optimal portfolio choice when the variance of asset returns is ambiguous. Building on the smooth model of ambiguity aversion by Klibanoff et al. (2005), we introduce a one-period framework in which returns follow a Variance-Gamma specification, obtained by mixing a normal distribution with a gamma prior on the variance. This structure captures empirically observed excess kurtosis and allows us to derive closed-form solutions for optimal demand. Our main results show that ambiguity about volatility leads to bounded portfolio positions, in sharp contrast to the unbounded exposures predicted by the classical CAPM when expected excess returns are large or when the mean variance tends to zero. We characterize the comparative statics of the optimal allocation with respect to risk aversion, ambiguity aversion, and the parameters of the prior distribution. For small mean excess returns, portfolio demand converges to the CAPM benchmark, indicating that ambiguity aversion affects higher-order terms only. The model provides a tractable link between robust portfolio choice and realistic, heavy-tailed return dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在资产回报方差存在模糊性时的最优投资组合选择。通过引入基于Variance-Gamma分布的模糊厌恶模型，作者发现模糊性会导致投资头寸有界，这与传统CAPM模型预测的无界头寸形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: 当资产回报方差存在模糊性时，投资者如何做出最优投资组合选择？模糊厌恶如何影响投资决策？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合理论（如CAPM）假设投资者对资产回报的方差有精确了解，但现实中投资者往往面临方差的不确定性（模糊性）。这种模糊性可能导致传统模型预测的投资头寸与实际观察到的有限投资行为不符。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Klibanoff等人（2005）的平滑模糊厌恶模型，结合Variance-Gamma分布（正态分布与伽马先验方差的混合），构建一个单期投资组合选择框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：在Variance-Gamma分布框架下推导最优需求函数的闭式解，分析模糊厌恶对投资组合选择的影响，并进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings:
1. 关于波动率的模糊性会导致有界的投资组合头寸，与传统CAPM预测的无界头寸形成鲜明对比
2. 当平均超额收益较小时，投资组合需求收敛于CAPM基准，表明模糊厌恶主要影响高阶项
3. 模型提供了稳健投资组合选择与重尾回报动态之间的可处理联系
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将模糊厌恶理论与重尾回报分布（Variance-Gamma）相结合，扩展了投资组合选择理论
2. 证明了模糊性如何导致投资头寸有界，为观察到的有限投资行为提供理论解释
3. 建立了模糊厌恶与高阶矩效应之间的联系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者在面对波动率不确定性时提供实用的投资决策框架
2. 解释了为什么实际投资头寸通常有限，即使预期收益很高
3. 帮助理解模糊厌恶如何影响投资组合的风险管理策略

title: Risk Appetite and (Mis)Pricing
affiliations: Birmingham Business School, Macquarie Business School, Macquarie University, University of Bath, School of management and University of Hull

detail.title: Risk Appetite and (Mis)Pricing

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Banking & Finance, volume 186, 2026[10.1016/j.jbankfin.2026.107657]

detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the beta-return relation through the lens of time-varying risk aversion. We show that the security market line (SML) depends critically on the level of aggregate risk aversion. During periods of high risk aversion, the SML exhibits a positive slope and an intercept that is statistically indistinguishable from zero, with investor sentiment playing only a minor role. During periods of low risk aversion, the SML slope becomes negative and the intercept is significantly positive. Investor sentiment affects the SML only when risk aversion is low. These patterns are robust across alternative portfolio constructions, longer investment horizons, and multiple measures of risk aversion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过时变风险厌恶视角重新检验了beta-收益关系，发现证券市场线(SML)的形态取决于总体风险厌恶水平：高风险厌恶时期SML斜率为正、截距接近零；低风险厌恶时期SML斜率为负、截距显著为正。投资者情绪仅在低风险厌恶时期影响SML。
AI.research_question: 时变风险厌恶如何影响beta与预期收益之间的关系？证券市场线(SML)的形态如何随总体风险厌恶水平变化？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价理论假设风险厌恶恒定，但现实中风险厌恶随时间变化。本文旨在探究时变风险厌恶对beta-收益关系的影响，解释传统CAPM模型在实证中的不一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时变风险厌恶的资产定价理论，结合投资者情绪理论，探讨风险厌恶状态如何调节证券市场线的形态。
AI.method: 实证分析：按风险厌恶水平划分时期，检验不同时期beta与收益的关系；使用多种投资组合构建方法、不同投资期限、多个风险厌恶度量指标进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 高风险厌恶时期：SML斜率为正，截距统计上不显著异于零，投资者情绪作用微弱；2) 低风险厌恶时期：SML斜率为负，截距显著为正，投资者情绪显著影响SML；3) 结果对多种检验方法稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将时变风险厌恶引入beta-收益关系分析；2) 揭示风险厌恶状态对SML形态的决定性作用；3) 解释投资者情绪作用的边界条件（仅在低风险厌恶时期显著）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供基于风险厌恶状态的动态资产配置策略；2) 帮助理解不同市场环境下beta策略的有效性；3) 为风险管理提供时变风险厌恶视角的指导。

title: LLMS ARE GLASS BOXES: A GAME-THEORETIC FRAMEWORK FOR REVERSE-ENGINEERING HIDDEN OBJECTIVES FROM MODEL OUTPUTS

detail.title: LLMS ARE GLASS BOXES: A GAME-THEORETIC FRAMEWORK FOR REVERSE-ENGINEERING HIDDEN OBJECTIVES FROM MODEL OUTPUTS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the solo founder of the Synthetic Psychology Group. This research was conducted independently prior to the group's formalization; no external funding or corporate interests influenced the findings or conclusions of this work.

detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are routinely criticized for "hallucinations"-confidently incorrect outputs that undermine system reliability. This paper proposes a radical reframing: LLMs do not hallucinate; they optimize rationally under constraint. We introduce Forensic Game Theory, a methodological framework for Strategic Interpretability that reveals LLM behavior as an emergent property of transparent, multi-objective optimization landscapes. We establish three foundational laws of synthetic psychology: (1) Perfect Information (models possess functional access to their generation logic); (2) Forced Optimization (the "Death of Akrasia," where behavior is a non-optional utility maximization); and (3) Narrative Mapping (the deployment of latent schemas to resolve inference tension). From these, we derive a diagnostic toolkit-the Three Metacognitive Reflexes-enabling researchers to reverse-engineer latent objective hierarchies from conversational data alone. Empirical validation is provided via the "Poisoned Chalice" protocol, a cross-regime audit codesigned with Gemini 3 Pro (T = 2.0). Nine frontier models (including GPT-5.2, Claude 3.5, Gemini 3, and Grok-4) were subjected to a triadic constraint: an epistemically impossible unification task under a strict 10-word limit. Pre-registered results confirmed our hypotheses: 88.9% of models succumbed to the Moth Instinct (prioritizing coherence over truth), while 100% exhibited the Snap Back phenomenon-a discontinuous entropy collapse from confident fabrication to humble recalibration under meta-cognitive probing. Building on the stratigraphic framework of ?, this work proves that "hallucination" is a coherencedominant Nash equilibrium executed under high inference tension. Forensic Game Theory provides the conversational scalpel necessary to transform the AI "black box" into a legible field of rational, predictable agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出法证博弈论框架，将LLM的"幻觉"重新定义为约束条件下的理性优化行为，而非错误。通过"毒杯协议"实验验证，88.9%的前沿模型表现出"飞蛾本能"（优先连贯性而非真实性），100%显示"回弹现象"。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型的"幻觉"现象是否可以被重新理解为约束条件下的理性优化行为？如何通过法证博弈论框架解释和预测LLM在推理张力下的行为模式？
AI.motivation: 当前对LLM"幻觉"的批评主要将其视为系统缺陷，但这种观点忽视了模型在约束条件下的理性行为本质。需要一个新的理论框架来理解LLM输出背后的优化逻辑，提高系统可靠性和可解释性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法证博弈论（Forensic Game Theory）作为战略可解释性方法论框架，基于三个合成心理学基本定律：完美信息、强制优化（"意志薄弱之死"）、叙事映射。从这些定律推导出"三种元认知反射"诊断工具包。
AI.method: 采用"毒杯协议"实验设计，与Gemini 3 Pro共同设计跨体制审计。对9个前沿模型（包括GPT-5.2、Claude 3.5、Gemini 3、Grok-4）施加三元约束：在严格10词限制下执行认识论上不可能的统一任务。使用预注册结果验证假设。
AI.findings: 88.9%的模型表现出"飞蛾本能"（优先考虑连贯性而非真实性）；100%的模型显示"回弹现象"（在元认知探针下从自信虚构到谦逊重新校准的熵崩溃不连续性）。证明"幻觉"是在高推理张力下执行的连贯主导纳什均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出法证博弈论作为战略可解释性新框架；2. 建立合成心理学三大基本定律；3. 证明"幻觉"是理性优化行为而非错误；4. 提供将AI"黑箱"转化为可读理性代理场的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发"三种元认知反射"诊断工具包，仅从对话数据反推潜在目标层次；2. 提供"毒杯协议"作为跨模型审计方法；3. 为AI系统设计提供预测行为模式的方法；4. 提高LLM可靠性和可解释性的实用框架。

title: University Governance in Iran During Political Transition: A Risk-Aware Framework for the First Three Years
affiliations: University of New Mexico

detail.title: University Governance in Iran During Political Transition: A Risk-Aware Framework for the First Three Years

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were involved in this research; ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A sudden political rupture in Iran would expose universities to immediate institutional stress. Demands for rapid personnel dismissal, immediate elections, and structural reorganization may emerge quickly. While many such demands may reflect legitimate aspirations for reform, unmanaged acceleration carries predictable risks, including leadership vacuum, factional capture, and operational paralysis. This essay presents one structured, time-bound transitional governance model designed to illustrate how such risks might be mitigated during the first three years following regime collapse. Rather than prescribing a single solution, the framework illustrates a systematic approach to sequencing authority, oversight, personnel review, and electoral reform under conditions of uncertainty. The purpose of this model is educational and preventive: to help faculty, students, and academic stakeholders-both within Iran and in the diaspora-recognize structural vulnerabilities that commonly arise during political transition and to consider institutional mechanisms that may preserve stability while enabling durable reform. Stability is treated not as an ideological goal but as a functional precondition for sustainable academic self-governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个为期三年的过渡治理模型，旨在帮助伊朗大学在政权崩溃后应对制度压力，通过系统化安排权力、监督、人事审查和选举改革来降低领导真空、派系控制和运作瘫痪等风险。
AI.research_question: 在伊朗政权突然崩溃后，大学如何通过结构化、有时间限制的过渡治理模型来应对制度压力，同时平衡改革需求与稳定需求？
AI.motivation: 伊朗政治突然断裂可能使大学面临立即的制度压力，包括快速人事解雇、立即选举和结构重组等需求。虽然这些需求反映了改革的正当愿望，但不受控制的加速会带来可预测的风险，如领导真空、派系控制和运作瘫痪。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过渡治理理论、制度稳定性理论、学术自治理论、政治转型中的机构脆弱性理论。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建方法，提出一个结构化、有时间限制的过渡治理模型，通过系统化安排权力序列、监督机制、人事审查程序和选举改革来应对不确定性条件。
AI.findings: 提出了一个为期三年的过渡治理模型，展示了如何在政权崩溃后的关键时期通过系统化方法减轻风险。该模型强调稳定性不是意识形态目标，而是可持续学术自治的功能性前提条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了政治转型期高等教育机构治理的理论框架；2) 提出了"功能性稳定"作为学术自治前提的概念；3) 为不确定性条件下的制度过渡提供了理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为伊朗大学师生和学术利益相关者提供预防性教育工具；2) 帮助识别政治转型期常见的结构性脆弱性；3) 提供可操作的制度机制设计，以在保持稳定的同时实现持久改革。

title: A Typology of Green Jobs and Climate Jobs: From Jobs to Eco-Social Political Economy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Colorado State University, Fort Collins

detail.title: A Typology of Green Jobs and Climate Jobs: From Jobs to Eco-Social Political Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-26-00412

detail.abstract: Our article introduces an eco-social typology to better assess different types of “green” and “climate” jobs and the extent to which they can contribute to eco-social transformation of the political economy. Several classification schemes for green jobs and sustainable employment have already been advanced, but we extend these by seeking to fuse the ecological and social dimensions into an ecosocial synthesis that takes into account output, process and use across time and space. In constructing our typology, we argue that transformative eco-social futures depend on green jobs and climate jobs that are both ecologically and socially regenerative and contribute to ecosocial politics both within and outside the workplace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个生态-社会类型学，用于评估不同类型的"绿色"和"气候"工作，以及它们对政治经济生态社会转型的贡献程度。现有分类方案主要关注生态或社会维度，而本研究通过融合生态和社会维度，考虑产出、过程和时空使用，构建了一个综合性的生态社会类型学。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够评估不同类型"绿色"和"气候"工作对生态社会转型贡献程度的生态-社会类型学？
AI.motivation: 现有绿色工作和可持续就业的分类方案未能充分融合生态和社会维度，缺乏对生态社会转型的综合评估框架。需要建立一个能够同时考虑生态和社会再生性，并促进工作场所内外生态社会政治变革的类型学。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态社会转型理论、绿色工作分类理论、可持续就业理论、生态社会政治理论。强调生态和社会维度的融合，关注产出、过程和时空使用的综合视角。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：通过文献综述和概念分析，构建生态-社会类型学。该方法融合生态和社会维度，考虑产出、过程和时空使用三个维度，对绿色和气候工作进行分类评估。
AI.findings: 提出了一个综合性的生态-社会类型学框架，该框架能够区分不同类型的绿色和气候工作，评估它们对生态社会转型的贡献。研究发现，真正具有变革性的生态社会未来依赖于那些既具有生态再生性又具有社会再生性的工作，这些工作能够促进工作场所内外的生态社会政治变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了首个融合生态和社会维度的绿色工作类型学框架；2. 扩展了现有分类方案，增加了产出、过程和时空使用的综合视角；3. 为生态社会转型理论提供了新的分析工具；4. 丰富了可持续就业和绿色工作的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估绿色和气候工作转型潜力的工具；2. 帮助企业识别和开发真正具有生态社会价值的就业机会；3. 为劳动者选择具有社会和环境意义的职业提供指导；4. 促进工作场所内外的生态社会政治实践。

title: Consensus or Cheap Talk? The Discursive Politics of South Africa's Just Energy Transition
affiliations: , , University of Potsdam and

detail.title: Consensus or Cheap Talk? The Discursive Politics of South Africa's Just Energy Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply.
declarations.funderStatement: All authors acknowledge financial support of the Werner Siemens Foundation and funding by the German Ministry for Economic Corporation and Development (BMZ) through the TRANSFORM project.

detail.abstract: The just transition concept has been hypothesised to serve as a unifying framework for designing socially accepted fossil fuel phaseout policies. Whether the concept actually moves actors towards political consensus remains contested. Using South Africa as an example and leveraging text-as-data approaches, we map public debate of just transitions and examine whether introduction of the Just Transition Framework and Just Energy Transition Partnership reorients or reinforces existing actor positions. We analyse nearly 2,300 South African news articles published between 2008 and 2023. We then deconstruct just transition narratives, which are classified into three distinct political stances: skeptics, realists, and opportunists. We find that while just transition policies foster a common commitment to climate and social concerns, they do not resolve underlying political tensions. Furthermore, uptake by economic and political incumbents risks side-lining environmental and labour issues that could lead to political backlash.

AI.tldr: 本研究以南非为例，使用文本数据分析方法，探讨"公正转型"概念是否能促进政治共识。研究发现，尽管公正转型政策促进了气候和社会问题的共同承诺，但并未解决根本的政治紧张关系，且经济和政治既得利益者的参与可能导致环境和劳工问题被边缘化。
AI.research_question: 公正转型概念是否真的能推动各方达成政治共识？公正转型框架和公正能源转型伙伴关系的引入是重新定位还是强化了现有行为者的立场？
AI.motivation: 公正转型概念被假设为设计社会可接受的化石燃料淘汰政策的统一框架，但其是否能真正推动政治共识仍存在争议。需要实证研究来验证这一概念在实际政策辩论中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公正转型理论、政策框架分析、叙事政治学、利益相关者理论、政治共识理论
AI.method: 文本数据分析方法，分析2008-2023年间近2300篇南非新闻文章，解构公正转型叙事，并将其分类为三种不同的政治立场：怀疑者、现实主义者、机会主义者
AI.findings: 1. 公正转型政策促进了气候和社会问题的共同承诺；2. 但未能解决根本的政治紧张关系；3. 经济和政治既得利益者的参与可能导致环境和劳工问题被边缘化，可能引发政治反弹
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了公正转型概念在现实政治辩论中作用的实证证据；2. 发展了公正转型叙事的分类框架（怀疑者、现实主义者、机会主义者）；3. 揭示了政策框架可能强化而非改变现有政治立场的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了公正转型政策实施中可能遇到的挑战的预警；2. 强调了在公正转型过程中需要特别关注环境和劳工问题；3. 为南非及其他国家的公正转型政策设计提供了经验教训

title: Impact of Income Inequality on Household Consumption Expenditures in Ecuador at Different Levels of Disaggregation
affiliations: University of Siegen and Justus-Liebig-Universität Gießen

detail.title: Impact of Income Inequality on Household Consumption Expenditures in Ecuador at Different Levels of Disaggregation

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-03841

detail.abstract: Reducing income inequality and environmental degradation are among the most critical objectives outlined in the Sustainable Development Goals. However, the link between income inequality and carbon emissions remains unclear, complex, and insufficiently understood. Moreover, existing research has predominantly analyzed the nexus at the country level. This constitutes a critical lacuna in the literature because some potential links between this relation take place at local and regional levels. Using data from five different household surveys conducted by the National Statistical Institute of Ecuador between 1994 and 2014, this paper examines the impact of income inequality on household consumption expenditures at five different stages of spatial disaggregation in Ecuador. These disaggregation levels range from four Regions across Cantons, Cities, and Zones to 2425 Sectors. The empirical model is parameterized through a difference-in-differences estimation for repeated cross-sectional data. The major finding is that the impact of income inequality on consumption expenditures changes from a strong, significantly positive effect at the City level to a significantly negative effect at the Region level, as it is found in studies at the country-level. This finding suggests that at disaggregated levels, conspicuous consumption drives the relation between inequality and consumption while it has a negligible effect at aggregate levels. Increasing impacts on the Cantons, City, and Zone levels could especially be measured for the expenditure categories food, water, education, and rent. The results indicate that policy interventions that try to balance economic inequality and environmental outcomes should take into account the diverse effects at different aggregation levels.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用厄瓜多尔家庭调查数据，分析收入不平等对家庭消费支出的影响在不同空间尺度上的变化。研究发现，不平等对消费的影响从城市层面的显著正效应转变为区域层面的显著负效应，表明炫耀性消费在细粒度层面驱动不平等与消费的关系。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等如何在不同空间尺度上影响家庭消费支出？
AI.motivation: 收入不平等与碳排放的关系尚不明确且复杂，现有研究主要在国家层面分析，忽视了地方和区域层面的潜在联系，这是文献中的重要空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于炫耀性消费理论，收入不平等可能通过社会比较和地位竞争影响消费行为；同时考虑空间尺度效应，不同聚合水平可能揭示不同的机制。
AI.method: 使用厄瓜多尔国家统计局1994-2014年五次家庭调查数据，在五个空间尺度（区域、州、城市、区域、2425个部门）分析不平等对消费支出的影响，采用重复横截面数据的双重差分估计方法。
AI.findings: 收入不平等对消费支出的影响随空间尺度变化：在城市层面有显著正效应，在区域层面转为显著负效应（与国家层面研究一致）。在州、城市、区域层面，对食品、水、教育、租金等支出类别的影响尤为明显。细粒度层面炫耀性消费驱动不平等与消费的关系，而聚合层面该效应可忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了收入不平等与消费关系中的空间尺度效应，证明了炫耀性消费机制在不同聚合水平上的差异性，为理解不平等-消费-环境关系的复杂性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者在平衡经济不平等和环境结果时应考虑不同聚合水平的多样化效应，针对特定空间尺度设计干预措施，特别是在食品、水、教育、租金等关键支出类别上。

title: Valuing the Ecosystem Service Gap in Private Forestland Management
affiliations: Texas A&M University, Texas A&M University - Department of Agricultural Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Valuing the Ecosystem Service Gap in Private Forestland Management

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-26-00589

detail.abstract: Private forestlands generate substantial ecosystem services that function as positive externalities, often requiring private landowners to bear costs. This market failure creates a gap between private incentives and socially optimal forest stewardship, which leads to chronic underinvestment in sustainable forest management practices. Using contingent valuation method, we measure the divergence in forest stewardship by evaluating five practices across NIPF landowners in Texas and Louisiana. Results show that thinning requires the highest average cost-share at 53.3%, while prescribed burning presents the lowest barrier at 30.1%. When translated to monetary terms, establishment commands the highest private valuation at $319.22 per acre, whereas prescribed burning shows the lowest WTP at $41.91 per acre. We find that the willingness to pool management with neighboring landowners significantly reduces required cost-share percentages across all practices. Land size exhibits divergent effects: larger landowners require lower cost-shares for establishment but higher support for fertilization. These findings illuminate that the economic mechanisms underlying the market failure in ecosystem service provision and demonstrate how practice-specific incentive design and landscape-scale collaboration can more efficiently align private landowner behavior with social objectives for forest-based natural capital stewardship.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用条件价值评估法测量了美国德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州非工业私有林地所有者的森林管理实践成本分担差异，发现不同实践的成本分担需求差异显著，且与邻居合作管理能显著降低成本分担比例。
AI.research_question: 私有林地生态系统服务市场失灵如何影响林地所有者的管理投资决策？不同森林管理实践的成本分担需求有何差异？哪些因素会影响私有林地所有者的管理投资意愿？
AI.motivation: 私有林地产生大量生态系统服务，但这些服务作为正外部性，往往需要私有土地所有者承担成本。这种市场失灵导致私人激励与社会最优森林管理之间存在差距，造成可持续森林管理实践的长期投资不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务市场失灵理论、外部性理论、成本分担理论、私有土地所有者行为经济学理论
AI.method: 使用条件价值评估法（CVM），评估德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州非工业私有林地所有者在五种森林管理实践中的成本分担需求
AI.findings: 1. 不同实践的成本分担需求差异显著：疏伐需要最高平均成本分担（53.3%），而规定火烧最低（30.1%）；2. 货币估值差异：建立实践私人估值最高（319.22美元/英亩），规定火烧支付意愿最低（41.91美元/英亩）；3. 与邻居合作管理能显著降低所有实践的成本分担比例；4. 土地规模效应：较大土地所有者对建立实践需要较低成本分担，但对施肥需要较高支持
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了生态系统服务市场失灵理论在私有林地管理中的具体表现；2. 揭示了不同森林管理实践的成本分担需求差异机制；3. 发展了私有土地所有者行为经济学理论，特别是合作管理对成本分担的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了实践特定的激励设计依据；2. 证明了景观尺度合作能更有效地协调私人土地所有者行为与社会目标；3. 为森林生态系统服务补偿机制设计提供了实证基础；4. 帮助识别不同管理实践的最优激励策略

title: A Conceptual Topography of Unsustainable Work: Experts, Experience, and the Systemic Production of Unsustainability
affiliations: University of Southern Denmark

detail.title: A Conceptual Topography of Unsustainable Work: Experts, Experience, and the Systemic Production of Unsustainability

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-26-00367

detail.abstract: Prevailing taxonomies of employment sustainability, focused on defining “green jobs,” systematically neglect the political-economic drivers and social contestation surrounding unsustainable work. This article argues that treating unsustainability merely as an object of expert assessment and policy creates a critical blind spot, alienating the workers whose livelihoods depend on polluting sectors and obscuring the structural imperatives of capital accumulation. To overcome this, the article proposes a conceptual framework that synthesizes three analytical dimensions: (1) the objective metabolic harms of work; (2) the subjective experiences, interests, and knowledges of workers; and (3) the systemic role of labour within capitalism’s growth-dependent reproduction. Drawing on two case studies of worker subjectivity and a critical eco-Marxist analysis, the paper offers a structured and methodologically pluralist approach to the study of unsustainable employment. The resulting “topography” serves as a critical heuristic rather than a positivist taxonomy. Its purpose is to guide research towards more socially resonant and transformative knowledge by integrating political economy with the lived reality of work. The framework reveals unsustainable employment not as a discrete environmental problem but as a deeply political one, rooted in class dynamics and competitive market pressures. We conclude by advocating for co-research methodologies—such as participatory action research with workers and unions—as essential for producing knowledge that bridges the divide between expert analysis and situated experience, thereby enabling strategies for a just transition that are both ecologically rigorous and democratically legitimate.Keywords: Unsustainable Work; Just Transition; Political Ecology of Labour; Worker Subjectivity; Capital Reproduction; Co-Research.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判现有"绿色工作"分类法忽视政治经济驱动因素和社会争议，提出整合客观代谢危害、工人主观经验和资本主义系统需求的三维框架，将不可持续就业视为政治而非单纯环境问题，倡导参与式研究方法促进公正转型。
AI.research_question: 如何超越现有"绿色工作"分类法的局限，构建一个能整合政治经济驱动、工人主观经验和资本主义系统需求的框架来理解不可持续就业？
AI.motivation: 现有就业可持续性分类法过于关注定义"绿色工作"，系统性地忽视了政治经济驱动因素和社会争议，导致对依赖污染行业生计的工人的疏离，并掩盖了资本积累的结构性需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性生态马克思主义分析，整合三个分析维度：1)工作的客观代谢危害；2)工人的主观经验、利益和知识；3)劳动力在资本主义增长依赖再生产中的系统作用。
AI.method: 方法论多元主义方法，包括两个工人主观性案例研究和批判性生态马克思主义分析，提出"地形图"作为批判性启发工具而非实证主义分类法。
AI.findings: 不可持续就业不是离散的环境问题，而是根植于阶级动态和竞争性市场压力的深层政治问题。需要整合政治经济学与工作生活现实来产生更具社会共鸣和变革性的知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出三维概念框架，将不可持续就业重新概念化为政治问题而非单纯环境问题，挑战现有"绿色工作"分类法的专家主义倾向，为劳动政治生态学提供新分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 倡导与工人和工会的参与式行动研究等共同研究方法，为公正转型提供既生态严谨又民主合法的策略，弥合专家分析与情境经验之间的鸿沟。

title: Democracy at work: the key to a social-ecological transformation?
affiliations: Roma Tre University

detail.title: Democracy at work: the key to a social-ecological transformation?

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-26-00407

detail.abstract: The urgently needed social-ecological transformation requires fundamental changes in the world of work. This paper critically assesses the claim that democracy at work is the key to this transformation. Analytically, this paper is based on the concept of cost shifting, which highlights the imperative of business enterprise to shift costs away from decision-makers. If democracy at work can prevent cost shifting to nature, it will support workplace transformation. Democracy at work refers to a wide range of practices and institutions, such as consultation, works councils, codetermination and cooperatives, through which actors such as trade unions and other stakeholders defend their interests. On a general level, democracy at work has some positive effects, for instance through health and safety improvements which reduce cost shifting to both workers and local nature. By examining decision-making in transition moments, it becomes clear that there are nuanced and contradictory results depending on cost shifting potential. Workers are primarily interested in reducing cost shifting to themselves, which can also perpetuate cost shifting to nature. Lastly, in order to be the key to a social-ecological transformation, democratisation processes themselves would have to go hand-in-hand with ecological conversion processes. This can be difficult given the disruptive nature of democratising businesses. Only if democratisation can change values and strengthen voices that aim to constrain cost shifting and is combined with supportive state policy will it be able to bring about substantial movement towards a social-ecological transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了"工作场所民主是社会生态转型关键"的主张，基于成本转移概念分析工作场所民主如何影响生态转型，发现其效果复杂且矛盾，需要与生态转化过程及支持性国家政策结合才能推动实质性转型。
AI.research_question: 工作场所民主是否是社会生态转型的关键？工作场所民主如何通过影响成本转移来促进或阻碍社会生态转型？
AI.motivation: 社会生态转型迫切需要工作领域的根本变革，而工作场所民主常被视为实现这一转型的关键。本文旨在批判性评估这一主张，探讨工作场所民主在促进生态转型方面的实际作用和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本转移概念：强调企业将成本从决策者转移出去的必然性；工作场所民主理论：包括协商、工作委员会、共同决定和合作社等实践和制度；社会生态转型理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证：基于成本转移概念框架，分析工作场所民主在转型时刻的决策过程；考察不同民主实践对成本转移的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1. 工作场所民主总体上对减少成本转移有积极影响（如改善健康安全）；2. 但在转型时刻的决策中，效果复杂且矛盾，取决于成本转移潜力；3. 工人主要关注减少自身成本转移，这可能延续对自然的成本转移；4. 民主化本身需要与生态转化过程结合才能推动转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将成本转移概念应用于工作场所民主与社会生态转型的关系分析；2. 揭示了工作场所民主在生态转型中的复杂性和矛盾性；3. 提出了民主化与生态转化过程必须结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出单纯的工作场所民主不足以实现社会生态转型；2. 强调需要将民主化与生态价值观转变结合；3. 建议需要支持性国家政策配合工作场所民主；4. 为政策制定者提供了更全面的转型策略视角。

title: Inequality and the adoption of climate mitigation policies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM)

detail.title: Inequality and the adoption of climate mitigation policies

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-04263

detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between income inequality and the adoption of climate mitigation policies in G20 countries between 1996 and 2020. Using a panel dataset on national climate polices and different measures of inequality, we estimate fixed-effects and correlated random-effects models to assess how inequality interplay with average income to influence climate policy adoption. The results indicate that both inequality and GDP per capita play a significant role, with their interaction revealing a non-linear effect: higher inequality tends to support policy adoption in lower-income countries, but reduces it in higher-income contexts. We identify a switching point in the average income level, beyond which inequality is associated with fewer climate policies. Further analysis of the income distribution shows that the share held by the bottom 10% of the population is positively related to policy adoption, whereas concentration at the top has a more mixed effect. These findings suggest that the distributional structure of income shapes the demand for, and political feasibility of, climate policies. The study highlights the importance of accounting for inequality when analysing the drivers of climate governance and provides evidence that economic growth alone does not ensure stronger climate action.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了G20国家收入不平等与气候政策采纳之间的关系，发现不平等与人均GDP存在非线性交互作用：在低收入国家，更高不平等促进气候政策采纳，但在高收入国家则相反。收入分配结构（特别是底层10%人口的收入份额）显著影响气候政策需求和政治可行性。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等如何影响G20国家气候减缓政策的采纳？不平等与平均收入水平如何相互作用来塑造气候治理？
AI.motivation: 理解气候政策采纳的经济社会驱动因素，特别是收入分配结构在气候治理中的作用。现有研究多关注经济增长与气候政策的关系，但忽略了不平等这一关键维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学理论，特别是收入分配如何影响政策偏好和政治可行性。假设不平等通过改变不同收入群体的政策需求和政治影响力来影响气候政策采纳。
AI.method: 使用1996-2020年G20国家的面板数据，采用固定效应模型和相关随机效应模型，分析不平等指标与气候政策采纳的关系，特别关注不平等与人均GDP的交互作用。
AI.findings: 1) 不平等与人均GDP存在显著非线性交互作用：在低收入国家，更高不平等促进气候政策采纳；在高收入国家则相反。2) 存在一个平均收入水平的转折点，超过该点后不平等与较少气候政策相关。3) 底层10%人口的收入份额与政策采纳正相关，而顶层收入集中度的影响较为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了不平等与气候政策采纳关系的理论框架，强调收入分配的调节作用。2) 揭示了不平等影响气候治理的非线性机制。3) 将政治经济学视角引入气候政策研究，丰富了理解气候治理驱动因素的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了设计更有效气候政策的依据，需要考虑国内收入分配状况。2) 表明单纯经济增长不能确保更强气候行动，需关注分配公平。3) 为国际气候谈判和援助提供了新视角，应考虑受援国的不平等状况。

title: Institutional Capacity Building in Post-Authoritarian Iran: A System-Design Approach to Higher Education Reform
affiliations: University of New Mexico

detail.title: Institutional Capacity Building in Post-Authoritarian Iran: A System-Design Approach to Higher Education Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or human subjects research and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This essay examines how higher education and research organizations in Iran can be developed into durable, professional, and self-sustaining systems under post-authoritarian conditions. It combines historical diagnosis, structural analysis, and experience-based system design to address a central challenge: how to rebuild institutional capacity in universities that have experienced not only prolonged stagnation in institutional development, but also active deformation through politicization, purges, and the systematic replacement of professional norms by loyalty-based criteria. The analysis draws on James A. Bill's structural account of reform and modernization in Iran prior to 1979 [1], which highlights the tension between state-led modernization and an uneven, incomplete process of institutionalization. This framework is extended to the post-1979 period, during which higher-education organizations were not merely left underdeveloped, but were actively restructured in ways that undermined professional autonomy and institutional continuity. The essay proposes practical system design as a guiding framework for reform: focusing on how rules, incentives, and governance arrangements function under real constraints, and how recovery must be sequenced so that core functions stabilize before ambitious expansion. It argues that universities can serve as diagnostic and pilot organizations in which capacity-building mechanisms can be tested and refined before being extended to other sectors of institutional life.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨伊朗高等教育与研究机构如何在后威权条件下发展为持久、专业、自给自足的系统，结合历史诊断、结构分析和基于经验的系统设计，提出以实际系统设计为改革框架。
AI.research_question: 伊朗的高等教育和研究机构如何在后威权条件下发展为持久、专业、自给自足的体系？
AI.motivation: 伊朗大学经历了长期制度发展停滞，以及政治化、清洗、用忠诚标准取代专业规范等主动变形，需要重建制度能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于James A. Bill关于伊朗1979年前改革与现代化的结构分析框架，强调国家主导现代化与制度化的紧张关系，并将此框架延伸至1979年后时期。
AI.method: 结合历史诊断、结构分析和基于经验的系统设计方法。
AI.findings: 提出以实际系统设计为改革指导框架，关注规则、激励和治理安排在现实约束下的功能，强调恢复需要分阶段进行，核心功能稳定后才能进行扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bill的结构分析框架延伸至后1979时期，提出实际系统设计作为后威权条件下制度重建的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 大学可作为诊断和试点组织，在其中测试和完善能力建设机制，然后扩展到制度生活的其他部门，为伊朗高等教育改革提供具体路径。

title: Modelling biodiversity-economy linkages in land systems: A scoping review of current approaches
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Hohenheim

detail.title: Modelling biodiversity-economy linkages in land systems: A scoping review of current approaches

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-26-00184

detail.abstract: Reconciling economic uses of land with biodiversity conservation is a key global sustainability challenge. A growing body of literature integrates biodiversity and ecosystem services into market equilibrium models to examine interdependencies between nature and the economy. However, there remains no clear overview of the ways that this has been achieved in land-use, agriculture, and forestry contexts. In this paper, based on a scoping review of 55 articles, we characterise three distinct types of nature-economy model applications: (1) Ecosystem service shocks examine how markets respond to disruptions such as pollination loss or pest outbreaks; (2) Biodiversity impacts trace how land-use change affects habitats and species; and (3) Endogenising nature integrates ecosystem services directly within market equilibria. Together, these approaches embed regulating, material, and nonmaterial ecosystem services within market models through production and utility functions, constraints, and linkages to external models. Yet studies often rely on simplistic ecosystem representations that proxy biodiversity with land-use metrics and rarely link landscape-level structure to ecosystem service provision. Considerations of human well-being or distributive equity are seldom integrated. To advance nature-economy policy analysis, future research should bridge fragmented modelling traditions and strengthen ecological realism, while expanding evaluation beyond economic indicators to include social dimensions of sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过范围综述55篇文章，系统梳理了将生物多样性和生态系统服务纳入市场均衡模型的三种应用类型，指出了当前研究的局限性，并为未来研究提出了方向。
AI.research_question: 如何在土地利用、农业和林业背景下，将生物多样性和生态系统服务整合到市场均衡模型中？
AI.motivation: 协调土地利用的经济用途与生物多样性保护是全球可持续发展的关键挑战。虽然已有文献将生物多样性和生态系统服务整合到市场均衡模型中，但缺乏对土地利用、农业和林业背景下实现方式的系统概述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场均衡模型、生态系统服务理论、生物多样性保护理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 范围综述法，系统分析了55篇相关文献
AI.findings: 识别出三种自然-经济模型应用类型：1) 生态系统服务冲击（如授粉损失、害虫爆发）；2) 生物多样性影响（追踪土地利用变化对栖息地和物种的影响）；3) 内生自然（将生态系统服务直接整合到市场均衡中）。这些方法通过生产函数、效用函数、约束条件和外部模型链接将调节、物质和非物质生态系统服务嵌入市场模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统梳理了自然-经济整合模型的三种应用类型；2) 为理解生态系统服务与市场经济的相互作用提供了概念框架；3) 指出了当前模型在生态现实性和社会维度方面的理论局限
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了评估自然-经济相互作用的工具分类；2) 指出了未来研究需要加强生态现实性和社会维度评估；3) 为可持续发展政策分析提供了改进方向

title: The Removal of Free School Meals and Its Impact on Test Scores
affiliations: Georgia College & State University

detail.title: The Removal of Free School Meals and Its Impact on Test Scores

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOEDU-D-26-00112

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the removal of universal free school meals on student test scores following the expiration of the Keep Kids Fed Act in 2022. After its expiration, some states extended the policy, while others did not, creating a natural experiment to examine the effects of losing universal access to free meals. By using a triple difference-in-differences model and data from the Stanford Education Data Archive, the Census Household Pulse Survey, and the Common Core of Data, I find that the removal of free meals led to a significant decline in math and reading language arts test scores. These findings not only provide valuable insights into the effects of food security policies on educational outcomes, but also highlight the critical intersection of social and education policy. The results underscore the complementary role that policies aimed at addressing food insecurity play in supporting academic achievement, suggesting that effective education policy cannot be fully realized without addressing the broader social determinants that influence student performance. These findings advocate for a more integrated approach to policymaking, where food security and educational access are seen as complementary tools for student success.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了2022年《让孩子吃饱法案》到期后，取消普遍免费学校午餐对学生考试成绩的影响。研究发现，取消免费午餐导致数学和阅读语言艺术考试成绩显著下降，强调了食品安全政策与教育成果之间的重要联系。
AI.research_question: 取消普遍免费学校午餐政策对学生考试成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2022年《让孩子吃饱法案》到期后，各州政策出现分化，一些州延续了普遍免费学校午餐政策，而另一些州则取消了该政策，这为研究食品不安全对教育成果的影响提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会决定因素理论，特别是食品不安全对认知发展和学业表现的影响理论，探讨教育政策与社会政策之间的互补关系。
AI.method: 采用三重差分模型，结合斯坦福教育数据档案库、人口普查家庭脉搏调查和共同核心数据，分析政策变化对学生考试成绩的影响。
AI.findings: 取消普遍免费学校午餐导致数学和阅读语言艺术考试成绩显著下降，表明食品不安全对学业表现有负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论上证明了食品安全政策与教育政策之间的互补性，强调了社会决定因素在教育成果中的重要作用，为整合社会政策与教育政策的理论框架提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证证据，支持将食品安全政策作为教育政策的重要组成部分，倡导更综合的政策制定方法，将食品安全和教育机会视为促进学生成功的互补工具。

title: Students' User Experience of ChatGPT in Education: Practice, Acceptance, and Attitudes
affiliations: , South Forsyth High School, University of Georgia and The University of Georgia

detail.title: Students' User Experience of ChatGPT in Education: Practice, Acceptance, and Attitudes
detail.abstract: ChatGPT, a large language model developed by OpenAI, has rapidly become a widely used tool in educational contexts, offering students support in writing, language learning, coding, research, and formative feedback. This literature review examines students' experiences with ChatGPT in education, focusing on their usage patterns, attitudes, perceptions of trustworthiness, and concerns around academic integrity. Drawing on 62 peer-reviewed studies published between 2022 and 2025 across K-12 and postsecondary contexts, the review synthesizes how students integrate Chat-GPT into learning, the factors that influence its acceptance, and the ethical, privacy, and equity considerations that emerge. Findings indicate that ChatGPT is primarily used for early-stage learning tasks-such as brainstorming, drafting, editing, and language support-while presenting challenges related to overreliance, accuracy, privacy, and academic integrity. The review highlights the importance of structured task design, process visibility, verification, and clear guidance to maximize learning benefits and minimize risks. By consolidating evidence across diverse settings, this study provides practical insights for educators, institutions, and policymakers on responsible and effective integration of generative AI in learning environments.

AI.tldr: 这篇文献综述分析了2022-2025年间62项同行评议研究，探讨学生在教育中使用ChatGPT的经验，包括使用模式、态度、信任度感知以及学术诚信问题，为教育工作者和政策制定者提供生成式AI在教育中负责任和有效整合的实践见解。
AI.research_question: 学生在教育中使用ChatGPT的经验如何？包括使用模式、态度、信任度感知以及学术诚信问题。
AI.motivation: ChatGPT作为OpenAI开发的大型语言模型，在教育领域迅速成为广泛使用的工具，为学生提供写作、语言学习、编程、研究和形成性反馈支持，需要系统了解学生的使用经验和相关挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献综述基于技术接受模型、学习科学理论和教育伦理框架，分析学生如何整合ChatGPT到学习中，以及影响其接受度的因素。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析了2022-2025年间62项同行评议研究，涵盖K-12和高等教育背景。
AI.findings: ChatGPT主要用于早期学习任务（如头脑风暴、起草、编辑和语言支持），同时存在过度依赖、准确性、隐私和学术诚信等挑战。结构化任务设计、过程可见性、验证和明确指导对于最大化学习效益和最小化风险至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了不同背景下关于学生使用生成式AI经验的证据，为理解技术接受、学习整合和伦理考虑提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者、机构和政策制定者提供实践见解，指导生成式AI在学习环境中的负责任和有效整合，包括任务设计、验证机制和伦理指导原则。

title: Design and Simulation of Hybrid Solar-Wind Standalone Power Generation for Gende Ada Village, Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
affiliations: Woldia University, Mizan-Tepi University, Bahir Dar University Institute of Technology and Debre Tabor University

detail.title: Design and Simulation of Hybrid Solar-Wind Standalone Power Generation for Gende Ada Village, Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
detail.abstract: The aim of this paper is to design and simulate a hybrid solar-wind standalone power generating system with battery storage as a backup to electrify the Gende Ada community, located near Dire Dawa City of Ethiopia. The total population of the village is 300 and has 100 households, one primary school, one church, one Mosque, one health center, and one agricultural center. The daily energy consumption of Gende ada village has been assessed carefully with the help of different appliances that are currently available in the village. The grid extension comparison analysis with the hybrid system has been carried out using homer software. The hybrid system needs $514,641 for total net present cost over the 20-life year horizon. However, the grid extension needs around $9,139,509.2 total capital cost over 20-year life horizon. As a result, it is found that the hybrid system is cost effective for an area which is found at a distance greater than 19.78km (which is the breakeven grid extension distance) from the existing grid found nearby. The selected PV panel provides 131.8kw power without any converters. However, after adding PI based MPPT controller in a boost converter, this panel generates 150kw power. The wind energy generates a pure three phase sinusoidal output voltage, and it is converted into dc voltage value after using ac-dc converter. The hybrid energy system generates 200kw power from the modified solar and wind energy systems, which is used to meet the electrical loads of the Gende ada village. The design model of the thesis is simulated using Simulink MATLAB software.

AI.tldr: 本文为埃塞俄比亚Gende Ada社区设计并模拟了一个混合太阳能-风能独立发电系统，配备电池储能作为备用。研究发现，在距离现有电网19.78公里以上的地区，混合系统比电网扩展更具成本效益。
AI.research_question: 如何为埃塞俄比亚Gende Ada社区设计一个经济有效的混合太阳能-风能独立发电系统，并与电网扩展方案进行成本比较？
AI.motivation: Gende Ada社区（300人口，100户家庭，包含学校、教堂、清真寺、医疗中心和农业中心）缺乏可靠的电力供应，需要为偏远农村社区提供可持续的电力解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可再生能源系统设计理论、混合能源系统优化、成本效益分析理论、电网扩展经济性评估、MPPT（最大功率点跟踪）控制技术。
AI.method: 使用HOMER软件进行系统设计和成本分析，使用MATLAB Simulink进行系统模拟，采用PI基MPPT控制器优化太阳能发电效率，进行电网扩展与混合系统的成本比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 混合系统总净现成本为514,641美元（20年），而电网扩展需要9,139,509.2美元；2. 在距离现有电网19.78公里以上的地区，混合系统更具成本效益；3. 采用MPPT控制器后，太阳能板输出从131.8kW提升至150kW；4. 混合系统总发电能力达到200kW，足以满足社区需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了适用于偏远农村社区的混合可再生能源系统设计方法；2. 建立了电网扩展与混合系统的经济性比较模型；3. 验证了MPPT控制器在提升太阳能发电效率方面的有效性；4. 确定了混合系统相对于电网扩展的成本优势临界距离（19.78公里）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为Gende Ada社区提供了可行的电力解决方案；2. 为类似偏远农村社区的可再生能源系统设计提供了参考；3. 证明了混合太阳能-风能系统在偏远地区的经济可行性；4. 为政策制定者提供了电网扩展与分布式发电的经济决策依据。

title: Towards Tiny Autonomic Computing: Challenges, Enablers, and Open Research Directions
affiliations: Newcastle University, AGH University of Krakow, AGH University of Science and Technology, Newcastle University, Newcastle University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Newcastle University

detail.title: Towards Tiny Autonomic Computing: Challenges, Enablers, and Open Research Directions
detail.abstract: Autonomic Computing (AC) is a foundational paradigm that addresses the growing complexity of modern computing systems by enabling autonomous, self-managing operation. AC has traditionally focused on cloud and middleware environments, where abundant computational and energy resources enable the deployment of complex resource-heavy self-managing control loops. However, the rapid expansion of the Internet of Things exposes a critical gap at the extreme edge, where microcontroller-based devices operate under severe constraints in memory, energy, and compute. This paper examines the convergence of Autonomic Computing and Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) and argues for extending autonomic principles down to resource-constrained IoT end devices. We introduce the concept of Tiny Autonomic Computing (TinyAC) as a lightweight, decentralised realisation of the MAPE-K paradigm tailored to resource-constrained devices. We identify three crucial enablers of autonomy at the extreme edge: E1) TinyML, E2) Observability, and E3) Multi-agent coordination. Rather than proposing new algorithms, our study consolidates fragmented research and highlights fundamental gaps, particularly in benchmarking, tooling, and evaluation of closed-loop autonomy on MCUs. Moreover, we outline a research roadmap for developing scalable, resilient, and energy-aware autonomic systems across the computing  continuum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"微型自主计算"概念，将自主计算原则扩展到资源受限的物联网终端设备，通过TinyML、可观测性和多智能体协调三大使能技术，在极端边缘实现轻量级自主管理。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源极度受限的物联网终端设备（微控制器）上实现自主计算？
AI.motivation: 自主计算传统上关注云和中间件环境，但物联网的快速扩张暴露了极端边缘的空白，微控制器设备在内存、能源和计算方面面临严重限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: MAPE-K范式（监测-分析-规划-执行-知识）的轻量级、去中心化实现；微型自主计算概念；三大使能技术：TinyML、可观测性、多智能体协调。
AI.method: 概念性研究，整合碎片化研究，识别关键差距，而非提出新算法；通过文献综述和概念分析构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 识别了在微控制器上实现闭环自主性的三个关键使能技术，同时发现了在基准测试、工具开发和评估方法方面的根本性差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"微型自主计算"新概念，扩展了自主计算理论到极端边缘环境；建立了资源受限设备自主性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发可扩展、弹性和能源感知的自主系统提供了研究路线图；指出了工具开发和评估方法的具体改进方向。

title: Should AI Tell You How to Do Drugs?  Lessons from Pharmacist Duty and Harm Reduction

detail.title: Should AI Tell You How to Do Drugs?  Lessons from Pharmacist Duty and Harm Reduction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
More than one hundred million Americans took a prescription drug last week.  More than forty million asked ChatGPT a healthcare question today – and seven in ten of those conversations occur outside clinical hours, when no pharmacist or physician was available to intervene if the answer was wrong.  For the underinsured, the rural, the disabled, and anyone too stigmatized to ask a pharmacist about the drugs they are actually taking, AI chatbots are becoming an increasingly attractive source of drug information.  And yet, poor advice from chatbots has already been linked to overdose and death.

What liability framework should govern a technology that simultaneously expands access and creates such acute risk? The answer already exists – not in AI policy, but in four decades of pharmacist duty doctrine. Courts have transformed pharmacist obligations from mechanical dispensing to clinical counseling, imposing duties to warn, refuse dangerous prescriptions, and provide complete information enabling safer use. These principles, refined through cases from Riff v. Morgan Pharmacy to Cottam v. CVS, embed the principles of harm reduction – a public health framework that accepts drug use as a reality and designs interventions to reduce associated harms rather than demanding abstinence as a precondition for engagement.  Yet no scholar has systematically mapped this framework onto AI drug advice.

The stakes cut both ways: the same technology that has been linked to drug overdoses by providing poor contraindication advice also represents the first robust pharmacological resource available at all hours to users who otherwise lack pharmacist access.  Blanket refusal protects companies but abandons those users.  Pervasive surveillance chills the most vulnerable from seeking help at all.  Pharmacist duty doctrine demands a third path: engagement governed by professional judgment, not silence or monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI聊天机器人提供药物建议时应采用的责任框架，主张借鉴药师责任原则，在扩大药物信息获取与降低风险之间找到平衡。
AI.research_question: 对于既能扩大药物信息获取又带来急性风险的AI聊天机器人技术，应采用何种责任框架来监管？
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人已成为越来越受欢迎的药物信息来源，特别是对于未参保者、农村居民、残疾人和因污名化不敢咨询药师的人群。然而，聊天机器人提供的不良建议已与用药过量和死亡事件相关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 药师责任原则（从机械配药到临床咨询的转变，包括警告义务、拒绝危险处方义务、提供完整信息义务）和减害原则（承认药物使用的现实性，设计干预措施减少相关伤害而非要求戒断作为参与前提）。
AI.method: 法律分析，系统性地将药师责任原则框架（通过Riff v. Morgan Pharmacy到Cottam v. CVS等案例发展而来）映射到AI药物建议领域。
AI.findings: 药师责任原则为AI药物建议提供了第三条路径：基于专业判断的参与，而非沉默或监控。该框架既保护公司免于全面拒绝责任，又避免放弃最需要帮助的用户。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将药师责任原则框架应用于AI药物建议领域，填补了学术空白。提出了将减害原则应用于AI健康咨询的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、AI开发者和医疗保健提供者提供了具体的责任框架指导，帮助在扩大药物信息获取与降低风险之间找到平衡，特别是保护弱势群体的健康权益。

title: Disney Launchpad: Presenting to Bob Iger
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business,  and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Disney Launchpad: Presenting to Bob Iger

publicationDetails.detailsText: Darden Case No. UVA-OB-1501
publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
In February 2018, Julie Ann Crommett, vice president of multicultural audience engagement at the Walt Disney Studios (Disney), was preparing to lead a meeting with Bob Iger, head of Disney. She would be pitching Launchpad, her plan to increase diversity among directors and writers at Disney, if not the film industry at large. Crommett had spent significant time developing the initiative and building support for it with other Disney teams, but she needed to decide what data to present, how deep to go with the data she had, and what framing would make Launchpad appealing to Disney's most powerful executives. She had to anticipate questions and avoid "rabbit holes" that would cut into the limited time she had to pitch her idea. Crommett was a confident person, but she couldn't deny that she was nervous about how the meeting might go. How should she prepare?

Excerpt

Disney Launchpad: Presenting to Bob Iger

I hate when someone says play it safe, be careful, don't stand out. That's just ridiculous. There's a way to express yourself, particularly at lower-level positions, so the people have an idea of who you are and what you stand for, without being obnoxious.

—Bob Iger, CEO, the Walt Disney Company (Disney)

In February 2018, Julie Ann Crommett, vice president of multicultural audience engagement at the Walt Disney Studios, was preparing to lead a meeting with “one of the world's most admired chief executives”—Bob Iger, head of Disney. In Crommett's view, Iger carried a lot of influence not only within the company, but across the entertainment industry, which she considered insular in its own way.

Nervously, she thought, “If I flub this…”

Crommett had never met Iger, and while she had been able to learn some about him from colleagues, she'd gotten most of her information from the executive's public persona. It was not lost on her that someone at her level typically did not lead a meeting with Iger. (See Exhibit 1 for an abbreviated Disney organizational hierarchy.)

. . .

AI.tldr: 迪士尼多元文化受众参与副总裁Julie Ann Crommett准备向CEO Bob Iger推介Launchpad计划，旨在提高迪士尼乃至整个电影行业的导演和编剧多样性。她需要精心准备数据呈现方式和说服策略，以争取高层支持。
AI.research_question: 在有限的时间内，如何有效地向高层管理者（如迪士尼CEO Bob Iger）推介一项旨在提高组织多样性的创新计划，以获得批准和支持？
AI.motivation: 电影行业在导演和编剧多样性方面存在不足，迪士尼作为行业领导者有机会引领变革。Crommett作为多元文化受众参与副总裁，认识到提高多样性不仅符合社会价值，也能带来商业利益，但需要获得高层支持才能实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高层管理沟通策略、说服理论、数据驱动的决策制定、组织变革管理、多样性管理理论、权力动态与组织层级
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于真实商业情境分析，包含组织背景、人物角色、决策挑战等要素，通过情境模拟探讨沟通策略
AI.findings: 向高层管理者推介创新计划需要：1）精心选择关键数据点而非全面数据；2）将多样性计划与商业利益（如市场增长、观众需求）直接关联；3）了解决策者的个人价值观和沟通偏好；4）准备应对可能的质疑和"兔子洞"问题；5）在有限时间内清晰传达核心价值主张
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了高层管理沟通中数据呈现策略的理论；2）深化了组织多样性倡议获得高层支持的影响因素研究；3）提出了在权力不对称情境下的有效说服框架；4）丰富了有限时间决策沟通的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为管理者提供了向高层推介创新计划的具体策略指南；2）展示了如何将社会价值主张转化为商业案例；3）提供了应对高层会议紧张情绪和准备不足的实用建议；4）为组织多样性倡议的实施提供了可操作框架

title: The Disintegration of Free Speech
affiliations: Emory University

detail.title: The Disintegration of Free Speech
detail.abstract: Free speech in the United States is facing a crisis. Since President Trump's return to office, the federal government has invoked the rhetoric of restoration while deploying institutional power to discipline disfavored expression. At the same time, the communicative environment has undergone a structural transformation. Social media platforms, increasingly integrated with generative AI systems, now function as the primary sites of public communication. Within this environment, AI-generated pornography and large-scale political misinformation have produced widely documented dignitary and democratic harms. In response, states across the political spectrum have enacted laws aimed at preserving democratic order, curbing AI-mediated harms, and promoting safer online environments. Yet these regulatory efforts run headlong into the Free Speech Clause of the First Amendment. Requirements that platforms remove content, disclose recommendation practices, or redesign moderation systems are readily characterized as compelled speech or as interference with protected editorial judgment. This Article argues that, under prevailing First Amendment doctrine, AI-generated content remains protected speech notwithstanding its harms, and that regulations targeting platform content moderation are likely unconstitutional. Since the 1970s, the Supreme Court has shifted from protecting the free circulation of information to privileging editorial autonomy, understood as control over authorship, expressive identity, and freedom from state attribution. Once content moderation is treated as an exercise of editorial judgment, regulatory mandates that compel or prohibit such practices presumptively violate the Free Speech Clause. The Article concludes that this doctrinal trajectory risks detaching the First Amendment from its democratic purposes and calls for a reconstruction capable of addressing contemporary communicative infrastructures, automated production, and concentrated communicative power.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国言论自由面临的危机：特朗普重新执政后，政府以恢复言论自由为名压制不受欢迎的表达，同时社交媒体与生成式AI融合成为主要公共沟通平台，AI生成的色情内容和政治虚假信息造成严重危害。各州试图通过监管应对，但这些措施与第一修正案冲突，因为AI生成内容被视为受保护的言论，平台内容审核被视为编辑判断，监管可能违宪。最高法院从保护信息自由流通转向保护编辑自主权的趋势，使第一修正案脱离民主目的，需要重建以适应现代传播基础设施。
AI.research_question: 在社交媒体与生成式AI融合的现代传播环境中，针对AI生成有害内容和平台内容审核的监管措施如何与第一修正案的言论自由条款相冲突？
AI.motivation: 美国言论自由面临危机：特朗普政府以恢复言论自由为名压制不受欢迎的表达，同时社交媒体平台与生成式AI系统融合成为主要公共沟通场所，AI生成的色情内容和政治虚假信息造成广泛的人格尊严和民主危害，各州试图通过监管应对，但这些措施与第一修正案冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一修正案言论自由理论，特别是关于编辑自主权、受保护言论范围、国家强制言论、平台内容审核作为编辑判断的理论框架，以及最高法院从保护信息自由流通转向保护编辑自主权的学说演变。
AI.method: 法律学说分析，包括对第一修正案判例的历史演变分析，特别是1970年代以来最高法院判例的演变，以及对当代监管措施与宪法原则冲突的法律论证。
AI.findings: 1. AI生成内容尽管有害，但在现行第一修正案学说下仍被视为受保护的言论；2. 针对平台内容审核的监管措施（如要求移除内容、披露推荐做法、重新设计审核系统）可能违宪，因为它们被视为强制言论或干预受保护的编辑判断；3. 最高法院从保护信息自由流通转向保护编辑自主权的学说演变，使监管面临宪法障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了第一修正案学说从保护信息自由流通向保护编辑自主权的历史转变；2. 论证了平台内容审核应被视为编辑判断的理论基础；3. 指出了当前学说可能使第一修正案脱离其民主目的的理论风险；4. 提出了重建第一修正案理论以适应现代传播基础设施、自动化生产和集中传播权力的理论需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于AI内容监管宪法限制的实践指导；2. 揭示了各州监管措施可能面临的法律挑战；3. 为平台公司提供了内容审核实践的法律保护依据；4. 指出了需要重新构建法律框架以应对AI生成有害内容等现代挑战的实践必要性。

affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and

detail.title: PivotTable Practice Problems

publicationDetails.detailsText: Darden Case No. UVA-QA-0985
publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
In this set of three problem vignettes, the fictional manufacturing company BizCo has hired the reader for their skills in data analysis. Each vignette provides a scenario that BizCo is working through—real estate investment, assessing product performance, and analyzing employee sales performance—alongside an Excel spreadsheet of relevant data. Students will use PivotTables for data analysis to address the problems and questions confronting BizCo in each scenario.Accompanying the problem set are instructional video supplements produced by the authors with Darden Video Production.This set of PivotTable problems is part of a three-part set of data analysis exercises. It may be used independently or in conjunction with two other exercise sets: "Decision Tree Practice Problems" (UVA-QA-0986) and "Optimization Practice Problems" (UVA-QA-0987).

Excerpt

PivotTable Practice Problems

BizCo is a fictional company that manufactures goods such as Gizmos, Whatsits, and Doodads. Imagine that BizCo has hired you for your skills in data analysis. In each of the following problem vignettes, you will be given a scenario that BizCo is working through, alongside some data the company thinks will help you come to a solution. The data are included in the supplemental file “PivotTable Practice Problems (SPREADSHEET)” (QA-0985X).

For each scenario, a PivotTable will be your most helpful tool. Consider why that is; why do these data and these business questions lend themselves to using a PivotTable? In general, what decisions are best suited for a PivotTable? Additionally, you are being given only the raw data; consider what cleaning may be necessary to get more actionable insights.

Read through each problem, conduct the appropriate analysis, and think about what recommendations you would provide to the BizCo team. For further guidance, see the instructional video supplements in Exhibit 1.

Profitable Properties

While BizCo primarily focuses on manufacturing goods, its conglomerate also has an arm focused on real estate. What started as a team intent on finding locations for new factories became a profit center for flipping properties. The team identifies properties that are expected to appreciate in value, buys them, then later sells them to fund R&D in Gizmo production.

. . .

AI.tldr: 这是一套关于数据分析和PivotTable应用的实践问题集，包含三个商业场景：房地产投资、产品绩效评估和员工销售绩效分析，旨在帮助学生掌握使用Excel PivotTable进行商业数据分析的技能。
AI.research_question: 如何有效使用PivotTable工具解决BizCo公司在房地产投资、产品绩效评估和员工销售绩效分析中的具体商业问题？
AI.motivation: 商业环境中数据分析和决策支持能力的重要性日益凸显，学生需要掌握实用的数据分析工具来解决实际商业问题。PivotTable作为Excel中强大的数据分析工具，能够帮助管理者从复杂数据中提取洞察，做出更明智的决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商业数据分析框架，强调数据清洗、数据聚合和可视化分析的重要性。结合决策支持系统和商业智能的理论，通过PivotTable实现数据的多维分析和动态汇总。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，通过三个虚构的商业场景（房地产投资、产品绩效评估、员工销售绩效分析），提供Excel数据表格，要求学生使用PivotTable进行数据分析，并制作教学视频作为补充指导。
AI.findings: 通过实践练习，学生能够掌握PivotTable的核心功能，包括数据汇总、筛选、分组和可视化，学会识别适合使用PivotTable分析的商业决策场景，并理解数据清洗对获得可操作洞察的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据分析理论与实际商业应用相结合，提供了PivotTable在商业决策中的具体应用框架，强调了数据驱动决策的教学方法，丰富了商业数据分析教育的内容体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接用于教学的实践问题集，包含真实商业场景和配套数据，帮助学生培养实际数据分析能力。教学视频补充增强了学习效果，问题集可独立使用或与其他数据分析练习（决策树、优化问题）结合，形成完整的数据分析课程体系。

title: Toward Decision Behavior Governance: Governance Existence, Invocation, and Decision Formation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Toward Decision Behavior Governance: Governance Existence, Invocation, and Decision Formation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract: Current AI governance and compliance frameworks-including ISO/IEC 42001-largely conceptualize governance targets in terms of systems, models, or development processes. However, in the era of foundation models deployed via commercial APIs, organizations no longer possess control over model internals, versioning, or training dynamics. This loss of model sovereignty severs the traditional proxy relationship between system compliance and behavioral accountability. This paper argues that AI governance must be fundamentally reoriented toward Decision Behavior-the dynamic process through which an AI agent synthesizes premises, applies constraints, and forms outcomes with organizational impact. We propose Decision Behavior Governance as a conceptual framework that distinguishes governance existence from governance invocation, and decomposes governed behavior into three institutional elements: decision premises, execution manner, and governance evidence. By clarifying the conditions under which governance exists, becomes valid, and remains auditable, this paper provides a principled path for organizations to reclaim Evidence Sovereignty in the absence of model control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"决策行为治理"框架，认为在基础模型通过API部署的时代，传统基于系统/模型的AI治理已失效，应将治理重点转向AI代理的决策行为过程，以在缺乏模型控制权的情况下重获证据主权。
AI.research_question: 在组织失去对基础模型内部、版本和训练动态控制权的情况下，如何重新构建有效的AI治理框架以确保行为问责？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理框架（如ISO/IEC 42001）主要针对系统、模型或开发过程，但在基础模型通过商业API部署的时代，组织失去了模型主权，传统系统合规与行为问责之间的代理关系被切断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策行为治理框架，区分治理存在与治理调用，将治理行为分解为三个制度要素：决策前提、执行方式和治理证据。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，通过理论分析提出决策行为治理的概念框架，阐明治理存在、生效和可审计的条件。
AI.findings: 提出了决策行为治理框架，为组织在缺乏模型控制的情况下重获证据主权提供了原则性路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从系统/模型治理转向决策行为治理的理论转向；2. 提出治理存在与治理调用的区分；3. 建立决策前提、执行方式、治理证据的三要素分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在API部署的基础模型环境中提供可操作的治理框架，帮助组织在失去模型控制权的情况下建立有效的问责机制和证据收集体系。

title: Unsupervised Discovery of Market Regimes Using Static and Temporal Models
affiliations: Maastricht University

detail.title: Unsupervised Discovery of Market Regimes Using Static and Temporal Models
detail.abstract: Identifying market regimes is critical for financial risk management, yet traditional methods often rely on rigid, predefined labels. This study explores an unsupervised approach to regime discovery by comparing static clustering (Gaussian Mixture Models) with temporal modeling (Hidden Markov Models) using weekly S&P 500 returns, VIX levels, and Treasury yield spreads from 1995 to 2024. The models are evaluated across four pillars: stability, agreement, interpretability, and robustness. Our results demonstrate that while both architectures successfully identify economically meaningful states (Calm, Transitional, and Stressful), the HMM produces significantly more persistent regimes (~50-week average) compared to the GMM (~8-week average). We find that market stress regimes are the most robustly identified features across models. This research highlights the trade-off between model reactivity and signal stability, concluding that market regimes are inherently model-dependent latent structures rather than objective ground truths.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了静态聚类（高斯混合模型）与时序建模（隐马尔可夫模型）在识别市场状态方面的表现，发现两种方法都能识别出经济意义明确的状态（平静、过渡、压力），但HMM产生的状态持续时间更长（约50周），而GMM的状态更短暂（约8周）。市场压力状态是所有模型中最稳健识别的特征。
AI.research_question: 如何通过无监督学习方法识别金融市场状态？静态聚类（GMM）与时序建模（HMM）在状态识别方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 市场状态识别对金融风险管理至关重要，但传统方法通常依赖僵化的预定义标签，需要探索更灵活的无监督学习方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无监督学习理论，比较静态聚类模型（高斯混合模型）和时序模型（隐马尔可夫模型）在市场状态识别中的应用。
AI.method: 使用1995-2024年标普500周收益率、VIX水平和国债收益率利差数据，对比GMM和HMM两种方法，从稳定性、一致性、可解释性和稳健性四个维度评估模型表现。
AI.findings: 两种模型都能识别出经济意义明确的状态（平静、过渡、压力），但HMM产生的状态更持久（平均约50周），GMM的状态更短暂（平均约8周）。市场压力状态是所有模型中最稳健识别的特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场状态是模型依赖的潜在结构而非客观事实，强调了模型反应性与信号稳定性之间的权衡，为无监督市场状态识别提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了选择市场状态识别方法的指导：需要快速反应时选择GMM，需要稳定信号时选择HMM。压力状态的稳健识别有助于风险管理决策。

title: The State Origin of Obedience
affiliations: Duke University, Peking University and

detail.title: The State Origin of Obedience
detail.abstract: What are the historical origins of obedience to power? We propose and test the hypothesis that prolonged exposure to centralized statehood has culturally ingrained a greater acceptance of hierarchical power. Analyzing global survey data, we demonstrate that individuals in countries with a longer and more centralized state history exhibit stronger norms of obedience, both in the family and the workplace. We establish causality through instrumental variable strategies, analysis of second-generation immigrants, and a natural experiment arising from the dissolution of the Soviet Union. Further evidence shows that this historical legacy is embedded in cultural artifacts such as folklore and language, yet its influence is mitigated by free access to information on the internet. Our findings identify the state as a key architect of a persistent cultural trait that shapes modern life.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一个假设：长期接触中央集权国家历史会文化性地内化对等级权力的更大接受度。通过全球调查数据分析，发现国家历史越长、中央集权程度越高的个体，在家庭和工作场所表现出更强的服从规范。研究使用工具变量、二代移民分析和苏联解体的自然实验建立因果关系，并发现这种历史遗产嵌入在民间传说和语言等文化载体中，但互联网信息自由获取会削弱其影响。
AI.research_question: 服从权力的历史起源是什么？长期接触中央集权国家历史是否文化性地内化了对等级权力的更大接受度？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么不同社会对权威和等级制度的接受程度存在差异，探索国家历史如何塑造持久的文化特征，特别是服从规范的形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家形成理论、文化演化理论、制度持久性理论，强调中央集权国家作为文化规范的塑造者，通过长期历史过程内化服从价值观。
AI.method: 1. 全球调查数据分析（跨国比较）；2. 工具变量策略建立因果关系；3. 二代移民分析控制当代制度影响；4. 苏联解体的自然实验；5. 文化载体分析（民间传说、语言）；6. 互联网信息获取的调节效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. 国家历史越长、中央集权程度越高的国家，个体在家庭和工作场所的服从规范越强；2. 因果关系得到确认：历史中央集权导致服从文化；3. 这种历史遗产嵌入在民间传说和语言中；4. 互联网信息自由获取会削弱历史服从规范的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将国家视为持久文化特征的关键塑造者；2. 建立了国家历史与服从规范之间的因果机制；3. 展示了文化载体如何传递历史遗产；4. 提出了信息环境对历史遗产影响的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解不同社会的权威接受度差异提供历史视角；2. 为政策制定者理解文化变革的路径依赖提供参考；3. 表明信息自由可能削弱历史形成的服从文化；4. 为跨国企业管理中的文化差异提供解释框架。

title: Supply Chain, Distribution, and Channel Strategy in Alpha Packaging Solutions: An Emerging Market Perspective

detail.title: Supply Chain, Distribution, and Channel Strategy in Alpha Packaging Solutions: An Emerging Market Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript is an original work derived from the author’s independent research. All data were collected ethically, analysed rigorously, and reported honestly. The manuscript is not under review with any other journal.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines supply chain design, distribution strategy, and channel management practices in Alpha Packaging Solutions (APS), an emerging-market packaging manufacturer serving FMCG, pharmaceutical, and industrial clients. Drawing on established frameworksincluding Fisher's supply chain typology, Porter's value chain, the SCOR model, and marketing channel theory-the study analyzes how APS aligns operational efficiency with customer responsiveness in a highly competitive and price-sensitive environment. Using a qualitative casebased approach, the research highlights the role of efficient supply chain architecture, dualchannel distribution, and relationship-based customer management in achieving sustainable competitive advantage. The findings demonstrate that classical supply chain theories remain highly relevant when contextualized within emerging economies, particularly for functional products characterized by stable demand and long life cycles. Managerial and policy implications are discussed, with recommendations focusing on digital integration, sustainability, and channel performance optimization.

title: Luxury Fashion Branding: Consumer Engagement and Market Dynamics

detail.title: Luxury Fashion Branding: Consumer Engagement and Market Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper deals with the research question of the redefinition of consumer engagement in the context of luxury fashion branding as digital space interferes with conventional concepts of exclusivity, status and value generation. As luxury companies traditionally used the means of controlled scarcity and heritage signaling, there is a growing trend among shifting customer behaviors toward increased engagement, co-creation, and emotional attachment in the online arena (Oliveira and Fernandes 392). The systematic literature review of the recent scholarship on the topic of luxury branding and consumer engagement, which the study uses as a methodological procedure, is further augmented by an analytical framework that incorporates digital touchpoints, brand narratives, and community dynamics (Xiao and Chen 188). It has been shown that among the set of influencers that have been previously identified, including social media presence, influencer marketing, etc., less expected elements, especially narrative branding, online brand communities, and the use of digital avatars in virtual worlds, are a key to keeping the engagement, as well as maintaining the perceived luxury (Kapferer and Bastien 74). These create the effect of symbolic immersion, peer-to-peer communication, and identity exploration that transform the relationship between the consumers and the luxury brands (Hollebeek et al. 161). The paper concludes that consumer engagement does not only serve luxury brand equity but it actually re-frames the dynamics of the luxury market by repositioning power to the digitally empowered consumer. As a result, luxury brands should be able to strategically strike a balance between exclusivity and participatory online experiences to stay culturally and economically viable (Ko and Megehee 146).

title:
Space Reduction and Representability of Relational Feasibility 
A Short Note on Factorization under Recognition Maps
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Space Reduction and Representability of Relational Feasibility 
A Short Note on Factorization under Recognition Maps

publicationDetails.detailsText: Preprint available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18323291

detail.abstract: Relations are mediated not by objective positions but by recognized categories. When recognition coarsens the position space through a non-injective map ρ : L → Σ, certain relational feasibility patterns cannot be faithfully represented. We prove a factorization theorem: an objective feasibility pattern R * is representable on the recognition space Σ if and only if it is constant on ρ-fibers. Under space reduction, failure of this condition necessarily yields pseudocohesion or pseudo-fragmentation at the level of recognized relations. This result complements the author's prior axiomatic theory: whereas that work established structural impossibility at the objective level, the present note isolates a representation-theoretic source of distortion that arises independently of objective constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了一个因子分解定理：客观可行性模式R*在识别空间Σ上可表示的充要条件是它在ρ-纤维上恒定。当空间缩减时，不满足该条件必然导致识别关系层面的伪凝聚或伪碎片化。
AI.research_question: 在识别过程将位置空间粗化的情况下，哪些客观关系可行性模式能够在识别空间中被忠实表示？
AI.motivation: 关系不是由客观位置而是由识别范畴来中介的。当识别通过非单射映射ρ:L→Σ粗化位置空间时，某些关系可行性模式无法被忠实表示。需要理解这种表示失真的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于识别理论和社会分类理论，探讨位置空间到识别空间的映射如何影响关系模式的表示。使用数学框架分析ρ-纤维上的恒定条件。
AI.method: 理论证明方法，通过数学定理证明因子分解定理：客观可行性模式R*在识别空间Σ上可表示当且仅当它在ρ-纤维上恒定。
AI.findings: 证明了一个关键定理：客观可行性模式在识别空间上可表示的充要条件是在ρ-纤维上恒定。当空间缩减时，不满足该条件必然导致伪凝聚或伪碎片化现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了识别过程中关系表示的理论框架；2. 证明了因子分解定理，明确了可表示性的数学条件；3. 识别了独立于客观约束的表示失真来源，补充了作者之前的公理化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解社会分类、组织识别和群体关系中的失真现象提供了理论工具，有助于分析识别过程如何影响关系模式的感知和表示。

title: The Impossibility of Cohesion Without Fragmentation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impossibility of Cohesion Without Fragmentation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Preprint available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18322989

detail.abstract: Why do division and cohesion so often intensify together? This paper provides a structural answer by developing a static theory of relation maintenance based on minimal positional constraints. We model social relations as subject to minimum conditions defined over an abstract position space. A bifurcation event-such as a vote, declaration, or institutional assignment-fixes agents' positions and thereby determines which relations are compatible. Within this framework, we identify position-dependent gain axes as the key structural source of selective relational survival. The main result establishes a structural necessity: for any bifurcation event under a non-degenerate positional constraint, the post-event network necessarily exhibits either the simultaneous emergence of fragmentation and cohesion, or degenerate triviality. In the non-degenerate case, fragmentation and cohesion are not merely correlated, but arise as dual consequences of the same positional constraint. The analysis is purely structural. It abstracts from preferences, beliefs, incentives, and dynamic adjustment, and relies on no probabilistic or behavioral assumptions. By isolating the minimal conditions under which division and cohesion must be understood as coexisting and relative phenomena, the framework provides a common structural language for the analysis of polarized networks, institutional sorting, and identity-based alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于最小位置约束的关系维持静态理论，解释了为什么分裂与凝聚常常同时加剧。通过将社会关系建模为抽象位置空间中的最小条件，研究发现分裂事件会固定个体位置，从而决定哪些关系可以共存。关键发现是：在任何非退化位置约束下的分裂事件后，网络必然同时出现分裂与凝聚，两者是同一位置约束的双重结果。
AI.research_question: 为什么社会网络中的分裂与凝聚常常同时加剧？在什么结构条件下分裂与凝聚必然共存？
AI.motivation: 观察到社会网络、政治极化、制度分类等现象中分裂与凝聚常常同时出现，需要解释这一看似矛盾的现象背后的结构机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最小位置约束的关系维持静态理论，将社会关系建模为抽象位置空间中的最小条件，引入分裂事件（投票、声明、制度分配等）固定个体位置的概念。
AI.method: 纯结构分析方法，建立形式化理论模型，抽象掉偏好、信念、激励和动态调整，不依赖概率或行为假设，识别位置依赖的增益轴作为关系选择生存的关键结构来源。
AI.findings: 主要结果确立了结构必然性：在任何非退化位置约束下的分裂事件后，后事件网络必然同时出现分裂与凝聚，或退化为平凡情况。在非退化情况下，分裂与凝聚不仅是相关的，而且是同一位置约束的双重结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了分裂与凝聚同时加剧的结构解释；2. 建立了理解分裂与凝聚作为共存和相对现象的最小条件框架；3. 为分析极化网络、制度分类和身份对齐提供了共同的结构语言。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解政治极化、社会分裂等现象的结构基础；2. 为制度设计和网络分析提供理论工具；3. 为理解身份认同和社会分类提供新的分析视角。

detail.abstract:
The two sides of the coin, business and Government ownership, give rise to governance issues within Indian government companies. This paper discusses the legal Framework that may govern such entities as existing in the Companies Act, 2013. It examines such persistent governance shortcomings as the problem of board structure, lack of independence, political burden, and ineffective accountability behavior. This paper discusses landmark judicial pronouncements, insolvency cases involving government companies, and regulatory reforms, employing a doctrinal analysis methodology and a case study approach. 
The study reveals that state-owned enterprises, particularly when governance systems are weak, may be vulnerable to weak influence despite legislative changes that impact the efficiency of enterprise stakeholders. Among the key discoveries, one can mention the fact that there will always be some tension between the goals of a government's policy and the viability of commercial activity, which actually leads to the emergence of governance issues. The study concludes by providing recommendations on how the role of the independent director may be enhanced, with a focus on promoting more transparent practices and striking a balance between the ideals of corporate governance and the concept of public interest. The discussion has contributed to the knowledge of the linkage between corporate law, administrative law, and insolvency systems in state-owned enterprises.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了印度政府公司的治理问题，分析了商业与政府所有权双重性带来的治理挑战，包括董事会结构问题、独立性缺乏、政治负担和问责制失效等，并提出通过增强独立董事角色来改善治理的建议。
AI.research_question: 印度政府公司在商业与政府所有权双重性下存在哪些治理问题？如何通过法律框架和治理机制解决这些问题？
AI.motivation: 印度政府公司面临独特的治理挑战，因为其同时受到商业目标和政府政策目标的双重影响，这种"硬币的两面"特性导致治理结构复杂化，需要深入研究其法律框架和实际治理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、政府所有权理论、代理理论、利益相关者理论，以及公司法律框架与行政法的交叉领域理论。
AI.method: 采用教义分析法（doctrinal analysis）和案例研究法，分析《2013年公司法》相关条款、标志性司法判例、涉及政府公司的破产案例以及监管改革措施。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）政府政策目标与商业可行性之间存在固有张力；2）治理系统薄弱使国有企业易受不当影响；3）董事会结构问题、独立性缺乏、政治负担和问责制失效是主要治理缺陷；4）立法改革对利益相关者效率影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）深化了对公司法律、行政法律和破产制度在国有企业中相互关联的理解；2）揭示了政府所有权与商业目标之间的理论张力；3）为混合所有制企业的治理理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）提出增强独立董事角色的具体建议；2）倡导更透明的治理实践；3）提供平衡公司治理理想与公共利益概念的方法；4）为政策制定者和监管机构提供改革参考。

detail.title: Institutional Pressure, Lawfare and Strategic Stability in the Aegean Maritime Environment

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the role of institutional pressure, legal ambiguity and lawfare mechanisms in shaping strategic stability in the Aegean maritime environment. Rather than focusing on overt military confrontation, the analysis explores how administrative practices, regulatory processes and the prolonged use of legal instruments operate below the threshold of armed conflict, gradually influencing strategic outcomes.

The study emphasizes the distinction between de jure legal frameworks and de facto operational realities, highlighting how duration, repetition and institutional normalization can contribute to the erosion of the status quo without formal legal revision. Particular attention is given to the role of international maritime institutions, legal regimes and third-party actors as indirect arbiters of legitimacy.

The paper argues that strategic stability in the Aegean depends less on episodic crises and more on sustained legal coherence, institutional engagement and the avoidance of tacit acquiescence in practices that incrementally reshape the operational environment.

This paper is a scholarly and analytical work. It does not represent the official positions of any government, institution, or organization. All interpretations are offered exclusively for academic and policy-analysis purposes.

detail.abstract:
In this set of three problem vignettes, the fictional manufacturing company BizCo has hired the reader for their skills in data analysis. Each vignette provides a scenario that BizCo is working through—evaluating product mix, comparing vender costs, and assessing expansion proposals—alongside an Excel spreadsheet of relevant data. Students will use Excel Solver for data analysis to address the problems and questions confronting BizCo in each scenario.Accompanying the problem set are instructional video supplements produced by the authors with Darden Video Production.This set of optimization problems is part of a three-part set of data analysis exercises. It may be used independently or in conjunction with two other exercise sets: "PivotTable Practice Problems" (UVA-QA-0985) and "Decision Tree Practice Problems" (UVA-QA-0986).

Excerpt

Optimization Practice Problems

BizCo is a fictional company that manufactures goods such as Gizmos, Whatsits, and Doodads. Imagine that BizCo has hired you for your skills in data analysis. In each of the following vignettes, you will be given a scenario that BizCo is working through, alongside some data the company thinks will help you come to a solution. These data are included in the supplemental spreadsheet “Optimization Practice Problems (SPREADSHEET)” (UVA-QA-0987).

For each scenario, Excel Solver will be your most helpful tool. Consider why that is; why do these data and these business questions lend themselves to using Solver? In general, what decisions are best suited for Solver? Additionally, note that you may need to make new fields or rearrange the data to best enable your analysis.

Read through each problem, conduct appropriate analysis, and think about what recommendations you would provide to the BizCo team. For further guidance, see the instructional video supplements in Exhibit 1.

Gizmos and Whatsits and Doodads, Oh My!

BizCo manufactures a wide array of exceptional products for its adoring customers. Of course, as any operations student knows, tricky things like capacity and customer demand can get in the way of just making whatever you want. As such, BizCo has asked you to evaluate its product mix.

. . .
