title: Measuring Economic Outlook in the News
affiliations: Swiss National Bank, , ETH Zurich, Swiss National Bank and Swiss National Bank

detail.title: Measuring Economic Outlook in the News

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 04/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss National Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a resource-efficient methodology for measuring economic outlook in news text that combines document embeddings with synthetic training data generated by large language models. Applied to 27 million news articles, the resulting indicator significantly improves GDP growth forecast accuracy and captures sentiment shifts weeks before official releases, proving particularly valuable during crises. The indicator outperforms both survey-based benchmarks and traditional dictionary methods and is interpretable, allowing identification of specific drivers of economic sentiment. Our approach addresses key institutional constraints: it performs sentiment classification locally, enabling analyses of proprietary news content without transmission to external services while requiring minimal computational resources compared to direct large language model classification.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种资源高效的方法，通过结合文档嵌入和大型语言模型生成的合成训练数据来测量新闻文本中的经济前景。应用于2700万篇新闻文章，所得指标显著提高了GDP增长预测准确性，并在官方发布前数周捕捉到情绪变化，在危机期间特别有价值。该指标优于基于调查的基准和传统词典方法，且具有可解释性，能够识别经济情绪的具体驱动因素。该方法解决了关键制度约束：在本地执行情绪分类，无需传输到外部服务即可分析专有新闻内容，同时与直接使用大型语言模型分类相比需要最少的计算资源。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种资源高效的方法来测量新闻文本中的经济前景，以提高GDP增长预测准确性并捕捉早期情绪变化？
AI.motivation: 传统经济预测方法存在局限性：调查基准成本高且滞后，词典方法不够精确，直接使用大型语言模型分类需要大量计算资源且涉及数据隐私问题。需要一种既能准确预测经济趋势，又能在资源受限环境下运行，同时保护专有数据隐私的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合自然语言处理（NLP）中的文档嵌入技术和大型语言模型（LLM）的合成数据生成能力，构建经济情绪测量框架。利用迁移学习思想，通过少量高质量合成数据训练轻量级分类器。
AI.method: 开发了一种结合文档嵌入和LLM生成合成训练数据的方法：1）使用LLM生成标注好的合成训练数据；2）提取文档嵌入特征；3）训练轻量级本地分类器；4）应用于2700万篇新闻文章构建经济前景指标。
AI.findings: 1）所得指标显著提高GDP增长预测准确性；2）在官方数据发布前数周就能捕捉到情绪变化；3）在危机期间特别有价值；4）优于调查基准和传统词典方法；5）具有可解释性，能识别具体驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了结合文档嵌入和LLM合成数据的资源高效情绪分析方法论；2）发展了在制度约束下进行专有文本分析的理论框架；3）为经济预测中的NLP应用提供了新的技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了可本地部署的经济情绪测量工具；2）降低了计算资源需求；3）保护了专有数据隐私；4）为政策制定者和企业提供了更及时的经济预测工具；5）方法具有可扩展性，可应用于其他领域。

title: Brief of Amicus Curiae Professor Steven L. Schooner in Support of Petitioners' Petition for Certiorari in King v. United States (U.S. Supreme Court)
affiliations: George Washington University - Law School, George Washington University, George Washington University, George Washington University - Law School, George Washington University - Law School,  and George Washington University - Law School

detail.title: Brief of Amicus Curiae Professor Steven L. Schooner in Support of Petitioners' Petition for Certiorari in King v. United States (U.S. Supreme Court)

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-16
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-16
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This is an amicus brief in support of a U.S. Supreme Court petition for certiorari in King v. United States (No. 25-856), in which GW Law School's GW Law’s Administrative Law, Issues, and Appeals Clinic represented government contracts expert, GW Law Professor Steven L. Schooner). Petitioners—retired UPS employees William King, Stephen Dardzinski, and the Estate of Anthony Gugliuzza (on behalf of a class of retirees and pension beneficiaries)—challenge the Federal Circuit’s novel “underlying assets” test (created in reviewing a matter initially decided in the U.S. Court of Federal Claims), which withholds per se Takings Clause protection for vested rights to payment unless the claimant also owns the assets used to pay. The brief explains how that rule unnecessarily departs from Supreme Court precedent and deepens a pre-existing circuit split. It also warns that the rule invites retroactive abrogation of contractual obligations and, in turn, could force contractors into an arbitrary regulatory-takings framework that yields only de minimis relief.

This brief was prepared by the team of GW Law students Eric Frank, Giovanna Milano, Matt Novotny, Tegan Oliver, and Kaci Waguespack, under the supervision of Professor Aram Gavoor, through GW Law School’s Administrative Law, Issues, and Appeals Clinic.

AI.tldr: 这是一份支持美国最高法院调卷令的法庭之友意见书，挑战联邦巡回法院创造的"基础资产"测试，该测试要求征收条款保护必须同时拥有支付权利和用于支付的资产。
AI.research_question: 联邦巡回法院创造的"基础资产"测试是否符合最高法院先例，以及该测试对合同权利和征收条款保护的潜在影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 联邦巡回法院创造的"基础资产"测试偏离了最高法院先例，加深了巡回法院之间的分歧，可能允许追溯性废除合同义务，并将承包商置于任意的监管征收框架中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国宪法第五修正案的征收条款、合同权利保护、监管征收理论、司法先例原则。
AI.method: 法律分析和论证，包括案例法分析、先例比较、政策影响评估，以法庭之友意见书形式呈现。
AI.findings: "基础资产"测试与最高法院先例不符，加深了巡回法院分歧，可能允许追溯性废除合同义务，并将承包商置于仅提供微不足道救济的监管征收框架中。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清征收条款对既得支付权利的保护范围，强调所有权与支付权利分离情况下的宪法保护，维护合同权利的稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院提供法律分析支持，保护退休人员和养老金受益人的合同权利，防止政府追溯性废除合同义务，维护承包商的法律确定性。

title: Leverage Impact on Firms' Investment Decision -A Study of Indian Steel Companies'
affiliations: Kalyani University

detail.title: Leverage Impact on Firms' Investment Decision -A Study of Indian Steel Companies'
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of leverage on the investment decisions of firms, focusing on a comparative analysis between Indian public and private sector steel companies. Using a panel dataset spanning 15 (from 2008 to 2023) years, the analysis employs descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and panel data regression models to uncover significant relationships. The findings reveal that public sector firms exhibit higher leverage ratios and larger capital expenditures (CapEx), supported by government-backed financial structures. In contrast, private sector firms demonstrate higher profitability and financial efficiency, despite their relatively lower investment levels. Leverage negatively impacts CapEx in both sectors, with the effect being more pronounced in private firms due to stricter financial constraints and a higher cost of capital. Profitability and firm size positively influence investment decisions, highlighting the importance of operational performance and economies of scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了印度公共和私营钢铁企业的杠杆对投资决策的影响。研究发现，公共部门企业杠杆率更高、资本支出更大，但私营部门企业盈利能力和财务效率更高。杠杆对两个部门的资本支出都有负面影响，对私营企业影响更显著。
AI.research_question: 杠杆如何影响印度公共和私营钢铁企业的投资决策？两个部门在杠杆与投资关系方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解不同所有制结构下企业杠杆与投资决策的关系，为政策制定者和企业管理者提供关于资本结构优化和投资策略的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构理论（权衡理论、优序融资理论）、投资决策理论、企业所有制理论（公共vs私营企业差异）
AI.method: 使用2008-2023年15年的面板数据，采用描述性统计、相关性分析和面板数据回归模型进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 公共部门企业杠杆率更高、资本支出更大（政府支持）；2. 私营部门企业盈利能力和财务效率更高；3. 杠杆对两个部门的资本支出都有负面影响，对私营企业影响更显著；4. 盈利能力和企业规模对投资决策有正向影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了资本结构理论在发展中国家不同所有制企业的应用；2. 揭示了所有制结构在杠杆-投资关系中的调节作用；3. 为新兴市场企业融资约束研究提供新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为公共部门企业优化资本结构提供参考；2. 帮助私营企业管理者理解杠杆对投资的约束效应；3. 为政策制定者设计差异化融资支持政策提供依据；4. 指导投资者评估不同所有制企业的投资风险

title: The Virtue of Transparency in Sports Analytics: An Application to NFL Quarterbacks
affiliations: State Street Corporate, Cambridge Sports Analytics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and State Street Associates

detail.title: The Virtue of Transparency in Sports Analytics: An Application to NFL Quarterbacks

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Sloan Research Paper No. 7358-26
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: A model-based approach to prediction, such as a regression model or a machine learning model, estimates parameters from a sample of observations and applies those parameters uniformly across all prediction tasks. These approaches fail to consider the unique circumstances of individual prediction tasks, and they conceal the influence of observations and predictive variables on individual predictions. Additionally, model-based approaches to prediction offer no guidance about the reliability of individual predictions. We describe a novel model-free prediction system called relevance-based prediction (RBP) that overcomes these limitations, and we show how it enables prediction-specific transparency that is beyond the reach of model-based approaches. RBP reveals the specific reliability of each prediction before the prediction is made, the importance of each prior player to each prediction, the contribution of each predictive variable to each prediction's value, and the contribution of each predictive variable to each prediction's reliability. We illustrate this new prediction system by applying it to predict passing yards per game for NFL quarterbacks. The prediction-specific information given by RBP stands in contrast to R-squared, t-statistics, and beta which only give information about average effects, as we illustrate with specific player examples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于相关性的预测系统（RBP），克服了传统模型预测方法的局限性，能够为每个具体预测任务提供个性化的透明度和可靠性评估。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种预测系统，能够克服传统模型预测方法的局限性，为每个具体预测任务提供个性化的透明度、可靠性评估和影响因素分析？
AI.motivation: 传统基于模型的预测方法（如回归模型、机器学习模型）存在三个主要问题：1）使用统一参数，不考虑个体预测任务的独特性；2）隐藏了观测值和预测变量对个体预测的影响；3）无法提供个体预测的可靠性指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相关性的预测（RBP）理论框架，强调预测任务的个体差异性和透明度需求，区别于传统模型预测的"一刀切"方法。
AI.method: 开发并应用基于相关性的预测系统（RBP），以NFL四分卫每场比赛传球码数预测为例进行实证说明。
AI.findings: RBP系统能够为每个预测提供：1）预测前的具体可靠性评估；2）每个先前球员对每个预测的重要性；3）每个预测变量对预测值的贡献；4）每个预测变量对预测可靠性的贡献。这些信息超越了R平方、t统计量和β系数等仅提供平均效应的传统指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了模型无关的预测系统理论框架，强调预测任务的个体差异性和透明度，为预测科学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际预测任务提供了更透明、更可靠的工具，特别适用于需要理解个体预测背后驱动因素的场景，如体育表现预测、金融风险评估等。

title: Labor Futures Under Artificial Intelligence: Scenarios for the Philippine Economy
affiliations: CirroLytix Research Services

detail.title: Labor Futures Under Artificial Intelligence: Scenarios for the Philippine Economy
detail.abstract:
Rapid advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping the nature of work worldwide, yet their labor market implications remain highly uncertain and context-dependent. This paper examines the likely impacts of AI on labor in the Philippines through a prognostic, scenario-based approach that moves beyond deterministic forecasts. Drawing on three complementary evidence bases—task-level evidence on what generative AI can already do in practice, occupational exposure and complementarity analysis using Philippine labor force data, and firm- and worker-level evidence on AI adoption—the study develops an integrated framework linking AI capabilities, occupational structure, and institutional mediation.

The analysis shows that while a significant share of Philippine employment is exposed to AI—particularly in service-sector and BPO-related occupations—most exposed jobs also exhibit high complementarity, suggesting substantial scope for augmentation rather than immediate displacement. Observed adoption patterns to date are cautious, with limited job loss but growing task reconfiguration and emerging skills gaps. Building on these findings, the paper develops three policy-contingent labor market scenarios for the period 2025–2035: an Augmented Services Economy characterized by inclusive productivity gains, a Dual-Speed Labor Market marked by polarization and uneven adjustment, and a Disruptive Automation Shock involving significant displacement and social strain.

The paper argues that AI’s labor market impacts in the Philippines are not technologically predetermined. Instead, outcomes will depend on policy choices related to skills development, governance, social protection, and innovation. The Philippines faces a narrow but real window to steer AI adoption toward inclusive upgrading rather than disruptive adjustment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过情景分析方法研究生成式AI对菲律宾劳动力市场的影响，发现虽然许多工作岗位面临AI暴露风险，但多数具有高度互补性，可能实现增强而非替代。研究基于任务能力、职业暴露和采用模式证据，提出三种政策依赖的未来情景，强调政策选择对AI影响的决定性作用。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能对菲律宾劳动力市场将产生何种影响？这些影响如何受到政策选择的调节？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在全球范围内重塑工作性质，但其劳动力市场影响仍高度不确定且依赖具体情境。菲律宾作为服务导向型经济体，特别需要理解AI对其劳动力市场的潜在影响，以制定适当的政策应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合框架连接AI能力、职业结构和制度调节，超越确定性预测，采用情景分析方法。结合任务层面的AI能力证据、职业暴露与互补性分析、以及企业和工人层面的AI采用证据。
AI.method: 采用预后性、情景导向的方法，结合三个互补证据基础：1)任务层面AI实际能力证据；2)使用菲律宾劳动力数据的职业暴露与互补性分析；3)企业和工人层面的AI采用证据。
AI.findings: 菲律宾大量就业岗位面临AI暴露风险（特别是服务业和业务流程外包相关职业），但大多数暴露岗位也表现出高度互补性，表明存在增强而非立即替代的潜力。当前采用模式谨慎，有限的工作流失但任务重构增加和技能差距显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接AI能力、职业结构和制度调节的整合分析框架；发展了超越技术决定论的情景分析方法；强调了政策选择在塑造AI劳动力市场影响中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政策制定者提供了三种政策依赖的劳动力市场情景（2025-2035年）：增强型服务经济、双速劳动力市场、破坏性自动化冲击；识别了技能发展、治理、社会保护和创新等关键政策领域；强调了菲律宾引导AI采用走向包容性升级而非破坏性调整的有限但真实的窗口期。

title: A Comment on "Estimating Large-Scale Tree Logit Models"
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School

detail.title: A Comment on "Estimating Large-Scale Tree Logit Models"
detail.abstract: Jagabathula et al. (2024) propose a scalable algorithm for estimating large-scale tree logit models and illustrate their approach using a "SUSHI" data exercise. This exercise generates millions of transactions by repeatedly drawing random offer sets and deterministically assigning each individual the highest-ranked available item (or no-purchase) from survey-based preference orderings. This comment focuses on interpretation rather than computation. I show that the deterministic rankings-to-choices mapping makes conditional choice almost deterministic and, under random assortments, creates a long-tail pattern in which many products are offered frequently but chosen rarely. A binary logit example clarifies the core mechanism: determinism pushes logit estimation into a boundary regime in which the utility differences become extreme and weakly identified, and in the high-dimensional SUSHI construction, this manifests as nearseparation-style imbalance (rarely chosen yet frequently offered items). In contrast, the tree logit model can match the same near-determinism primarily through scaled indices-by pushing dissimilarity parameters toward their lower bound, thereby making implied conditional log-odds large-without requiring comparably extreme dispersion in leaf-level utilities. I therefore argue that the reported likelihood advantages in the SUSHI exercise are best viewed as evidence of performance under a semi-synthetic stress test, rather than as direct validation that the model captures real-world correlations better in transactional choice data.

AI.tldr: 该评论指出Jagabathula等人(2024)的SUSHI数据练习中，确定性排名到选择的映射导致条件选择几乎确定，在随机产品组合下产生长尾模式，使逻辑回归估计进入边界状态，而树逻辑模型通过相似性参数匹配这种确定性，因此报告的可能性优势应视为半合成压力测试下的表现，而非模型在真实交易数据中捕捉相关性的直接验证。
AI.research_question: 如何正确解释Jagabathula等人(2024)在SUSHI数据练习中报告的树逻辑模型似然优势？这些优势是否真正表明模型能更好地捕捉真实世界交易选择数据中的相关性？
AI.motivation: Jagabathula等人(2024)提出了可扩展的树逻辑模型估计算法，并使用SUSHI数据练习展示其方法。该评论旨在澄清该练习中确定性排名到选择的映射对模型估计的影响，避免对模型性能的误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散选择模型理论，特别是树逻辑模型和标准逻辑回归模型；确定性选择映射对模型估计的影响；边界估计问题和弱识别问题；长尾分布模式在模拟数据中的形成机制。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念论证：1) 分析SUSHI数据练习中确定性排名到选择的映射如何导致条件选择几乎确定；2) 展示在随机产品组合下如何产生长尾模式；3) 通过二元逻辑回归示例说明确定性如何将估计推向边界状态；4) 对比树逻辑模型如何通过相似性参数匹配这种确定性。
AI.findings: 1) SUSHI数据练习中的确定性映射使条件选择几乎确定，在随机产品组合下产生"频繁提供但很少选择"的长尾模式；2) 这种确定性将逻辑回归估计推向边界状态，效用差异变得极端且弱识别；3) 树逻辑模型可以通过将相似性参数推向下限来匹配相同的近确定性，而不需要叶级效用有可比较的极端离散；4) 因此，报告的似然优势应视为半合成压力测试下的表现，而非模型在真实交易数据中捕捉相关性的直接验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 阐明了确定性排名到选择映射对离散选择模型估计的影响机制；2) 区分了树逻辑模型和标准逻辑回归在匹配确定性模式时的不同机制；3) 提出了对模拟数据练习结果解释的谨慎框架，强调区分压力测试表现和真实世界相关性捕捉能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒研究人员在解释模拟数据练习结果时需要谨慎，特别是当数据生成过程包含确定性元素时；2) 为评估离散选择模型性能提供了更细致的视角，强调需要考虑数据生成过程的特性；3) 帮助实践者正确理解树逻辑模型在特定条件下的优势及其局限性。

title: When Perishables Go Online: The Impact on Waste, Welfare, and Profit
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Operations Research Center and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: When Perishables Go Online: The Impact on Waste, Welfare, and Profit

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Sloan Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Reducing food waste, particularly at the downstream stages of the supply chain, has become a global priority. At the same time, online grocery shopping has expanded rapidly. This raises an important question: how does the adoption of online grocery shopping influence food waste at the consumer and retail levels? To address this question, we develop a bi-level optimization framework in which the lower level captures consumers’ repeat-purchase decisions and the upper level models the retailer’s inventory management problem. A key methodological contribution is endogenizing consumers’ purchase behavior in a perishable setting, translating their decisions into the stochastic demand faced by the retailer. To this end, we characterize an asymptotically optimal base-stock policy for the retailer that captures the essential system dynamics while remaining analytically tractable. Our results show that online grocery adoption can reduce waste at both the consumer and retail levels, provided it targets the “right” consumers and products; specifically, it can enable more frequent replenishment by reducing the fixed cost of purchasing relative to in-store trips, with larger gains for products with lower perishability and consumption rates. We also identify substantial overlap between regions where waste declines and consumer welfare and retailer profitability increase, yielding a triple-win outcome. Empirical calibrations using U.S. retail data confirm that lowering the fixed cost of purchase is the primary moderator; notably, a 9-15% reduction in delivery fees can unlock this triple-win across all states in our analysis. This alignment underscores the potential of online grocery to simultaneously enhance environmental sustainability and economic efficiency.

AI.tldr: 在线杂货购物通过降低购买固定成本，使消费者能更频繁补货，从而减少消费者和零售层面的食物浪费，同时提升消费者福利和零售商利润，实现三重共赢。
AI.research_question: 在线杂货购物的采用如何影响消费者和零售层面的食物浪费？
AI.motivation: 减少食物浪费已成为全球优先事项，特别是在供应链下游阶段。同时，在线杂货购物迅速扩张，需要研究其对食物浪费的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层优化框架：下层捕捉消费者重复购买决策，上层建模零售商库存管理问题。内生消费者在易腐品环境中的购买行为，将其决策转化为零售商面临的随机需求。
AI.method: 开发双层优化模型，为零售商表征渐近最优的基础库存政策，捕捉系统动态同时保持分析可处理性。使用美国零售数据进行实证校准。
AI.findings: 在线杂货采用可以减少消费者和零售层面的浪费，前提是瞄准"正确"的消费者和产品。通过降低相对于实体店购物的购买固定成本，实现更频繁补货，对低易腐性和低消费率产品效果更显著。浪费减少、消费者福利和零售商利润增加的区域有大量重叠，形成三重共赢。降低购买固定成本是主要调节因素，配送费降低9-15%可在所有州实现三重共赢。
AI.theory_contributions: 方法学贡献：在易腐品环境中内生消费者购买行为，将其决策转化为零售商面临的随机需求。为零售商开发渐近最优的基础库存政策，捕捉系统动态同时保持分析可处理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别在线杂货减少浪费的条件：瞄准合适消费者和产品。发现降低配送费（9-15%）是实现三重共赢的关键杠杆。为零售商和政策制定者提供具体策略，通过在线杂货同时提升环境可持续性和经济效益。

title: The Trilemma, Macroprudential Policy, and Monetary Spillovers

authors.last_name: Institute for Monetary and Financial Research

affiliations: (HKIMR)

detail.title: The Trilemma, Macroprudential Policy, and Monetary Spillovers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 20/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Haiqin Liu (Fudan University).

Using hand-dated country policy events and daily firm-level equity returns, I estimate how capital controls, exchange rate regimes, and macroprudential policy moderate spillovers from monetary shocks by the Fed, ECB, and BoE. Exploiting an event-study design around precisely dated domestic policy changes, I show that for conventional monetary policy shocks, tightening capital controls or adopting a more flexible exchange rate regime attenuates negative equity spillovers. This is in support of the classic Trilemma. For quantitative easing (QE) shocks, exchange rate flexibility amplifies positive spillovers. Conversely, capital controls and macroprudential policy tightening can mitigate spillovers from QE. Interestingly, what distinguishes macroprudential tools from capital controls is that, as QE purchase sizes scale up, macroprudential tools remain effective whereas the absorptive capacity of capital controls wanes. These results underscore the central role of balance sheet and risk premium channels in the international transmission of QE. Simulations from a stylized two-country collateral model deliver consistent predictions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过事件研究法分析资本管制、汇率制度和宏观审慎政策如何调节美联储、欧央行和英央行货币政策冲击的国际溢出效应。研究发现，对于传统货币政策冲击，收紧资本管制或采用更灵活的汇率制度能减弱负面的股票溢出效应，支持"三元悖论"。对于量化宽松冲击，汇率灵活性会放大正面溢出效应，而资本管制和宏观审慎政策收紧能缓解QE溢出效应。宏观审慎工具与资本管制的区别在于，随着QE规模扩大，宏观审慎工具仍然有效，而资本管制的吸收能力会减弱。
AI.research_question: 资本管制、汇率制度和宏观审慎政策如何调节主要央行（美联储、欧央行、英央行）货币政策冲击的国际溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 在全球金融一体化背景下，主要央行的货币政策变化会产生显著的跨国溢出效应，影响其他国家的金融市场稳定。理解不同政策工具如何调节这些溢出效应对于各国政策制定者设计有效的政策组合具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"三元悖论"理论框架，结合资产负债表渠道和风险溢价渠道来解释量化宽松的国际传导机制。使用简化的两国抵押品模型进行理论预测。
AI.method: 采用事件研究设计，利用手工收集的国家政策事件日期和每日公司层面股票回报数据，围绕精确日期的国内政策变化进行分析。
AI.findings:
1. 对于传统货币政策冲击：收紧资本管制或采用更灵活的汇率制度能减弱负面的股票溢出效应，支持"三元悖论"。
2. 对于量化宽松冲击：汇率灵活性会放大正面溢出效应；资本管制和宏观审慎政策收紧能缓解QE溢出效应。
3. 宏观审慎工具与资本管制的区别：随着QE规模扩大，宏观审慎工具仍然有效，而资本管制的吸收能力会减弱。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了"三元悖论"在传统货币政策冲击下的适用性。
2. 揭示了资产负债表渠道和风险溢价渠道在量化宽松国际传导中的核心作用。
3. 区分了宏观审慎工具与资本管制在应对大规模QE冲击时的不同效果。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了针对不同类型货币政策冲击的差异化政策工具组合建议。
2. 强调了宏观审慎政策在应对大规模量化宽松冲击时的独特优势。
3. 为各国在全球化背景下设计有效的金融稳定政策框架提供了实证依据。

title: Does Mediation Deliver Justice? The Perspective of Unrepresented Parties
affiliations: University of Strathclyde – Law School

detail.title: Does Mediation Deliver Justice? The Perspective of Unrepresented Parties

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was granted by Queen Margaret University's Ethics Committee
declarations.funderStatement: The research was partially funded by a doctoral research grant from Queen Margaret University

detail.abstract: This study examines the justice thinking of unrepresented people who have taken part in mediation. The context is two mediation services, serving Scotland’s two largest courts, from which the twenty four participants were referred to mediation by a judge (known as a sheriff) in the course of a small claim. The study addresses a notable gap in the literature on mediation: the modest attention paid to parties’ perspectives on substantive justice (see Chapter 1.C and 3.C. below). Its aim was to provide a richer understanding of the thinking of mediation participants charged by the justice system with devising an outcome to their disputes, in particular their evaluations of the fairness and justice of that outcome. It finds that those without legal training can nonetheless apply justice principles in resolving their disputes; this can be described as “justice outside the law.” They were able to account for their decisions in terms recognisable to those operating the justice system: the encounter (replicating the day in court), the chance to tell their story, compensation, punishment of bad behaviour, closure and payment. However, their lack of formal legal knowledge can lead to injustice and the study highlights the key role of activist mediators in providing legal information when required. Despite having forged the terms of their settlements, most participants were ambivalent when asked “Did you get justice?” The study notes several reasons. First, they are decision makers who are also decision recipients, meaning the other party, their legal opponent, has a say in the outcome. Secondly, they want to do, and be seen to do, justice. Thirdly, they also want to receive justice (and not injustice), yet often have to compromise and settle for “good enough” (see Chapters 5 and 6, below). And finally they have little interest in applying, still less in creating, legal norms. I conclude that mediation can deliver justice but not law.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了无法律代表的调解参与者的正义思维，发现他们虽无法律训练但仍能运用正义原则解决纠纷，形成"法律之外的正义"。参与者能使用司法系统可识别的理由解释决定，但缺乏法律知识可能导致不公，且多数人对"是否获得正义"持矛盾态度。
AI.research_question: 无法律代表的调解参与者如何理解和评估调解结果的公平性与正义性？他们如何运用正义原则解决纠纷？
AI.motivation: 填补调解文献中对当事人实质性正义视角关注不足的空白，深入了解被司法系统委托解决纠纷的调解参与者的正义思维。
AI.theoretical_framework: "法律之外的正义"概念、实质性正义理论、调解参与者的正义认知框架、司法系统与民间正义思维的对比。
AI.method: 质性研究，从苏格兰两大法院的调解服务中选取24名被法官（治安官）转介至调解的无法律代表的小额索赔案件参与者进行研究。
AI.findings: 1. 无法律训练者仍能运用正义原则解决纠纷，形成"法律之外的正义"；2. 参与者使用司法系统可识别的理由解释决定：庭审体验、讲述故事机会、补偿、惩罚不良行为、结案和付款；3. 缺乏法律知识可能导致不公，积极调解员在提供法律信息方面起关键作用；4. 多数参与者对"是否获得正义"持矛盾态度，原因包括：双方共同决定结果、希望实现正义、需要妥协接受"足够好"的结果、对法律规范不感兴趣。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"法律之外的正义"概念，丰富了调解理论和实质性正义理论，揭示了民间正义思维与正式法律系统的互动关系，拓展了对调解参与者认知框架的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调解实践提供指导：1. 强调调解员在提供法律信息方面的重要作用；2. 帮助理解调解参与者的正义评估标准；3. 为司法系统设计更有效的调解机制提供依据；4. 促进对"足够好"解决方案的接受度管理。

title: Impact of AI-Powered Digital Channels on Customer Satisfaction in the Saudi Public Social Insurance Sector
affiliations: Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) Researcher

detail.title: Impact of AI-Powered Digital Channels on Customer Satisfaction in the Saudi Public Social Insurance Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Doctor of Business Administration (DBA). The author declares no other known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants included in the study. The opening section of the electronic questionnaire clearly outlined the research objectives, guaranteed the anonymity of respondents, and confirmed that participation was voluntary. Completion of the survey was taken as consent to participate.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper is based on the author's DBA thesis, 'Impact of AI-powered digital channels on Customer Satisfaction in Saudi Public Social Insurance Sector', available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18316239

detail.abstract: Objective: This study measures the impact of AI-powered digital channelsspecifically examining dimensions of ease of use, responsiveness, helpfulness of AI, and reliability-on customer satisfaction within the public social insurance sector in Saudi Arabia. It further explores the relationship between user satisfaction and future behavioral intentions, including word-of-mouth promotion and continued engagement. Methodology: A descriptive analytical approach was employed, utilizing an electronic questionnaire distributed to a random sample of social insurance beneficiaries, yielding 406 valid responses. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS and AMOS, including Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to test hypotheses. Results: The findings reveal a high level of customer satisfaction with AI-powered channels. All four quality dimensions-ease of use, responsiveness, helpfulness of AI, and reliability-demonstrated a positive and statistically significant impact on customer satisfaction. Furthermore, satisfaction positively influenced users' future behavioral intentions. Implications: The study recommends continued investment in AI usability and reliability, alongside targeted awareness programs to enhance beneficiary trust. It provides a framework for public sector entities to assess AI effectiveness in service delivery.

AI.tldr: 本研究测量了AI驱动的数字渠道（易用性、响应性、AI帮助性和可靠性）对沙特阿拉伯公共社会保险部门客户满意度的影响，并探讨了满意度与未来行为意图（口碑推广和持续参与）之间的关系。研究发现四个质量维度均对满意度有显著正向影响，满意度也正向影响未来行为意图。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的数字渠道（包括易用性、响应性、AI帮助性和可靠性）如何影响沙特阿拉伯公共社会保险部门的客户满意度？客户满意度又如何影响未来的行为意图（如口碑推广和持续参与）？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在公共服务领域的广泛应用，需要评估AI驱动的数字渠道在公共社会保险部门中的有效性，了解这些渠道如何影响客户满意度，以及满意度如何转化为未来的行为意图，从而为公共服务数字化转型提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于服务质量理论和技术接受模型，研究构建了AI渠道质量维度（易用性、响应性、AI帮助性、可靠性）→客户满意度→未来行为意图（口碑推广、持续参与）的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用描述性分析方法，通过电子问卷对沙特社会保险受益人进行随机抽样调查，收集了406份有效问卷。使用SPSS和AMOS进行统计分析，包括结构方程模型（SEM）来检验假设。
AI.findings: 研究发现客户对AI驱动的渠道满意度较高。四个质量维度（易用性、响应性、AI帮助性、可靠性）都对客户满意度有显著的正向影响。此外，客户满意度也正向影响用户的未来行为意图。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了服务质量理论在AI驱动的公共服务领域的应用，验证了AI渠道质量维度对满意度的作用机制，并建立了满意度与未来行为意图之间的理论联系，为公共服务数字化转型提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议继续投资于AI的可用性和可靠性，同时开展有针对性的意识提升计划以增强受益人的信任。为公共部门实体评估AI在服务交付中的有效性提供了实用框架，有助于优化公共服务数字化转型策略。

title: Operational AI Governance and the Runtime Decision Ownership Gap
affiliations: Independent Researcher and Independent Researcher

detail.title: Operational AI Governance and the Runtime Decision Ownership Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects research requiring formal ethics committee approval. The analysis is based on practitioner discussions conducted in a professional capacity and publicly available secondary sources. No personal, sensitive, or identifiable data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence systems transition from analytical tools to operational decision delegates, governance frameworks have not evolved at the same pace as real-world usage. Existing approaches emphasize model correctness, policy compliance, and system integrity, but provide limited visibility into how humans actually interact with AI at runtime. This report presents qualitative validation evidence indicating a systemic governance gap: organizations can increasingly reconstruct what AI systems did, yet cannot reliably demonstrate who owned decisions at the moment of execution or whether meaningful human judgment was exercised. Drawing on cross-industry practitioner perspectives and market-level evidence from Indian enterprises, the analysis identifies human behavioral drift-not technical failure-as the dominant cause of governance breakdown. The findings suggest the need for a distinct operational governance layer focused on preserving, observing, and evidencing human decision ownership in AI-assisted workflows.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出AI系统从分析工具转变为运营决策代理时，治理框架未能跟上实际使用步伐。研究发现组织能重建AI系统做了什么，但无法可靠证明执行时谁拥有决策权或是否行使了有意义的人类判断。人类行为漂移（而非技术故障）是治理失效的主要原因，需要建立专注于保存、观察和证明人类决策所有权的运营治理层。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统从分析工具转变为运营决策代理时，现有治理框架如何应对人类与AI在运行时的实际互动？组织能否可靠证明执行时谁拥有决策权以及是否行使了有意义的人类判断？
AI.motivation: AI系统正从分析工具转变为运营决策代理，但治理框架未能跟上实际使用步伐。现有方法强调模型正确性、政策合规性和系统完整性，但对人类如何在实际运行时与AI互动缺乏可见性，存在系统性治理缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理框架、人类-AI协作理论、决策所有权理论、运营治理理论、行为漂移概念
AI.method: 定性验证证据分析，结合跨行业从业者视角和印度企业的市场层面证据
AI.findings: 1. 组织能重建AI系统做了什么，但无法可靠证明执行时谁拥有决策权或是否行使了有意义的人类判断；2. 人类行为漂移（而非技术故障）是治理失效的主要原因；3. 存在系统性治理缺口
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了AI治理中的系统性缺口：决策所有权和人类判断的可证明性；2. 提出了人类行为漂移作为治理失效的主要理论解释；3. 论证了需要专门的运营治理层来补充现有治理框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供了识别AI治理风险的框架；2. 建议建立专注于保存、观察和证明人类决策所有权的运营治理层；3. 基于印度企业的实证证据为跨行业实践提供参考

title: Global Arbitrage under Settlement Cycle Mismatch

authors.last_name: Institute for Monetary and Financial Research

affiliations: (HKIMR)

detail.title: Global Arbitrage under Settlement Cycle Mismatch

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 19/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Yuet Ning Chau (Hong Kong University of Science and Technology).

I provide the first causal evidence that settlement cycle mismatch across jurisdictions disrupt arbitrage mechanisms. Using the US transition to T+1 settlement as a quasi-natural experiment, I find that arbitrage activity significantly declines for US ETFs tracking foreign assets. This decline increases tracking error and reduces liquidity for these ETFs. The effects spill over, impacting other ETFs that share the same arbitrageurs and reducing liquidity in the underlying foreign assets. These findings underscore the economic costs of uncoordinated settlement cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了跨司法管辖区结算周期不匹配破坏套利机制因果证据。利用美国向T+1结算过渡作为准自然实验，发现跟踪外国资产的美国ETF套利活动显著下降，导致跟踪误差增加、流动性降低，并产生溢出效应影响其他ETF和基础外国资产流动性。
AI.research_question: 跨司法管辖区的结算周期不匹配如何影响套利机制、ETF跟踪误差和流动性？
AI.motivation: 不同司法管辖区采用不同的证券结算周期（如T+2 vs T+1），这种不匹配可能破坏跨境套利机制，但缺乏因果证据。美国向T+1结算过渡提供了研究这一问题的独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套利理论、市场微观结构理论、结算周期理论、跨境金融摩擦理论
AI.method: 利用美国向T+1结算过渡作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）分析跟踪外国资产的美国ETF套利活动变化，并检验对跟踪误差、流动性及溢出效应的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 套利活动显著下降：跟踪外国资产的美国ETF套利活动减少
2. 跟踪误差增加：ETF与其基础资产之间的价格偏离增大
3. 流动性降低：受影响ETF的流动性下降
4. 溢出效应：影响共享套利商的其他ETF，并降低基础外国资产流动性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次提供跨司法管辖区结算周期不匹配破坏套利机制的因果证据
2. 拓展了结算周期理论在跨境金融环境中的应用
3. 深化了对金融摩擦如何影响市场效率的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为监管机构协调全球结算周期提供实证依据
2. 帮助市场参与者理解结算周期不匹配的风险
3. 为ETF发行商和投资者提供风险管理参考

title:
The Adaptive Signaling Economy
An Ethological Theory of Human Economic Behavior
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Adaptive Signaling Economy
An Ethological Theory of Human Economic Behavior
detail.abstract:
LStandard economic theory models individuals as rational agents maximizing utility under constraints. While behavioral economics has introduced psychological deviations from rationality, it still largely abstracts from the evolutionary origins of economic behavior.

This paper proposes a unifying framework, The Adaptive Signaling Economy (ASE), grounded in ethology and evolutionary biology. We argue that a substantial share of human economic behavior is best understood as adaptive signaling, inherited from animal social systems, where economic actions primarily function to signal status, fitness, trustworthiness, and group membership rather than to maximize material payoff alone.

By integrating animal signaling theory, evolutionary stable strategies, and economic choice, we formalize a model in which markets operate as signaling arenas. The framework explains persistent economic anomalies such as conspicuous consumption, unpaid labor, excessive competition, speculative behavior, and reputation-driven markets. The theory generates testable predictions that diverge from both neoclassical and standard behavioral models, offering a biologically grounded foundation for economic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"适应性信号经济"框架，将人类经济行为理解为源自动物社会系统的适应性信号传递，而非单纯物质利益最大化。
AI.research_question: 如何从进化生物学角度理解人类经济行为，特别是那些偏离理性选择模型的经济现象？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学将个体视为理性效用最大化者，行为经济学虽然引入了心理偏差，但仍未充分考虑经济行为的进化起源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动物信号理论、进化稳定策略、经济选择理论的整合框架。
AI.method: 提出理论框架并形式化模型，将市场视为信号竞技场，解释经济异常现象。
AI.findings: 框架能够解释炫耀性消费、无偿劳动、过度竞争、投机行为和声誉驱动市场等经济异常现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济分析提供了生物学基础，提出了与古典经济学和行为经济学不同的可检验预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实经济现象提供了新的分析视角，有助于政策制定和市场设计。

title: Family Structures and Women's Empowerment in Islamic Societies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Family Structures and Women's Empowerment in Islamic Societies
detail.abstract: Over the past five years, there has been a growing body of research on women's empowerment in Islamic societies, with increasing emphasis on family structures as evolving social systems rather than fixed cultural institutions. This survey paper reviews interdisciplinary literature published between 2020 and 2025, examining how different family arrangements-extended, nuclear, and single-parent households-shape women's access to education, employment, decision-making power, and social participation. Drawing on scholarship from sociology, gender studies, development economics, and anthropology, the paper analyzes how family dynamics interact with legal frameworks, economic pressures, religious interpretations, and generational change, particularly among Generation Z. The review highlights policy-relevant and practical implications for development practitioners, civil society organizations, and community leaders seeking to promote women's empowerment in culturally grounded and sustainable ways.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文回顾了2020-2025年间关于伊斯兰社会中女性赋权的研究，特别关注不同家庭结构（扩展家庭、核心家庭、单亲家庭）如何影响女性在教育、就业、决策权和社会参与方面的机会。论文分析了家庭动态与法律框架、经济压力、宗教解释和代际变迁（特别是Z世代）的相互作用。
AI.research_question: 在伊斯兰社会中，不同的家庭结构（扩展家庭、核心家庭、单亲家庭）如何塑造女性在教育、就业、决策权和社会参与方面的机会？家庭动态如何与法律框架、经济压力、宗教解释和代际变迁相互作用影响女性赋权？
AI.motivation: 过去五年，关于伊斯兰社会中女性赋权的研究日益增多，但缺乏对家庭结构作为动态社会系统而非固定文化制度的系统性分析。需要理解不同家庭安排如何影响女性赋权，为政策制定者和实践者提供基于文化背景的可持续解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 家庭系统理论：将家庭视为动态社会系统而非固定制度
2. 女性赋权理论：关注教育、就业、决策权和社会参与四个维度
3. 交叉性理论：考虑性别、宗教、经济、法律和代际因素的相互作用
4. 文化适应理论：在伊斯兰文化背景下理解社会变迁
AI.method: 文献综述法：系统回顾2020-2025年间跨学科文献，涵盖社会学、性别研究、发展经济学和人类学领域。分析不同家庭结构对女性赋权的影响，以及家庭动态与法律、经济、宗教和代际因素的相互作用。
AI.findings:
1. 不同家庭结构对女性赋权有显著差异影响：扩展家庭可能提供支持但也限制自主性；核心家庭可能增加女性决策权但减少社会网络；单亲家庭面临经济挑战但可能增强独立性
2. 家庭动态与法律框架的相互作用：伊斯兰家庭法与现代化法律体系的冲突与协调
3. 经济压力推动家庭结构变迁，进而影响女性就业和教育机会
4. 宗教解释的多样性：保守与进步解释对女性角色的不同影响
5. Z世代推动代际变迁：年轻一代对性别角色和家庭规范的重新定义
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将家庭概念化为动态社会系统而非固定文化制度
2. 建立了家庭结构与女性赋权四个维度的分析框架
3. 提出了伊斯兰社会中家庭动态与多重因素（法律、经济、宗教、代际）相互作用的整合模型
4. 为跨文化女性赋权研究提供了伊斯兰社会特定背景的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为发展实践者提供基于文化背景的女性赋权策略
2. 为民间社会组织设计针对性干预措施提供指导
3. 为社区领袖促进可持续社会变革提供实践建议
4. 为政策制定者设计支持不同家庭结构的包容性政策提供依据

title: Work-Related Burnout in Judicial Institutions: Organizational, Institutional, and Human Implications

detail.title: Work-Related Burnout in Judicial Institutions: Organizational, Institutional, and Human Implications
detail.abstract: Work-related burnout has become a critical concern in contemporary judicial institutions, with implications that extend beyond individual well-being to organizational functioning and institutional legitimacy. This article examines burnout as a multidimensional and systemic phenomenon arising from sustained imbalances between job demands and available resources in judicial work. Drawing on established organizational behavior frameworks and empirical research, the study analyzes the organizational, psychosocial, and individual antecedents of burnout among judicial professionals. It further explores the consequences of burnout at multiple levels, including employee health and motivation, the effectiveness and internal climate of judicial organizations, and public trust in justice institutions. The article concludes by discussing integrated prevention and intervention strategies, emphasizing the importance of organizational design, supportive work environments, and ins tuitional commitment to employee well-being. Addressing burnout is framed not as an individual coping issue, but as a strategic investment in the quality, resilience, and long-term performance of judicial instituitions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨司法机构中的工作倦怠现象，将其视为多维系统性现象，源于工作要求与可用资源之间的持续失衡。研究分析了司法专业人员倦怠的组织、心理社会和个人前因，探讨了多层面后果，并提出了综合预防干预策略。
AI.research_question: 司法机构中工作倦怠的多维系统性现象如何产生？其组织、心理社会和个人前因是什么？对员工健康、组织效能和司法公信力有何影响？如何有效预防和干预？
AI.motivation: 工作倦怠已成为当代司法机构的关键问题，不仅影响个人福祉，还涉及组织功能和制度合法性。需要系统研究这一现象，以维护司法机构的长期绩效和公信力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织行为学框架，特别是工作要求-资源模型，将倦怠视为工作要求与可用资源之间持续失衡的结果。采用多维系统性视角分析组织、心理社会和个人层面的因素。
AI.method: 结合既有组织行为学框架和实证研究，对司法专业人员倦怠的前因后果进行综合分析。可能包括文献综述、案例研究或实证数据分析。
AI.findings: 司法机构倦怠源于工作要求与资源的持续失衡，具有组织、心理社会和个人多重前因。后果包括员工健康受损、动机下降、组织效能降低、内部氛围恶化，以及公众对司法机构的信任减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将倦怠概念化为司法机构中的多维系统性现象，扩展了工作要求-资源模型在司法领域的应用。强调倦怠不仅是个人问题，更是组织设计和制度承诺的战略问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出综合预防干预策略，强调组织设计、支持性工作环境和机构对员工福祉的承诺。将解决倦怠问题定位为对司法机构质量、韧性和长期绩效的战略投资。

title: Deep Learning-Based Fault Detection and Ride-Through Enhancement Techniques in Wind Farm Power Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Deep Learning-Based Fault Detection and Ride-Through Enhancement Techniques in Wind Farm Power Systems
detail.abstract: The rapid integration of wind energy into modern power systems has introduced significant challenges related to fault detection, transient stability, and grid code compliance. As wind farms increasingly rely on power electronic interfaces, traditional protection and control methods struggle to respond effectively to complex and fast-evolving fault conditions. This study investigates deep learning-based fault detection and ride-through enhancement techniques for wind farm power systems, with a focus on improving low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) performance under diverse grid disturbances. A unified framework is developed that integrates convolutional neural network-based fault classification with intelligent ride-through control strategies. The methodology leverages multi-source operational data and evaluates performance across multiple fault scenarios. Results demonstrate notable improvements in fault detection accuracy, response speed, voltage recovery, and transient stability compared to conventional and shallow learning approaches. Unexpectedly, the deep learning models exhibit strong generalization even under compound fault conditions, highlighting their robustness. The findings suggest that deep learning-driven protection and control can play a pivotal role in enabling reliable, resilient, and grid-compliant wind power integration. The study concludes by outlining future research directions and practical implications for next-generation wind farm protection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于深度学习的风电场故障检测与低电压穿越增强技术，开发了集成卷积神经网络故障分类与智能穿越控制策略的统一框架，显著提升了故障检测精度、响应速度和电压恢复性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习技术提升风电场电力系统的故障检测能力和低电压穿越性能？
AI.motivation: 随着风电大规模并网，电力电子接口的广泛应用使传统保护控制方法难以应对复杂快速变化的故障条件，需要新的技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论、卷积神经网络、智能控制策略、低电压穿越技术、电力系统保护理论。
AI.method: 开发了集成卷积神经网络故障分类与智能穿越控制策略的统一框架，利用多源运行数据，在多种故障场景下评估性能。
AI.findings: 深度学习方法在故障检测精度、响应速度、电压恢复和暂态稳定性方面显著优于传统和浅层学习方法，且在复合故障条件下表现出良好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了深度学习驱动的风电场保护控制统一框架，验证了深度学习在复杂电力系统故障检测中的理论优势，为智能电网保护提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风电场提供了更可靠的故障检测和穿越控制解决方案，有助于提升电网兼容性和风电并网可靠性，为下一代风电场保护系统设计提供了实践指导。

title: Intelligent Protection Schemes for Grid-Connected Wind Farms Using CNN-Based Fault Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Intelligent Protection Schemes for Grid-Connected Wind Farms Using CNN-Based Fault Classification
detail.abstract: The increasing penetration of grid-connected wind farms has significantly altered the dynamic behavior of modern power systems, introducing new challenges for conventional protection schemes (Kandil, Harris, and Das). Traditional relay-based protection methods often struggle under conditions of fluctuating generation, low fault currents, and inverter-dominated responses (Bhalja et al.). This study proposes an intelligent protection scheme for grid-connected wind farms using convolutional neural network (CNN)-based fault classification to enhance detection accuracy and response speed (Dilmi et al.). Voltage and current signals obtained from numerical relays are processed and used to train a deep CNN model capable of identifying multiple fault types under diverse operating conditions (Mokhtari et al.). The results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves higher classification accuracy and improved robustness during low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) events compared to conventional techniques (Ali et al.). The findings confirm that CNN-based protection frameworks can significantly improve grid resiliency and reliability in renewable-rich power systems (Abu Sarhan).

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的智能保护方案，用于电网连接的风电场，以提高故障分类的准确性和响应速度，相比传统保护方法在低电压穿越(LVRT)事件中表现更优。
AI.research_question: 如何利用卷积神经网络(CNN)技术提高电网连接风电场的故障检测准确性和响应速度？
AI.motivation: 电网连接风电场的普及改变了现代电力系统的动态行为，传统继电保护方法在波动发电、低故障电流和逆变器主导响应等条件下表现不佳，需要更智能的保护方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络(CNN)在信号处理和模式识别中的应用；电力系统保护理论；故障检测与分类理论。
AI.method: 使用数值继电器获取电压和电流信号，处理和训练深度CNN模型，识别多种故障类型在不同运行条件下的特征。
AI.findings: 提出的CNN方法相比传统技术具有更高的分类准确性和鲁棒性，特别是在低电压穿越(LVRT)事件中表现优异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将深度学习特别是CNN技术应用于电力系统保护领域，为可再生能源丰富的电力系统提供新的智能保护理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实际可部署的智能保护方案，能够提高电网连接风电场的故障检测准确性和响应速度，增强电网的弹性和可靠性。

title: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks for Real-Time Fault Detection in Renewable Energy Power Generation Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks for Real-Time Fault Detection in Renewable Energy Power Generation Systems
detail.abstract: The rapid global transition toward renewable energy has intensified the need for reliable, intelligent, and real-time fault detection mechanisms to ensure system stability and operational efficiency. Renewable energy power generation systems, including wind farms, solar photovoltaic installations, and microgrids, are inherently complex and exposed to diverse environmental and operational uncertainties. Traditional fault detection approaches, largely based on rule-based logic and signal processing techniques, often struggle to cope with nonlinearity, noise, and high-dimensional data generated by modern energy systems (Kandil et al.; Negi et al.). This study examines the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for real-time fault detection in renewable energy power generation systems. By synthesizing recent empirical research across multiple renewable domains, this work analyzes CNN architectures, data modalities, and deployment strategies that enable accurate and timely fault diagnosis. The findings indicate that CNN-based approaches consistently outperform conventional and shallow machine learning methods in fault detection accuracy, robustness, and adaptability (Bukhari et al.; Drir et al.; Liu et al.). However, challenges related to data availability, computational constraints, and model interpretability persist. The study concludes that CNNs represent a powerful and scalable solution for real-time fault detection in renewable energy systems, provided that future research addresses explainability and edge-deployment limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了卷积神经网络在可再生能源发电系统实时故障检测中的应用，分析了CNN架构、数据模态和部署策略，发现CNN方法在准确性、鲁棒性和适应性方面优于传统方法，但面临数据可用性、计算约束和模型可解释性等挑战。
AI.research_question: 卷积神经网络如何应用于可再生能源发电系统的实时故障检测？CNN架构、数据模态和部署策略如何影响故障检测的准确性和实时性？
AI.motivation: 全球向可再生能源的快速转型加剧了对可靠、智能、实时故障检测机制的需求，以确保系统稳定性和运行效率。传统故障检测方法基于规则逻辑和信号处理技术，难以应对现代能源系统产生的非线性、噪声和高维数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）在模式识别和特征提取方面的优势。CNN能够自动学习数据中的层次特征，处理高维时空数据，适用于可再生能源系统的复杂故障模式检测。
AI.method: 综合分析方法，通过合成多个可再生能源领域（风电场、太阳能光伏、微电网）的实证研究，分析CNN架构、数据模态（时间序列、图像、多传感器数据）和部署策略（云端、边缘计算）。
AI.findings: CNN方法在故障检测准确性、鲁棒性和适应性方面一致优于传统方法和浅层机器学习方法。CNN能够有效处理非线性、噪声和高维数据，实现实时故障诊断。但面临数据可用性、计算资源限制和模型可解释性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统化地建立了CNN在可再生能源故障检测领域的理论框架；2）识别了CNN架构设计的关键要素对故障检测性能的影响；3）提出了CNN在复杂能源系统中处理不确定性的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为可再生能源系统运营商提供了基于CNN的实时故障检测解决方案；2）指导工程师选择合适的CNN架构和部署策略；3）指出了未来研究方向：模型可解释性和边缘部署优化。

title: Global Risk-Driven Project Delivery (GRDP): Managing Large-Scale Oil & Gas EPC Projects Across Russia, Central Asia, and North Africa

detail.title: Global Risk-Driven Project Delivery (GRDP): Managing Large-Scale Oil & Gas EPC Projects Across Russia, Central Asia, and North Africa

keywords: and Structural Inefficiency Chapter -Central Asia: Hybrid Governance and Decision Bottlenecks Chapter -North Africa: Security Risk
and Capital Efficiency Chapter -Regional Risk Typology Chapter -Why Traditional Project Management Fails Chapter -The GRDP Model™ Chapter -Capital Protection & Value Recovery Cases

detail.abstract:
Large-scale oil and gas EPC projects executed across Russia, Central Asia, and North Africa are characterized by extreme regulatory volatility, geopolitical risk, sanctions exposure, fragmented governance structures, and chronic execution inefficiencies. Traditional project management frameworks—while formally adopted—often fail to protect capital, control decision-making latency, and prevent systemic waste under these conditions.


This research monograph introduces the Global Risk-Driven Project Delivery (GRDP Model™), an original project governance and execution framework developed through more than twenty years of direct leadership experience in multi-billion-dollar upstream, midstream, downstream, LNG, pipeline, refinery, and gas-chemical projects. The model integrates risk-oriented governance, decision-flow control, lean execution principles, and capital protection mechanisms tailored specifically for high-risk international EPC environments.


Drawing on practical case studies from Russia, Central Asia, and North Africa, the monograph demonstrates how conventional stage-gate, PMBOK-based, and compliance-driven project management approaches frequently amplify execution waste, delay decisions, and expose investors to avoidable capital losses. In contrast, the GRDP Model™ restructures project governance around risk-weighted decision authority, adaptive escalation paths, lean risk buffers, and value-based performance control.


The findings are particularly relevant for U.S. and international companies operating in sanctioned, emerging, or geopolitically complex regions, offering a practical methodology to enhance return on investment, improve capital efficiency, and strengthen execution resilience in large-scale energy and industrial projects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了全球风险驱动项目交付模型（GRDP Model™），专门针对高风险国际EPC项目环境，通过风险导向治理、决策流控制、精益执行原则和资本保护机制，解决传统项目管理框架在极端监管波动、地缘政治风险等复杂环境下的失效问题。

AI.motivation: 传统项目管理框架（如阶段门控、PMBOK等）在俄罗斯、中亚和北非等高风险地区的石油天然气EPC项目中经常失效，无法保护资本、控制决策延迟并防止系统性浪费，导致投资者面临可避免的资本损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球风险驱动项目交付模型（GRDP Model™）整合了风险导向治理、决策流控制、精益执行原则和资本保护机制，围绕风险加权决策权限、适应性升级路径、精益风险缓冲和基于价值的绩效控制重构项目治理。
AI.method: 基于20多年在数十亿美元级上游、中游、下游、LNG、管道、炼油和天然气化工项目的直接领导经验开发，并通过俄罗斯、中亚和北非洲的实际案例研究进行验证。
AI.findings: 传统阶段门控、PMBOK和合规驱动的项目管理方法经常放大执行浪费、延迟决策并使投资者面临可避免的资本损失；而GRDP模型能够通过风险驱动的治理结构增强投资回报、提高资本效率并加强执行韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专门针对高风险国际EPC环境的原创项目治理和执行框架，将风险导向治理与精益执行原则相结合，为复杂地缘政治环境下的项目管理理论提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在受制裁、新兴或地缘政治复杂地区运营的美国和国际公司提供了实用方法，能够增强大型能源和工业项目的投资回报、提高资本效率并加强执行韧性。

detail.abstract:
The global paradigm of national development is currently undergoing a structural transformation, shifting from the  traditional, growth-centric models of the twentieth century toward a more nuanced, public-private partnership multidimensional framework defined by Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. At the heart of this transition lies a profound philosophical and geopolitical realization: the "secret" to sustainable national prosperity is not merely the accumulation of capital, but the cultivation of a "Freedom Nation" that recognizes its citizens as the "supreme energy" of the state. In such a nation, governance is not a transactional administrative function but a living and serving  "pious service," a sacred commitment to the well-being and freedom of the community. This model posits that the highest trust is forged when citizens are viewed as intrinsically valued entities whose work is a form of "equaworkshipping"—a synthesis of labor, equity, and spiritual devotion to the common good.

Conversely, the erosion of this trust is increasingly linked to hyper-privatization and the "human monetization" of essential services. When the state treats its citizens as demographic products to be monetized by private interests, the basic trust, value, and service that define a free community are devalued. This report analyzes the empirical evidence and philosophical underpinnings of the high-ESG freedom nation, contrasting its resilience with the systemic failures observed in monetized social structures.

detail.abstract:
The managing director of a specialty foundry must decide whether to approve a major investment to improve the automation of part of her plant's production process. The case presents information sufficient to build cash flow forecasts of production costs incremental to this investment. Discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis reveals that this investment project is attractive but that the benefits hinge on important assumptions about the plant's business volume, the manager's ability to lay off workers over the objections of a labor union, and the hurdle rate. This case provides an update for the case Fonderia del Piemonte S.p.A. (UVA-F-1764).The case is designed as an intermediate case in capital budgeting and for placement in the first-year core finance course at the Darden School of Business. 

Excerpt

Fonderia del Piemonte S.p.A.: The Falcon3 Capital Investment

The sun glistened off the snow-covered heights of Turin's iconic Monviso mountain in northwest Italy as Martina Bellucci navigated her black Alfa Romeo Giulia through the parking deck on a November morning in late 2025. Bellucci was the managing director of Fonderia del Piemonte S.p.A. (Fonderia), and with improvements in artificial intellegence (AI) technology, she was considering ways to further automate the company's production process.

Fonderia specialized in the production of precision metal castings for use in automotive, aerospace, and construction equipment. The company had acquired a reputation for quality products, particularly for safety parts (i.e., parts whose failure would result in loss of control for the operator). Its customers were original-equipment manufacturers (OEMs), mainly in Europe, including Airbus S.A.S., Alfa Romeo S.p.A., Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW), Ferrari S.p.A., Fiat Automobiles S.p.A., and Peugeot S.A. The OEMs were becoming increasingly insistent about product quality, and Fonderia's response had reduced the rejection rate of its castings by the OEMs to 70 parts per million.

Bellucci and her team had met the day before with a representative from Gettler-Rand, an American equipment supplier out of Pittsburgh, who had confirmed the details associated with Fonderia's potential purchase of Falcon3, Gettler-Rand's new line of AI-guided molding machines that would automate the preparation of sand molds into which molten iron was poured to obtain iron castings. The new Falcon3 would replace existing equipment and substantially reduce the required operating labor, offer improvements in quality, and generate some additional capacity for expansion. Bellucci had rejected similar molding-machine proposals for economic reasons on three previous occasions, most recently in 2024. This time, given the size of the proposed expenditure of EUR3 million, Bellucci was seeking a careful understanding of the project's projected costs and benefits and, ultimately, a recommendation of whether to proceed with the investment.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于意大利精密铸造公司Fonderia del Piemonte的资本预算案例研究，总经理Martina Bellucci需要决定是否投资300万欧元购买新的AI引导成型机Falcon3，以自动化生产流程并降低成本。
AI.research_question: Fonderia del Piemonte S.p.A.是否应该投资300万欧元购买新的AI引导成型机Falcon3来替代现有设备？
AI.motivation: 公司需要提高自动化水平以应对客户对产品质量的更高要求，同时降低运营成本、提高质量并创造额外产能。总经理之前已三次因经济原因拒绝类似投资，但这次需要仔细评估这个重大投资项目的成本和收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本预算理论，特别是贴现现金流（DCF）分析，用于评估投资项目的财务可行性。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，提供足够的信息来构建与投资相关的增量生产成本现金流预测，并进行DCF分析。
AI.findings: DCF分析显示该项目具有吸引力，但收益取决于几个关键假设：工厂业务量、管理层克服工会反对解雇工人的能力以及最低回报率。
AI.theory_contributions: 该案例展示了资本预算理论在实际商业决策中的应用，特别是DCF分析在评估自动化投资时的使用，同时强调了关键假设对投资决策的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院学生提供了资本预算决策的实际案例，帮助他们理解如何应用DCF分析评估重大投资，并考虑业务量、劳动力关系和回报率等现实因素对投资决策的影响。

title: A Quantitative Theory of Hierarchical Coordination Ceilings
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Quantitative Theory of Hierarchical Coordination Ceilings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding.

detail.abstract: For nearly nine decades, transaction cost economics has explained firm boundaries in qualitative terms: organizations grow until internal coordination costs exceed external market costs. This paper proposes the first quantitative formulation of that constraint. We model the firm as a hierarchical information-processing system subject to semantic degradation, where managers function as regenerative repeaters counteracting noise accumulation. The resulting bridge equation, 1 − κ = (1 − ε)^αd, connects coordination overhead (κ) to hierarchy depth (d), per-level distortion (ε), and organizational coupling (α). Empirical validation across five independent sources—corporate accounting data, developer surveys, knowledge worker time-use studies, and macroeconomic analyses—reveals convergence around κ ≈ 0.40–0.42, consistent with our prediction of a synchronous efficiency limit. A conservation law emerges: viable organizations cluster near εd ≈ 0.50, trading depth for communication fidelity along this constraint. The framework explains why functional hierarchies stall at approximately five levels, why multidivisional structure enables organizational giants, and why remote work triggered widespread coordination crisis. We derive testable predictions about startup scaling traps, merger integration failures, and the coordination implications of artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将交易成本经济学中的企业边界理论定量化，提出了一个层级信息处理模型，揭示了组织协调效率的同步性限制（κ≈0.40-0.42），解释了为什么功能层级通常停滞在5层左右，以及远程工作为何引发协调危机。
AI.research_question: 如何定量地描述交易成本经济学中的企业边界约束？组织内部协调成本与市场交易成本之间的平衡点是否存在可量化的同步效率限制？
AI.motivation: 交易成本经济学近90年来一直用定性术语解释企业边界，缺乏定量框架。需要建立数学模型来精确描述组织内部协调成本与外部市场成本之间的平衡约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学、信息处理理论、层级组织理论、语义退化模型。将企业视为层级信息处理系统，管理者作为再生中继器来抵消噪声积累。
AI.method: 提出桥接方程 1 − κ = (1 − ε)^αd，连接协调开销(κ)、层级深度(d)、每级失真(ε)和组织耦合(α)。通过五个独立来源进行实证验证：公司会计数据、开发者调查、知识工作者时间使用研究、宏观经济分析。
AI.findings: 实证数据显示协调开销收敛于κ≈0.40-0.42，与同步效率限制预测一致。发现守恒定律：可行组织聚集在εd≈0.50附近，在深度和通信保真度之间进行权衡。解释了功能层级停滞在约5层、多部门结构支持组织巨人的原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将交易成本经济学的企业边界理论定量化；提出层级信息处理模型；揭示组织协调效率的同步性限制；发现深度-保真度权衡的守恒定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了为什么远程工作引发广泛协调危机；为初创企业扩展陷阱、并购整合失败提供可测试预测；分析人工智能对协调的影响；为企业组织结构设计提供指导。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Darden Case No. UVA-OB-1446

detail.abstract:
In February 2017, Julie Ann Crommett left her job at Google to take a new role within the Studio Entertainment business segment of The Walt Disney Company (Disney). Crommett was charged with ensuring that content created by Disney's film studios was culturally competent and authentic. Crommett needed to consider the cultural authenticity of not only new creative content (and characters) but also Disney's past box office hits, which often led to live-action remakes. She spent her first 90 days in the position meeting with key stakeholders such as studio heads to understand their perspectives. Crommett believed there was a lack of diversity among directors of theatrical-release films across the industry. She also believed that directors with multicultural points of view were crucially needed in the film industry. Crommett thought Disney had an opportunity to fill this gap. In the summer of 2017, new to Disney and the studio film industry, and attempting to rattle long-held mindsets and practices, Crommett needed to plot her next steps carefully.

Excerpt

Julie Ann Crommett at Disney Film Studios

Images are incredibly powerful. We can create the future through what people see.

—Geena Davis, actress

In February 2017, Julie Ann Crommett left her job at Google Inc. (Google) to take a new role within the Studio Entertainment business segment of The Walt Disney Company (Disney). Crommett was charged with ensuring that content created by Disney's film studios was culturally competent and authentic. How characters, for example, were portrayed in films had implications for how they were portrayed in Disney's parks or translated into consumer goods. Crommett needed to consider the cultural authenticity not only of new creative content (and characters) but also of Disney's past box office hits, which often led to live-action remakes. In the summer of 2017, new to Disney and the studio film industry and attempting to rattle long-held mindsets and navigate new terrain, Crommett needed to plot her next steps carefully.

The Film Industry

The film industry produced, marketed, and distributed films. Films were either feature length or short. Films were financed and produced at one of the major “Hollywood” studios (i.e., Disney, Paramount Pictures Corporation, Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc., Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation, Universal Pictures, and Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc.) or at independent (indie) studios. Major studio films tended to cost more to make (up to hundreds of millions of dollars), had broader distribution, and had well-known actors and directors. Indie films were made outside of the “studio system,” had much lower budgets, could have distribution challenges, and often featured newcomers in front of and behind the camera. Raising money to produce an indie film could be particularly challenging. Film production could involve collaboration between one or multiple studios, which led to varying project costs and revenues. Distribution of films in 2017 was primarily through theatrical release (i.e., showing films in movie theaters). With the emergence of streaming services (e.g., Netflix), a shift from DVD sales as a key profit maker for the studios was underway.

AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于真实商业情境分析，通过描述性分析探讨个人在组织变革中的角色和挑战

title: Tariff Trouble: Navigating a Trade War in the Global Supply Chain
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Tariff Trouble: Navigating a Trade War in the Global Supply Chain

publicationDetails.detailsText: Darden Case No. UVA-GEM-0255
publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
On April 2, 2025 (called “Liberation Day” by US President Donald Trump), the United States announced extensive tariffs on its trading partners. This presented the executives at Caterpillar Inc. with some difficult decisions, as their firm operated around the globe and sourced parts from many countries. Company leaders needed to determine the best location for a new plant while they navigated an unfamiliar international trade environment. Through the perspective of both microeconomic and macroeconomic theory, this case provides the context to analyze tariff policy and firm-level outcomes. The case bridges partial equilibrium (micro-level) international trade concepts with general equilibrium (macro-level) logic. In particular, it enables students to understand the impacts of tariffs on individual markets and countries as well as the effects of tariffs on exchange rates, policy uncertainty, and inflation. Ultimately, students will utilize economic theory to evaluate the current international trade atmosphere and its influence on corporate decisions. At the University of Virginia Darden School of Business, this case is the first piece of a two-class series that covers tariffs and the US dollar. For the companion case, see Felipe Saffie and Bryan Harrison, “Dollars, Debt, and Destiny: Marfrig's Dilemma in a Changing Currency World” (UVA-GEM-0254).

Excerpt

Tariff Trouble: Navigating a Trade War in the Global Supply Chain

In the spring of 2025, the leadership team of Caterpillar Inc. (Caterpillar) faced a crucial decision. The US government had announced extensive new tariffs on products imported from around the world. As the international landscape evolved, CEO Joe Creed and his team wanted to choose the best site for a new production facility. The team needed to consider the potential profitability for each plant location amid the uncertainty surrounding future US tariffs and monetary policies. How would changes in these variables affect the firm's long-term growth prospects? Would a domestic or foreign plant offer the better investment opportunity?

Tariffs and US Policy

Tariffs were taxes levied by a government on imported products. In the United States, Customs and Border Protection (CBP) typically collected the duty on a good at the port of entry. The US importer classified the good based on the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States and stated the value or quantity. Then, CBP examined the applicable paperwork, accepted the tariff payment from the importer, and deposited the money into the US General Fund. In late 18th- and early 19th-century United States, a significant portion of government revenue came from tariffs, but by 2024, less than 2% of taxes collected came from customs duties.

AI.tldr: 这是一个关于卡特彼勒公司在2025年美国宣布广泛关税后面临新工厂选址决策的教学案例，结合微观和宏观经济理论分析关税政策对企业决策的影响。
AI.research_question: 在2025年美国实施广泛关税的贸易环境下，卡特彼勒公司应如何选择新工厂的最佳位置？关税政策如何影响企业的长期增长前景和投资决策？
AI.motivation: 2025年美国宣布"解放日"关税政策，为全球运营的卡特彼勒公司带来了复杂的贸易环境挑战。公司需要在新关税政策下做出关键的战略决策，特别是新工厂的选址问题，这涉及到关税、汇率、政策不确定性和通货膨胀等多重因素的考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合微观经济学的局部均衡分析（企业层面）和宏观经济学的总体均衡逻辑，涵盖国际贸易理论、关税影响分析、汇率理论、政策不确定性理论等。
AI.method: 教学案例分析方法，通过卡特彼勒公司的具体决策情境，让学生应用经济理论分析实际问题。案例是弗吉尼亚大学达顿商学院两节课系列的第一部分。
AI.findings: 案例本身不提供具体结论，而是引导学生分析关税对个体市场和国家的影响，以及关税对汇率、政策不确定性和通货膨胀的效应，最终评估当前国际贸易环境对企业决策的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际贸易的微观层面概念（局部均衡）与宏观层面逻辑（总体均衡）相结合，提供了一个综合性的分析框架，帮助学生理解关税政策的多层次影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者在复杂贸易环境下做出战略决策提供分析工具和思考框架，特别是关于工厂选址、供应链管理和长期增长战略的决策支持。

title: How should Macroeconomists think about AI and the Labor Market?
affiliations: University of Trento - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: How should Macroeconomists think about AI and the Labor Market?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, dissemination or publication of this paper.

detail.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) moves rapidly from promise to practice, its early labor-market effects pose a puzzle for economists. Standard frameworks of skill-biased and routine-biased technological change predict that new technologies either complement highly skilled workers or displace routine labor. Yet emerging evidence paints a more complex picture. Recent results from Brynjolfsson et al. (2025a) show that the initial impact of widespread AI adoption is characterized by a pronounced contraction in employment-rather than wages-concentrated among highly educated, entry-level workers in prediction-intensive occupations, with little discernible effect on aggregate employment. We argue that these patterns cannot be fully understood within existing paradigms and call for a new conceptual synthesis. By integrating task-based macroeconomic models of automation with a microeconomic view of AI as a technology that substitutes for implementation skills while complementing human judgment, we delineate the backbone of a unified framework to analyze how AI is likely to reshape job design, reallocate comparative advantage across tasks, and alter the distributional consequences of technological change. This perspective serves to structure a formal research agenda on the evolving interaction between AI and labor markets and its implications for productivity, employment, and inequality.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI早期劳动力市场影响呈现复杂图景：就业收缩集中在高学历、入门级、预测密集型岗位，而非工资调整，现有技术变革理论无法完全解释，需要新框架整合任务自动化宏观模型与AI替代执行技能、补充人类判断的微观视角。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何重塑劳动力市场？其早期就业效应为何集中在高学历入门级工作者，而非遵循传统技能偏向或常规偏向技术变革模式？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI从承诺走向实践，其早期劳动力市场效应与传统经济学预测相悖：标准技能偏向和常规偏向技术变革框架预测新技术要么补充高技能工人，要么替代常规劳动，但新兴证据显示更复杂图景，需要新理论框架解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 技能偏向技术变革理论；2. 常规偏向技术变革理论；3. 任务自动化宏观模型；4. AI作为替代执行技能、补充人类判断的微观视角；5. 比较优势重新分配框架。
AI.method: 整合任务自动化宏观模型与AI替代执行技能、补充人类判断的微观视角，构建统一分析框架，用于分析AI如何重塑工作设计、重新分配任务比较优势，并改变技术变革的分配后果。
AI.findings: Brynjolfsson等（2025a）研究显示：AI广泛采用的初始影响表现为就业显著收缩而非工资调整，集中在高学历、入门级、预测密集型职业工作者，对总体就业影响有限，这一模式无法用现有理论范式完全解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出整合宏观任务自动化模型与微观AI特性的新理论框架；2. 挑战传统技能偏向和常规偏向技术变革理论；3. 为AI与劳动力市场互动研究提供结构化分析框架；4. 阐明AI如何重新分配任务比较优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI劳动力市场影响的新视角；2. 帮助企业理解AI对工作设计和技能需求的影响；3. 指导教育体系适应AI时代技能需求变化；4. 为劳动力市场政策设计提供理论基础。

title: Dollars, Debt, and Destiny: Marfrig's Dilemma in a Changing Currency World
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Dollars, Debt, and Destiny: Marfrig's Dilemma in a Changing Currency World

publicationDetails.detailsText: Darden Case No. UVA-GEM-0254
publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
Marfrig Global Foods (Marfrig) CFO Tang David must decide whether to anchor new short-term and long-term contracts in US dollars. For decades, the dollar had functioned as the global safe asset, but David wondered whether headwinds on the US policy front threatened the dollar's dominance. The case offers historical context about the dollar's rise to prominence and examines the dollar's current status in relation to US tariff policy, US fiscal stability, and firm-level outcomes.This case works well as the second piece in a two-class series that covers tariffs and the US dollar; the first case is "Tariff Trouble: Navigating a Trade War in the Global Supply Chain" (UVA-GEM-0255). With the 2025 US tariffs as a backdrop, the case covers the evolving role of the US dollar as an international safe asset. Students will not only understand why the dollar holds a preeminent role in international trade and finance, but they will learn how certain shocks can imperil the dollar's position and influence global business transactions.

Excerpt

Dollars, Debt, and Destiny:Marfrig's Dilemma in a Changing Currency World

As US trade policy disrupted the world monetary system in 2025, Marfrig Global Foods (Marfrig) CFO Tang David began to rethink the Brazilian company's financial strategy. Executives were finalizing a $500 million bond issuance with a 30-year maturity and pricing a three-year international export contract, deals that the firm often completed in US dollars. Marfrig conducted business across many countries, but it regularly chose to make transactions in dollars because the US currency typically provided stability and security. The US dollar had served as the preeminent currency for global transactions for decades, but David wondered about the future of its long-held status. The value of the dollar had begun declining early that year, and the fall continued in April when the United States announced the imposition of extensive tariffs, creating uncertainty in the international sector. Aside from tariff policy, David pondered other factors that could affect the dollar's worldwide position, including the United States' growing government debt. Would the lack of clarity regarding US trade policy or the direction of US fiscal policy cause people to lose confidence in US institutions and therefore the US dollar? The weakening of the dollar might simply represent a temporary aberration, but it could also signal a more permanent shift in the global order. Was it still safe for Marfrig to anchor in US dollars?

International Monetary Systems and the Rise of the Dollar

Over time, various currencies had dominated international trade and finance. When the Republic of Florence (in what became Italy) developed into a commercial and banking hub in the 13th century, the Florentine florin (initially a gold coin and later a silver coin) became one of the first currencies to reign supreme, arising as the primary medium for large purchases across Europe and different parts of the Mediterranean region. Other currencies eventually overtook the florin as the preferred means for cross-border transactions, with the British pound gaining wide acceptance by the 19th century, when Great Britain acted as a global financial leader. The pound lost its worldwide standing after World War I (1914–18) and World War II (1939–45) ravaged Europe, while the relative strength of the US economy and US financial markets propelled the US dollar to dominant-currency status. (See Exhibit 1 for a timeline of dominant currencies.)

AI.method: 案例研究方法，结合历史分析（从佛罗伦萨弗罗林到英镑再到美元的货币主导地位演变）和当前政策分析（美国关税政策、财政赤字）

title: Understanding Gendered Perspectives of Experiential Marketing in Generation Z
affiliations: , Institute of Innovation in Technology and Management, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University - Institute of Information Technology & Management, Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies-Technical Campus, Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies and Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies

detail.title: Understanding Gendered Perspectives of Experiential Marketing in Generation Z

publicationDetails.detailsText: Arora, M; Kumar, A; Tiruwa, A; Srivastava, R; Sharma, P & Verma, S (2026). Understanding Gendered Perspectives of Experiential Marketing in Generation Z. International Insurance Law Review, 34 (S1), 408- 417

detail.abstract: This study investigates the experiential perception of buying behavior among Generation Z, focusing on gender differences using an independent t-test analysis. The primary objective is to understand the gendered perspectives of experiential marketing within Gen Z consumers. The research utilizes primary data collected from 654 respondents, comprising 467 males and 177 females, all belonging to Generation Z.T test is used for checking significance level.The findings reveal that customer satisfaction correlates more strongly with females than males across several experiential marketing dimensions, including smell, act, sense, feel, word-of-mouth (WOM), and willingness to purchase. These results suggest that female consumers in Gen Z may respond more positively to sensory and emotional elements of experiential marketing, which in turn influences their buying decisions more significantly compared to their male counterparts. Despite these insights, the study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which restricts the ability to draw conclusions over time. Therefore, the generalizability of the findings may be enhanced by future longitudinal studies that track experiential perception and buying behavior trends over extended periods. Additionally, the study opens avenues for further research from the marketers' perspective, exploring how experiential marketing strategies can be optimized to cater to the nuanced preferences of different gender groups within Gen Z. Such investigations could provide valuable insights for creating targeted, gender-sensitive marketing campaigns that effectively engage this influential consumer segment.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查Z世代消费者的体验式购买行为感知，重点关注性别差异。研究发现女性在多个体验营销维度（气味、行动、感官、感受、口碑、购买意愿）上比男性表现出更强的顾客满意度相关性，表明女性Z世代消费者对感官和情感营销元素反应更积极。
AI.research_question: Z世代消费者的体验式购买行为感知是否存在性别差异？女性与男性在体验营销各维度上的顾客满意度相关性有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解Z世代消费者在体验营销中的性别差异视角，为企业制定针对不同性别群体的精准营销策略提供依据，以更有效地吸引这一重要消费群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体验营销理论（包括感官、情感、行动等维度），顾客满意度理论，性别差异消费行为理论，Z世代消费特征理论。
AI.method: 采用横断面研究设计，收集654名Z世代受访者（467名男性，177名女性）的一手数据，使用独立样本t检验分析性别差异的显著性水平。
AI.findings: 女性在多个体验营销维度（气味、行动、感官、感受、口碑、购买意愿）上比男性表现出更强的顾客满意度相关性，表明女性Z世代消费者对感官和情感营销元素反应更积极，购买决策受体验营销影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了体验营销理论在Z世代消费者性别差异方面的应用，深化了对性别与体验感知关系的理解，为消费者行为理论提供了性别视角的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供了针对Z世代不同性别群体的体验营销策略建议，帮助企业设计更具性别敏感性的营销活动，优化感官和情感元素以提升女性消费者的满意度和购买意愿。

title: From One Vice to Another: An Empirical Analysis of the Spillover Effects of Ban on Vaping Products
affiliations: and North Carolina State University - Department of Business Management

detail.title: From One Vice to Another: An Empirical Analysis of the Spillover Effects of Ban on Vaping Products

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest and no competing interests that could have influenced the research, including any financial gain.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no funding or research grants for the study, research, or preparation of this manuscript.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper No. 1
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Vaping product use has risen significantly in the United States. Health risks associated with vaping gained widespread attention in 2019 when a severe outbreak of lung injuries was linked to the use of these products. In response, Massachusetts became the first state to declare a public health emergency and enact a statewide ban on the sale of all vaping products. In this study, the authors ask an important public policy question: Does banning one vice product (vaping products) make consumers switch to a more harmful vice product in the same category (traditional cigarettes)? Using NielsenIQ retail-level sales data, the authors examine the causal impact of the ban on vaping products implemented by the state of Massachusetts. Results based on the difference-indifferences model suggest a strong spillover effect, with an increase in traditional cigarette sales following the focal ban. This increase is more pronounced for premium cigarette brands and for quick-stop retail formats. The authors propose and empirically test two different mechanisms that drive the switch: the substitution and the gateway effect. The authors find that the sales of cigarettes that share attributes with the vaping products increased following the ban and persisted after the removal of the ban, which lends evidence of substitution and gateway effects, respectively. The authors conduct a series of robustness checks to rule out alternative explanations and replicate the results from data from another state that implemented a ban on selective vaping products. The findings offer valuable insights for policymakers on the effects of regulation of vice products such as vaping products.

AI.tldr: 研究美国马萨诸塞州禁止电子烟销售的政策是否导致消费者转向购买更有害的传统香烟，发现禁令确实增加了传统香烟销量，特别是高端品牌和便利店渠道，存在替代效应和入门效应两种机制。
AI.research_question: 禁止一种恶习产品（电子烟）是否会导致消费者转向同一类别中更有害的恶习产品（传统香烟）？
AI.motivation: 2019年美国电子烟相关肺损伤爆发后，马萨诸塞州成为第一个宣布公共卫生紧急状态并实施全州电子烟销售禁令的州，需要评估这一政策是否产生意外的负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于替代效应和入门效应理论，分析消费者在一种恶习产品被禁后转向其他类似产品的行为机制。
AI.method: 使用NielsenIQ零售销售数据，采用双重差分模型分析马萨诸塞州电子烟禁令对传统香烟销售的因果影响，并进行一系列稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 电子烟禁令导致传统香烟销量显著增加，特别是高端品牌和便利店渠道；发现替代效应（与电子烟属性相似的香烟销量增加）和入门效应（禁令解除后销量持续增加）两种机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为恶习产品监管的意外后果理论提供实证支持，区分了替代效应和入门效应在消费者行为转变中的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：在监管电子烟等恶习产品时，需要考虑可能导致的消费者转向更有害产品的意外后果，建议采取更全面的监管策略。

title: Ecodent: A Feasibility Study
