The central claim is that regulators move beyond abstract principles and formal status labels to evidence-based, locally grounded criteria to decide, first, when AI-driven management amounts to employer control, and second, who must prevent and remedy the adverse effects produced by algorithmic tools. Methodologically, the project is a comparative analysis of European Union, United States, and Turkish law with a normative argument for evidence-based regulation.

As platforms deploy algorithmic management to control workers while simultaneously claiming to offer autonomy, traditional legal binaries, such as employee versus independent contractor, are proving inadequate. This work compares the regulations of the European Union (EU) and emerging frameworks in the United States (US) to ask: How can regulators globally develop a new framework that moves beyond rhetoric to define, using testable, evidence-based criteria, when an algorithmic nudge becomes manipulative control for workers?

Platforms consistently argue that their workers are independent contractors to avoid employment responsibilities while simultaneously exercising broad control through AI-driven management tools. This use of AI creates significant information asymmetry due to the black box problem and fosters an illusion of decision-making for workers. While platforms argue that reclassification infringes upon worker flexibility, empirical evidence suggests this is a manipulated narrative used to justify independent-contractor classification while algorithmic control leaves workers with little real autonomy.

The core ambiguity lies in determining when algorithmic nudges, such as surge remuneration and rejection penalties, cross the line from rational incentives to manipulative control that creates an "illusory choice." This calls for evidence-influenced regulations and measurable parameters rather than labels alone. A local approach provides the best context for defining when AI manipulates and exploits, as this depends on where the work is performed, for what purpose, and under what conditions.

Therefore, the central challenge is not a simple binary choice between universal reclassification and the status quo. The real problem is revising employment norms to align them with the aim of improving working conditions while benefiting from technology. An evidence-influenced and localized approach is better able to reconcile these tensions than a one-size-fits-all mandate.

Finally, the project addresses algorithmic discrimination, arguing that misclassification bars platform workers from employment-specific protections. It explores practical solutions such as bias audits, using New York City Local Law 144 as a model for potential regulations in the EU and other jurisdictions. Overall, this work argues that AI-mediated management destabilizes the traditional control test by hiding control behind information asymmetry and behavioral design. It proposes a contextual “whose benefit?” control test, using concrete AI-driven practices as triggers for employment status and for bans or partial controls.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI在工作基本条款中的应用对法律的影响，主张超越传统二元分类，建立基于证据、本地化的工人中心框架来监管AI驱动的工作关系。
AI.research_question: 当算法管理工具从理性激励转变为操纵性控制时，监管者如何制定基于证据、可测试的标准来定义这种转变，并建立新的监管框架？
AI.motivation: 传统法律概念和测试是为非AI驱动的雇佣关系设计的，现在被应用于AI驱动的工作，这种工作通过数字界面、信息不对称和行为设计隐藏控制，导致法律框架失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 控制理论：传统雇佣关系中的控制测试在AI环境下失效；2. 信息不对称理论：AI的黑箱问题造成平台与工人之间的信息鸿沟；3. 行为设计理论：算法推动创造"虚幻选择"的假象；4. 证据本位监管理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：比较欧盟、美国和土耳其的法律框架；规范性论证：提出基于证据的监管框架；案例研究：以纽约市地方法144号作为潜在监管模型。
AI.findings: 1. 平台声称提供自主性同时通过算法管理控制工人；2. 传统员工与独立承包商二元分类已不适用；3. AI管理通过信息不对称和行为设计隐藏控制；4. 需要基于证据、本地化的标准而非抽象原则；5. 算法歧视因错误分类而剥夺工人保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"谁的受益？"情境化控制测试；2. 发展基于证据的监管理论；3. 挑战传统雇佣法二元分类范式；4. 建立AI驱动工作关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出具体AI实践作为雇佣地位触发因素；2. 建议采用偏见审计等实际解决方案；3. 为监管者提供可操作的证据本位标准；4. 以纽约市法律为模型提出潜在监管方案；5. 促进工作条件改善同时利用技术优势。

title: From Cheating to Learning: AI Integration in Introductory Economics
affiliations: Lafayette College - Department of Economics, Glendale Community College, Social Sciences University of Ankara and California State University

detail.title: From Cheating to Learning: AI Integration in Introductory Economics
detail.abstract: This paper examines two primary concerns AI poses for educational integrity and instructional design: academic dishonesty and the need for curriculum development. Students' rapid adoption of AI has outpaced institutional capacity to verify the authenticity of submitted work. Furthermore, effectively integrating AI into coursework demands labor-intensive revisions of syllabi and assignments to align with educational goals while promoting the ethical use of AI tools. We provide a general structure that guides instructors in the process of building ChatGPT integrated assignments that focus on economic models. We also develop two easily modified assignments that integrate AI into principles of microeconomics and macroeconomics courses. These assignments encourage students to use ChatGPT to complement their learning process. Specifically, we designed two assignments that cover central topics in introductory economics courses. The assignments serve as cut-and-paste options for other instructors to adopt into their curriculum to meet students where they are at. We close with a preliminary discussion of survey results where students report their use and enjoyment using AI.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨AI对教育诚信和教学设计的双重挑战：学术不端和课程开发需求，并提出将ChatGPT整合到经济学课程中的具体作业设计框架。
AI.research_question: 如何应对AI在教育中带来的学术诚信挑战，并有效设计整合AI工具的经济学课程作业？
AI.motivation: 学生快速采用AI工具的速度超过了机构验证作业真实性的能力，同时需要将AI有效整合到课程中以满足教育目标并促进AI工具的伦理使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育技术整合理论、学术诚信理论、课程设计理论、AI伦理教育框架
AI.method: 开发通用结构指导教师设计ChatGPT整合作业，创建两个可修改的微观经济学和宏观经济学作业，并进行初步的学生使用调查
AI.findings: 提供了具体的作业设计框架和两个可直接使用的经济学作业模板，学生调查显示他们对AI工具的使用和体验情况
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI时代教育诚信与课程设计的整合框架，为AI工具在教育中的伦理应用提供理论指导
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接使用的经济学作业模板，帮助教师快速整合AI到教学中，解决学术诚信验证难题

title: Risks and Stability in the Italian Banking Sector: An Analysis Based on the Bank of Italy's Financial Stability Report
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Risks and Stability in the Italian Banking Sector: An Analysis Based on the Bank of Italy's Financial Stability Report

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: The report analyses the current condition of the Italian banking system, highlighting its overall f inancial soundness despite emerging signs of credit quality deterioration, particularly in the corporate loan segment. Key areas examined include profitability, capital adequacy, liquidity risk, market risk, interest rate risk, exposure to real estate and climate-related risks. The report also provides an overview of TLTRO operations and the ongoing decline in publicly guaranteed loans. On the operational side, increasing risks associated with digitalisation and cyberattacks are noted. Overall, the Italian banking sector demonstrates strong resilience, though it faces a challenging and uncertain macroeconomic environment that could adversely impact profitability and credit quality in the coming years.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了意大利银行体系的现状，指出尽管公司贷款领域出现信贷质量恶化的迹象，但整体财务稳健。报告评估了盈利能力、资本充足率、流动性风险、市场风险、利率风险、房地产和气候相关风险敞口，同时讨论了TLTRO操作和公共担保贷款的下降趋势。数字化和网络攻击风险上升，但意大利银行业整体展现出强大韧性，尽管面临可能影响未来盈利能力和信贷质量的宏观经济挑战。
AI.research_question: 意大利银行体系在当前宏观经济环境下的财务稳健性和风险状况如何？
AI.motivation: 随着宏观经济环境的不确定性增加，特别是公司贷款领域出现信贷质量恶化迹象，有必要全面评估意大利银行体系的健康状况和风险敞口，为政策制定者和市场参与者提供决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理理论框架，包括资本充足率理论、流动性风险管理、信用风险评估、市场风险分析以及新兴风险（如气候风险和网络安全风险）的评估框架。
AI.method: 采用描述性分析和风险评估方法，通过对意大利银行体系关键指标的全面审查，包括盈利能力指标、资本充足率指标、流动性指标、风险敞口分析等，结合宏观经济环境评估。
AI.findings: 意大利银行体系整体财务稳健，但公司贷款领域出现信贷质量恶化迹象；盈利能力、资本充足率和流动性状况良好；面临房地产、气候相关、数字化和网络攻击等新兴风险；TLTRO操作仍在进行，公共担保贷款持续下降；尽管展现强大韧性，但宏观经济不确定性可能对未来盈利能力和信贷质量产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了银行风险管理的理论框架，将新兴风险（如气候风险和网络安全风险）纳入传统银行风险评估体系，为在数字化和气候变化背景下评估银行体系韧性提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了意大利银行体系健康状况的全面评估，识别了关键风险领域；为银行管理者提供了风险管理和战略规划参考；为投资者和市场参与者提供了决策依据；为政策制定者提供了应对宏观经济挑战的政策建议。

title: A Tutorial on Rigorous Scientific Inference: Bayesian Model Selection, the Zero-Patch Standard, and the Deductive Primacy of Axioms Illustrated by the Voynich Manuscript
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Tutorial on Rigorous Scientific Inference: Bayesian Model Selection, the Zero-Patch Standard, and the Deductive Primacy of Axioms Illustrated by the Voynich Manuscript
detail.abstract: This tutorial presents a first-principles framework for rigorous scientific inference, grounded in a minimal set of explicit, falsifiable methodological principles. These principles enforce transparency of priors and the strict avoidance of post-hoc modification. We argue that the century-long stagnation in Voynich Manuscript (VMS) research is not a failure of scholar effort or data acquisition, but a systemic artifact of model selection. Specifically, the field has been constrained by the Patching Fallacy: the introduction of unconstrained auxiliary parameters to salvage a hypothesis already contradicted by evidence. By adopting a strict Zero-Patch Standard rooted in information theory [2] and Bayesian probability [5], we demonstrate how to deduce a prior directly from the topological invariants of the data. When applied to the VMS, this principled discipline rejects linguistic and cryptographic models as probabilistically disfavored. Instead, it identifies the textgenerating process as a Structured Reference System (e.g., a Relational Database or Inventory). This assignment is not offered as a settled historical claim but as the informationtheoretically minimal explanation under the Zero-Patch constraint derived from the entropy, morphology, and serialization constraints of the evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于第一性原理的科学推理框架，采用零补丁标准，证明伏尼契手稿不是语言或密码系统，而是结构化参考系统（如数据库或清单）。
AI.research_question: 伏尼契手稿（VMS）的真正性质是什么？如何通过严格的方法论原则解决该领域长期停滞的问题？
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿研究已停滞一个世纪，作者认为这不是学者努力或数据获取的失败，而是模型选择的系统性缺陷，特别是"补丁谬误"问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于第一性原理的科学推理框架、信息理论、贝叶斯概率、零补丁标准、结构化参考系统理论。
AI.method: 采用严格的方法论原则：先验透明、避免事后修改、零补丁标准。从数据的拓扑不变量直接推导先验，应用于伏尼契手稿的熵、形态和序列化约束分析。
AI.findings: 伏尼契手稿不是语言或密码系统（概率上不利），而是结构化参考系统（如关系数据库或清单），这是信息理论上最简解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基于第一性原理的严格科学推理框架，引入零补丁标准解决模型选择问题，为密码学和历史文本分析提供方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伏尼契手稿研究提供新的分析框架，避免补丁谬误，推动该领域突破长期停滞，为类似历史文本分析提供方法论指导。

title: The Impact of Digital Transformation on International Relations and the Legal Infrastructure of Cyber Terrorism: Power Sovereignty Responsibility and Cooperation
affiliations: University of Edinburgh

detail.title: The Impact of Digital Transformation on International Relations and the Legal Infrastructure of Cyber Terrorism: Power Sovereignty Responsibility and Cooperation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical and doctrinal analysis based exclusively on secondary sources (academic literature, legal texts, and open-source materials). Since no human participants or personal data were involved, ethical committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was not funded by any public, commercial, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract: This study examines the structural transformations generated by digital transformation within the discipline of international relations and analyzes cyber terrorism as one of the most complex security threats emerging from this transformation. The primary objective of the study is to assess how digital technologies reshape state power, sovereignty, and international security practices, and to evaluate the adequacy of existing legal frameworks for combating cyber terrorism. Digital transformation is conceptualized not merely as a technological advancement, but as a historical process that fundamentally alters the functioning of the international system. The research first analyzes the impact of digital transformation on major international relations theories, discussing the explanatory capacities of realism, liberalism, and constructivism in the context of digital power, cybersecurity, and norm formation. It then addresses the definitional challenges of cyber terrorism by distinguishing it from cybercrime and cyber warfare. The study also focuses on the enhanced capabilities of non-state actors enabled by digitalization and the resulting implications for global security. The findings demonstrate that digital transformation reconfigures power distribution in international relations through data, infrastructure, and platform sovereignty, and that an effective response to cyber terrorism requires a multi-layered, rights-based, and cooperation-oriented legal approach.

AI.tldr: 数字转型重构国际关系权力结构，网络恐怖主义成为新兴安全威胁，现有法律框架需多层面、权利导向、合作型改革
AI.research_question: 数字转型如何重塑国家权力、主权和国际安全实践？现有法律框架在应对网络恐怖主义方面是否充分？
AI.motivation: 数字转型不仅是技术进步，更是改变国际体系运作的历史进程，网络恐怖主义作为其中最复杂的安全威胁需要系统性分析
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实主义、自由主义、建构主义在数字权力、网络安全和规范形成背景下的解释能力
AI.method: 理论分析框架：分析数字转型对国际关系理论的影响；概念分析：区分网络恐怖主义与网络犯罪、网络战争；能力分析：评估非国家行为体在数字化背景下的能力增强
AI.findings: 数字转型通过数据、基础设施和平台主权重构国际关系权力分配；应对网络恐怖主义需要多层面、权利导向、合作型的法律方法
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字转型概念化为重塑国际体系的历史进程；评估主要国际关系理论在数字时代的解释能力；提出数字权力、数据主权等新分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对网络恐怖主义的法律框架建议；强调多层面、权利保护、国际合作的重要性；为非国家行为体能力增强提供安全影响分析

title: Factor Betas are Path-Dependent Regression Artifacts: Falsifying Fama-French with 6,560 Controlled Experiments
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Factor Betas are Path-Dependent Regression Artifacts: Falsifying Fama-French with 6,560 Controlled Experiments

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18330795

detail.abstract: Fama and French (1996) called momentum "the main embarrassment" of their three-factor model-the one timing anomaly their framework could not explain away. We demonstrate that this embarrassment was not an exception but a warning: the entire factor-based methodology for dismissing timing anomalies is invalid. Using 6,560 controlled experiments where paired portfolios hold identical stocks with identical weights entered on identical dates-differing only in exit timing-we show that factor loadings fail equivalence tests at an 86% rate. The failures are not marginal: loading differences exceed 0.45 in magnitude. Random entry strategies with zero predictive content produce massive loading shifts. A 10-stock single-sector control eliminates diversification explanations and still shows 96% failure. These results prove that factor loadings measure return-path covariances, not holdings-based risk exposure. The standard interpretation-that loadings reveal what risks a portfolio bears-is empirically false when timing varies. Every paper that used Fama-French regressions to conclude "alpha explained by factor exposure" for a timing strategy was applying a tool incapable of making that determination. Momentum survived as an acknowledged anomaly only because the broken dismissal tool happened to fail visibly for that case. The Halloween effect, January effect, and hundreds of other timing signals were dismissed by the same invalid procedure. Thirty years of factor-based anomaly evaluation must be reconsidered (Preregistered: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18304121).

AI.tldr: 本文通过6560个对照实验证明，基于因子的方法无法有效评估择时异常现象，因为因子载荷测量的是收益路径的协方差而非持仓风险暴露，导致过去30年许多择时信号被错误地解释为因子风险暴露
AI.research_question: 因子载荷是否能够准确衡量择时策略的风险暴露？基于Fama-French回归的因子方法是否有效用于评估择时异常现象？
AI.motivation: Fama和French（1996）将动量称为其三因子模型的"主要尴尬"，因为他们的框架无法解释这一择时异常。本文发现这种尴尬并非特例，而是整个基于因子的择时异常评估方法存在根本缺陷的警示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子定价理论、资产定价模型、风险暴露测量理论、择时策略评估方法
AI.method: 采用6560个对照实验，构建配对投资组合，这些组合持有完全相同的股票、相同的权重、相同的进入日期，仅在退出时机上存在差异。使用等价性检验评估因子载荷的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 因子载荷在86%的情况下未能通过等价性检验；2. 载荷差异幅度超过0.45；3. 零预测能力的随机进入策略产生巨大的载荷偏移；4. 10只股票的单行业控制实验仍显示96%的失败率；5. 因子载荷测量的是收益路径的协方差，而非基于持仓的风险暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明因子载荷无法准确衡量择时策略的风险暴露；2. 揭示标准解释（载荷反映投资组合承担的风险）在择时变化时经验上是错误的；3. 挑战过去30年基于因子的异常评估方法；4. 为重新评估动量、万圣节效应、一月效应等择时信号提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示研究者不应使用Fama-French回归来评估择时策略的alpha是否由因子风险暴露解释；2. 要求重新评估数百个被错误解释的择时信号；3. 为投资实践提供更准确的择时策略评估方法；4. 促进资产定价研究方法的改进。

title: Fear, Identity, and Instrumentalised Narratives in Contemporary Geopolitical Discourse: From Clausewitz to Cognitive Governance

detail.title: Fear, Identity, and Instrumentalised Narratives in Contemporary Geopolitical Discourse: From Clausewitz to Cognitive Governance
detail.abstract: This paper situates contemporary geopolitical discourse within the political economy of uncertainty. It argues that fear, identity mobilisation, and narrative simplification are not incidental distortions of rational policy-making, but instrumental resources through which institutions legitimate authority, mobilise resources, and coordinate behaviour under conditions of perceived systemic transition. Drawing on political psychology, international relations theory, and strategic studies, the analysis proceeds in three steps. First, it identifies recurrent cognitive and social traits that become salient under uncertainty, including worst-case reasoning, in-group consolidation, narrative dominance, and ambiguity reduction. Second, it shows how these traits are systematically amplified to achieve specific institutional objectives, such as emergency legitimation, deterrence signalling, and the normalisation of structural change. A contemporary illustration drawn from transatlantic tensions over Greenland highlights how cross-domain linkage between security and economic instruments accelerates these dynamics within alliance systems. Finally, the paper advances a theoretical synthesis spanning classical and contemporary war theory. It argues that while the political nature of war identified by Clausewitz endures, its dominant mode of operation has increasingly shifted toward what is termed cognitive governance: the management of fear, expectations, and legitimacy at the population level. The concluding section outlines policy-relevant conditions under which institutions may preserve strategic realism while reintroducing reversibility into fear-based governance, thereby reducing the long-run risks of institutional erosion and permanent emergency politics.

AI.tldr: 本文将当代地缘政治话语置于不确定性的政治经济学框架中，认为恐惧、身份动员和叙事简化并非理性决策的偶然扭曲，而是在感知系统转型条件下，制度用来合法化权威、动员资源和协调行为的工具性资源。
AI.research_question: 在不确定性条件下，恐惧、身份动员和叙事简化如何成为制度合法化权威、动员资源和协调行为的工具性资源？
AI.motivation: 当代地缘政治话语中普遍存在的恐惧叙事和身份政治现象，需要从政治经济学角度理解其制度功能和战略意义，而非简单视为理性决策的扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治心理学、国际关系理论、战略研究、克劳塞维茨战争理论、认知治理理论
AI.method: 理论分析分三步：1)识别不确定性条件下的认知和社会特征；2)分析这些特征如何被制度性放大以实现特定目标；3)通过格陵兰跨大西洋紧张关系的案例进行当代说明
AI.findings: 1) 不确定性条件下会出现最坏情况推理、内群体巩固、叙事主导和模糊性减少等特征；2) 这些特征被制度性放大用于紧急合法化、威慑信号传递和结构变革正常化；3) 当代战争的主导运作模式已转向"认知治理"——在人口层面管理恐惧、期望和合法性
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"认知治理"概念，将克劳塞维茨的战争政治本质与当代治理实践相结合；2) 构建了连接古典战争理论与当代地缘政治实践的理论框架；3) 发展了不确定性政治经济学的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了在保持战略现实主义的同时，重新引入恐惧治理可逆性的条件框架；2) 有助于减少制度侵蚀和永久紧急政治的长远风险；3) 通过格陵兰案例展示了联盟体系中安全与经济工具跨领域联动如何加速这些动态

title: Research in Higher Education Institutions: A Comparative Study of Select Countries

detail.title: Research in Higher Education Institutions: A Comparative Study of Select Countries
detail.abstract: Innovation has a crucial role in driving growth and development across the world. The present study explores the research and development (R&D) architecture of five diverse economies-India, China, the United States, Japan and South Korea-to assess the degree of R&D capacity and regulatory complexity in R&D within the higher education ecosystem of these countries. The study measures the innovation capacity in terms of state funding for tertiary education, higher education expenditure on research and development (HERD) and gross expenditure on research and development (GERD). The study assesses the regulatory complexity in R&D within higher education through parameters such as the researcher's autonomy, feasibility of research collaboration, private sector engagement, etc. The study roots itself in the new growth model which emphasizes innovation and technology adoption as primary factors for long-term economic development. The study uses the capacity-complexity framework to identify India's standing on higher education R&D indicators and to explore the impediments to Indian higher education institutions research output.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用能力-复杂性框架比较印度、中国、美国、日本和韩国五个经济体的高等教育研发体系，评估其研发能力和监管复杂性，特别关注印度在高等教育研发指标上的表现及其研究产出的障碍。
AI.research_question: 印度与其他四个经济体（中国、美国、日本、韩国）相比，在高等教育研发能力和监管复杂性方面处于什么位置？印度高等教育机构研究产出面临哪些障碍？
AI.motivation: 创新对全球增长和发展至关重要，需要理解不同经济体的研发架构差异，特别是印度高等教育研发体系的现状和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新增长模型（强调创新和技术采用作为长期经济发展的主要因素）和能力-复杂性框架。
AI.method: 比较分析五个经济体（印度、中国、美国、日本、韩国）的高等教育研发体系，使用定量指标（国家高等教育资助、高等教育研发支出、总研发支出）和定性参数（研究人员自主性、研究合作可行性、私营部门参与等）评估研发能力和监管复杂性。
AI.findings: 研究将揭示印度在高等教育研发指标上的相对位置，识别印度高等教育机构研究产出的具体障碍，并展示五个经济体在研发能力和监管复杂性方面的差异模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力-复杂性框架应用于跨国高等教育研发比较，扩展了新增长模型在高等教育创新生态系统中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度高等教育研发政策制定提供实证依据，帮助识别改进研发产出的关键领域，为其他经济体提供比较基准和最佳实践参考。

title: The Dual-Cycle Model: Labor, R&D, and Profit in the Intangible Economy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Dual-Cycle Model: Labor, R&D, and Profit in the Intangible Economy
detail.abstract: This report investigates the "Mediation Mechanism" in technology-intensive sectors, where the link between human capital and Operating Profit (EBIT) is mediated by Research and Development (R&D). We argue that the modern tech firm operates on a dual-logic: a Short-Cycle characterized by labor cost absorption and a Long-Cycle characterized by an explosion in innovation-driven value. Using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) and Clustered Bootstrap protocols, we quantify the "Intelligence Rent" that maintains a stable premium over industrial baselines.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了技术密集型行业中人力资本如何通过研发投入影响营业利润的机制，揭示了现代科技企业的双重逻辑：短期成本吸收和长期创新驱动价值创造。
AI.research_question: 在技术密集型行业中，人力资本如何通过研发投入（中介机制）影响企业的营业利润（EBIT）？
AI.motivation: 理解现代科技企业的双重运作逻辑：短期成本吸收周期和长期创新驱动价值创造周期，以及如何量化"智力租金"这一稳定溢价。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 中介机制理论（人力资本→研发→营业利润）
2. 双重逻辑框架：短期周期（劳动成本吸收）和长期周期（创新驱动价值爆炸）
3. 智力租金理论（维持高于行业基准的稳定溢价）
AI.method:
1. 最大似然估计（MLE）
2. 聚类自助法（Clustered Bootstrap）协议
3. 量化分析智力租金的规模和稳定性
AI.findings: 研发在人力资本和营业利润之间起到显著的中介作用；科技企业确实存在双重运作逻辑；智力租金能够维持稳定的溢价水平，高于行业基准。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了技术密集型行业的中介机制理论框架
2. 提出了现代科技企业的双重逻辑模型
3. 发展了智力租金的量化测量方法
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业管理者提供了优化人力资本和研发投入配置的决策依据
2. 帮助投资者识别具有持续智力租金的企业
3. 为政策制定者支持技术创新提供实证依据

title: Bayesian inference in IV regressions
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, European Central Bank (ECB) and Northwestern University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Bayesian inference in IV regressions

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3189
publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: It is well known that standard frequentist inference breaks down in IV regressions with weak instruments. Bayesian inference with diffuse priors suffers from the same problem. We show that the issue arises because flat priors on the first-stage coefficients overstate instrument strength. In contrast, inference improves drastically when an uninformative prior is specified directly on the concentration parameter—the key nuisance parameter capturing instrument relevance. The resulting Bayesian credible intervals are asymptotically equivalent to the frequentist confidence intervals based on conditioning approaches, and remain robust to weak instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在弱工具变量情况下贝叶斯推断的问题，指出传统扩散先验会高估工具变量强度，而直接在浓度参数上指定无信息先验能显著改善推断效果。
AI.research_question: 在弱工具变量情况下，如何构建稳健的贝叶斯推断方法？
AI.motivation: 标准频率推断和扩散先验的贝叶斯推断在弱工具变量情况下都会失效，需要找到更稳健的推断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工具变量回归理论、贝叶斯推断理论、弱工具变量问题、浓度参数理论
AI.method: 理论分析，比较不同先验设定下的贝叶斯推断性能，特别是比较第一阶段系数的扩散先验与浓度参数的无信息先验
AI.findings: 第一阶段系数的扩散先验会高估工具变量强度，导致推断失效；直接在浓度参数上指定无信息先验能显著改善推断效果，得到的贝叶斯可信区间与基于条件方法的频率置信区间渐近等价
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了弱工具变量问题中贝叶斯推断失效的根源，提出了基于浓度参数先验的稳健贝叶斯推断方法，建立了贝叶斯可信区间与频率置信区间的渐近等价性
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了在弱工具变量情况下进行稳健推断的实用方法，避免了传统方法可能导致的错误结论

title: A Structural Model of Capital Buffer Usability
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: A Structural Model of Capital Buffer Usability

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3188
publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Under which conditions do usability constraints for regulatory capital buffers emerge? To answer this question, we build a non-linear structural banking sector model with a minimum capital requirement that banks are not allowed to breach, and a capital buffer requirement (CBR) that banks can breach but if they do so potential stigma applies. We prove that even very low stigma costs induce large buffer usability constraints, i.e. when faced with losses banks will deleverage significantly to avoid that their capital ratio falls below the CBR. Our findings imply that non-releasble regulatory capital buffers are unlikely to fully achieve their macro stabilisation goal to support aggregate loan supply when the banking system faces losses.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明，即使极低的污名成本也会导致资本缓冲使用约束，使银行在面临损失时大幅去杠杆以避免资本比率跌破缓冲要求，从而削弱了不可释放监管资本缓冲的宏观稳定作用。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下会出现监管资本缓冲的使用约束？
AI.motivation: 研究监管资本缓冲在银行面临损失时是否能有效发挥宏观稳定作用，支持总体贷款供给。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非线性结构性银行部门模型，包含最低资本要求（不可违反）和资本缓冲要求（可违反但会产生污名成本）。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并进行数学证明，分析污名成本对银行资本缓冲使用行为的影响。
AI.findings: 即使非常低的污名成本也会导致显著的缓冲使用约束，银行在面临损失时会大幅去杠杆以避免资本比率跌破资本缓冲要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了污名成本在资本缓冲使用决策中的关键作用，证明了缓冲使用约束的存在性和强度。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出不可释放的监管资本缓冲可能无法完全实现其宏观稳定目标，为监管政策设计提供了重要启示。

title: Addressing Commercial Real Estate Lending Risks with Borrower-based Measures
affiliations: , European Central Bank (ECB), , , Banque de France, Bank of Italy, , , Banque de France, Banque de France, , , , , , , , European Central Bank (ECB), ,  and Bank of Portugal

detail.title: Addressing Commercial Real Estate Lending Risks with Borrower-based Measures

publicationDetails.detailsText: ESRB: Occasional Paper Series 2026/29
publicationDetails.journalName: ESRB: Occasional Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper explores ways in which borrower-based measures (BBMs) could be applied to commercial real estate (CRE) lending, focusing on suitable metrics and scope. BBMs have already proven to be effective in mitigating credit risks in residential real estate lending by curbing excessive credit growth, limiting high-risk loans and strengthening lender resilience. However, implementing these measures in CRE lending is more complex due to the diverse and intricate financing structures commonly found in CRE markets. BBMs for CRE lending could be effective in mitigating systemic risk by targeting the following metrics: debt service and interest coverage ratios (DSCR/ICR) and limits on aggregate indebtedness at the firm level; and/or loan-to-value (LTV) ratios at the credit facility level. A key challenge is the threat of regulatory leakage, as CRE borrowers often rely on multiple financing sources. This is why firm-level metrics are recommended, aligning with existing market practices and minimising implementation complexity. By limiting credit access from regulated financial entities to CRE firms exceeding these thresholds, such a framework would also indirectly cover lending by non-regulated lenders. National authorities should have the flexibility to calibrate and activate these measures, tailoring them to the unique characteristics of their CRE markets. This paper also aligns with the ESRB Recommendation to the European Commission ESRB/2022/9 D, which calls for activity-based macroprudential tools to address CRE vulnerabilities and to prevent regulatory arbitrage. The paper outlines the rationale, implementation strategy and forward-looking considerations for CRE BBMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了如何将基于借款人的宏观审慎措施应用于商业房地产贷款，建议采用债务偿还覆盖率/利息覆盖率等企业层面指标，以应对CRE市场的复杂融资结构和监管套利风险。
AI.research_question: 如何将基于借款人的宏观审慎措施有效应用于商业房地产贷款？哪些指标和范围最适合CRE贷款？
AI.motivation: 基于借款人的措施在住宅房地产贷款中已证明能有效缓解信用风险，但CRE贷款市场具有更复杂的融资结构和多样性，需要专门的研究来设计适合的监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎监管理论、系统性风险管理理论、基于借款人的监管措施理论、监管套利理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于现有监管实践和市场特征的分析，提出理论框架和实施策略。
AI.findings: 1. DSCR/ICR等企业层面指标最适合CRE贷款监管；2. 企业层面指标能减少监管套利风险；3. 需要国家监管机构根据市场特点灵活调整；4. 该框架能间接覆盖非监管机构的贷款。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了基于借款人的宏观审慎措施理论到CRE领域，提出了针对复杂融资结构的监管框架，丰富了系统性风险管理理论在商业房地产市场的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了具体的CRE贷款监管指标和实施策略，有助于预防系统性风险，减少监管套利，增强金融体系韧性，符合ESRB对欧盟委员会的监管建议。

title: Reforming EU Electricy Market Design: PPAS, CFDS, and Long-Term Signals for a Renewable-Dominates System
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Reforming EU Electricy Market Design: PPAS, CFDS, and Long-Term Signals for a Renewable-Dominates System

publicationDetails.detailsText: BAFFI Centre Research Paper No. 264
publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bocconi Legal Studies Research Paper N. 264
publicationDetails.journalName: Bocconi University Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The energy crisis of 2022–2023 marked a turning point for European electricity markets. It exposed how tightly power prices remain linked to gas, how market volatility can destabilize investment, and how fragmented national responses can undermine the integrity of the internal energy market. In the wake of that shock, the European Union has placed electricitymarket reform at the center of its Clean Industrial Deal, coupling decarbonization with competitiveness and energy security. The 2024 Electricity Market Design (EMD) reform and forthcoming guidance on Contracts for Difference (CfDs) and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) aim to ensure that long-term investment signals coexist with short-run market efficiency. Yet implementation will determine success: translating legislative intent into market outcomes requires sound economic design and clear institutional coordination. This report was prepared to support that process. It analyzes how PPAs and CfDs can jointly mobilize private and public capital while preserving efficient dispatch and price discovery. Drawing on academic research, EU policy documents, and empirical evidence from different countries, the study provides a structured framework for reform. It links economic theory on incomplete markets and risk allocation to the operational experience of regulators, utilities, and corporate buyers. The analysis proceeds from the recognition that volatility in high renewable systems is not an anomaly but a structural feature, one that must be managed

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了2022-2023年能源危机后欧盟电力市场改革，探讨如何通过差价合约和购电协议平衡长期投资信号与短期市场效率，为欧盟清洁工业计划提供实施框架。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟电力市场改革背景下，差价合约和购电协议如何协同动员公私资本，同时保持高效调度和价格发现机制？
AI.motivation: 2022-2023年能源危机暴露了欧洲电力市场的脆弱性：电价与天然气价格高度挂钩、市场波动破坏投资稳定性、各国分散应对损害内部能源市场完整性，促使欧盟将电力市场改革置于清洁工业计划核心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全市场理论、风险分配理论、高可再生能源系统的结构性波动特征、长期投资信号与短期市场效率的平衡理论。
AI.method: 综合分析方法：结合学术研究、欧盟政策文件、各国实证证据，构建结构化改革框架，将不完全市场和风险分配的经济理论与监管机构、公用事业公司和企业买家的运营经验相联系。
AI.findings: 高可再生能源系统中的波动不是异常现象而是结构性特征，必须通过制度设计进行管理；差价合约和购电协议可以协同工作，但成功实施需要良好的经济设计和清晰的制度协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不完全市场理论和风险分配理论应用于欧盟电力市场改革实践，为高可再生能源系统的波动管理提供理论框架，弥合经济理论与实际操作经验之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟2024年电力市场设计改革和差价合约、购电协议指导方针的实施提供具体框架，支持立法意图向市场结果的转化，帮助监管机构、公用事业公司和企业买家协调行动。

title: Hetero Behaviorus: A Complementary Agent Abstraction for Macroeconomic Analysis

detail.title: Hetero Behaviorus: A Complementary Agent Abstraction for Macroeconomic Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a complementary agent abstraction for macroeconomic analysis. While representative-agent and heterogeneous-agent models introduce heterogeneity primarily through variation in state variables such as wealth or liquidity, they typically retain a common decision-theoretic and expectation-formation structure across agents. The Hetero Behaviorus abstraction instead treats heterogeneity in decision architecture—including expectation formation and information processing—as potentially primitive. A minimal formal representation is provided in which aggregate out comes depend on a distribution over decision mappings rather than solely on a distribution of states. The analysis clarifies conditions under which representative-agent reductions are valid and identifies environments in which aggregation depends on the distribution of behavioral architectures. The contribution is conceptual: by distinguishing heterogeneity in states from heterogeneity in decision rules, the paper refines the scope of representative reasoning in macroeconomic modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于宏观经济分析的互补性智能体抽象——Hetero Behaviorus。与传统模型仅通过财富等状态变量引入异质性不同，该抽象将决策架构（包括预期形成和信息处理）的异质性视为基本特征。分析表明，在某些条件下代表性智能体简化有效，而在另一些环境中加总结果取决于行为架构的分布。
AI.research_question: 在宏观经济建模中，代表性智能体模型何时有效？在什么情况下加总结果取决于行为架构的分布而非仅仅是状态变量的分布？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济模型（代表性智能体和异质性智能体模型）主要通过在财富、流动性等状态变量上引入异质性，但通常保持智能体间共同的决策理论和预期形成结构。这种处理可能忽略了决策架构本身的异质性对宏观经济结果的重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hetero Behaviorus抽象框架，将决策架构异质性（包括预期形成、信息处理等）视为基本特征；代表性智能体理论；异质性智能体建模理论；行为宏观经济学。
AI.method: 概念性分析，提供最小化形式表示，其中总体结果取决于决策映射的分布而不仅仅是状态的分布。通过理论推导明确代表性智能体简化有效的条件。
AI.findings: 1. 明确了代表性智能体简化有效的具体条件；2. 识别了加总结果取决于行为架构分布的环境；3. 通过区分状态异质性和决策规则异质性，细化了代表性推理在宏观经济建模中的适用范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出Hetero Behaviorus新抽象概念，将决策架构异质性纳入宏观经济分析；2. 澄清了代表性智能体模型的有效性边界；3. 为行为宏观经济学提供了更精细的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为宏观经济建模者提供了判断何时使用代表性智能体简化的理论指导；2. 强调了在特定政策分析中考虑行为异质性的重要性；3. 为更准确地预测宏观经济结果提供了方法论基础。

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Optimization for Enterprise Value: Realistic Benchmarks, Adoption Barriers, and Emerging Low-Risk Evaluation Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Optimization for Enterprise Value: Realistic Benchmarks, Adoption Barriers, and Emerging Low-Risk Evaluation Models
detail.abstract: In 2026, quantum computing has matured into a hybrid quantum-classical reality, delivering targeted enterprise value in supply chain optimization, financial portfolio management, and constrained resource allocation. This review analyzes leading platforms-IBM Heron r2 (133 qubits, 99.95% two-qubit fidelity), Google Sycamore surface-code advancements, IonQ Tempo (#AQ 64 benchmarks), D-Wave Advantage2 (QUBO scale)-and cloud ecosystems (Amazon Braket, Azure Quantum, Google Cloud Quantum). Despite progress, NISQ constraints (noise requiring 10⁶+ shots, costs >$10k/hour, legacy integration) limit adoption.Hybrid techniques-multi-layer QAOA with warm-starting, error-mitigated VQE with qubit tapering, annealing + classical heuristicsshow 15-25% efficiency gains in pilots. Barriers (technical overhead, talent scarcity, ROI uncertainty) are assessed alongside emerging low-risk evaluation models that screen viability before investment. Projections to 2030 highlight fault-tolerant transitions, but near-term impact depends on disciplined hybrid proofs-of-concept and transparent benchmarking.This analysis provides operations, finance, and IT leaders with pragmatic guidance for quantum readiness, emphasizing evidence-based adoption in a maturing field.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述分析了2026年量子计算在混合量子-经典架构下的企业应用现状，评估了主要平台性能、云生态系统、技术限制和采用障碍，为商业领导者提供量子准备的实际指导。
AI.research_question: 在混合量子-经典计算时代，量子计算如何为企业创造实际价值？主要技术平台和云生态系统的现状如何？企业面临哪些采用障碍，以及如何制定有效的量子准备策略？
AI.motivation: 量子计算已从理论阶段进入混合量子-经典现实，在供应链优化、金融投资组合管理和资源分配等领域展现出商业价值潜力。然而，NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）设备的限制、高昂成本和集成挑战阻碍了广泛采用。需要为商业决策者提供基于证据的采用指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合量子-经典计算理论、NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）设备约束理论、量子近似优化算法（QAOA）、变分量子本征求解器（VQE）、量子退火理论、量子比特保真度与错误缓解技术。
AI.method: 文献综述与比较分析：评估IBM Heron r2、Google Sycamore、IonQ Tempo、D-Wave Advantage2等主要量子平台的技术规格；分析Amazon Braket、Azure Quantum、Google Cloud Quantum等云生态系统；考察混合技术（多层QAOA、错误缓解VQE、退火+经典启发式）的实证效果；评估技术障碍和采用模型。
AI.findings: 1. 主要量子平台在量子比特数量（133-500+）和保真度（99.95%双量子比特）方面取得进展；2. 混合技术在试点项目中实现15-25%的效率提升；3. NISQ限制（噪声需要10⁶+次测量、成本>$10k/小时、遗留系统集成）阻碍广泛采用；4. 技术复杂性、人才短缺和投资回报不确定性是主要障碍；5. 低风险评估模型有助于筛选可行性项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统化分析了混合量子-经典计算在企业环境中的理论框架；2. 提出了NISQ时代量子技术采用的理论模型；3. 构建了量子准备评估的理论基础；4. 为量子计算从实验到生产的过渡提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为运营、金融和IT领导者提供量子准备的实际指南；2. 识别了低风险评估模型，帮助企业筛选可行项目；3. 提供了混合技术实施的具体建议；4. 强调了基于证据的采用策略；5. 为2030年容错量子计算过渡提供了路线图参考。

title: Time Preferences under Stress
affiliations: , The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney and The University of Sydney - School of Economics

detail.title: Time Preferences under Stress
detail.abstract: We test whether acute psychosocial stress affects time preferences in a laboratory experiment. Using a validated stress induction and an incentive-compatible elicitation of time preferences, we find no effect of acute stress on patience or present bias, despite strong physiological and self-reported stress responses. Our results suggest that acute stress may not meaningfully distort intertemporal decision-making and highlight the need to examine whether chronic or domain-specific stressors have more robust effects.

AI.tldr: 实验室实验测试急性心理社会压力是否影响时间偏好，发现尽管有强烈的生理和自我报告压力反应，但急性压力对耐心或现时偏误没有影响
AI.research_question: 急性心理社会压力是否影响时间偏好？
AI.motivation: 理解压力如何影响跨期决策对行为经济学和公共政策很重要，但现有研究对急性压力对时间偏好的影响存在不一致的结果
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的时间偏好理论，包括耐心（贴现率）和现时偏误（双曲线贴现）
AI.method: 实验室实验，使用经过验证的压力诱导方法和激励相容的时间偏好引出机制
AI.findings: 急性压力对耐心或现时偏误没有显著影响，尽管观察到强烈的生理和自我报告压力反应
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了急性压力会显著扭曲跨期决策的假设，建议需要区分急性压力与慢性或领域特异性压力的不同影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，急性压力可能不会显著影响个体的跨期决策行为，但需要进一步研究慢性压力的影响

title: A Deterministic Framework for Temporal Forensics, Institutional Extraction Detection, and Infrastructure Debt Valuation
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title: A Deterministic Framework for Temporal Forensics, Institutional Extraction Detection, and Infrastructure Debt Valuation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper. The work was conducted independently and reflects the author’s own technical and analytical findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, patients, personal data, or experimental intervention. The research is based exclusively on server-side technical observations, system logs, and infrastructure behavior. As such, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was self-funded and conducted independently by the author without financial support from any public, private, or institutional entity.

keywords: Asymmetric Security Architecture Market Comparator: Bloomberg B-PIPE Enterprise Data Services

detail.abstract: The industrialization of automated data extraction has rendered traditional perimeter-based security models-IP blocking, rate-limiting, and identity attribution-operationally obsolete. Contemporary institutional actors employ distributed proxy infrastructure and low-frequency, highly synchronized request patterns ("ghost traffic") designed to evade volumetric thresholds while extracting proprietary logic, data, and research outputs. This paper introduces the Aries Protocol, a forensic middleware architecture that replaces identity-centric defense with temporal accountability. By enforcing a deterministic server-side temporal quantization interval, Aries converts machine efficiency into a forensic liability. Automated extractors reveal themselves through sustained synchronization behavior that is statistically incompatible with biological interaction. We document a coordinated multi-thread extraction event and present a reproducible framework for (a) detecting non-biological agents, (b) distinguishing incidental automation from willful extraction, and (c) valuing uncompensated infrastructure usage using Bloomberg B-PIPE enterprise data rates as a neutral market comparator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aries协议，一种法证中间件架构，通过时间量化将机器效率转化为法证责任，检测非生物代理并区分偶然自动化与故意数据提取。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测和防御分布式代理基础设施和低频高度同步请求模式（"幽灵流量"）对专有逻辑、数据和研究成果的自动化提取？
AI.motivation: 传统基于边界的网络安全模型（IP封锁、速率限制、身份归属）在自动化数据提取工业化背景下已过时，现代机构使用分布式代理基础设施和低频高度同步请求模式规避检测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间问责制（取代身份中心防御）、机器效率转化为法证责任、生物与非生物交互的统计差异、市场比较定价理论。
AI.method: Aries协议：确定性服务器端时间量化间隔的法证中间件架构，通过统计分析和协调多线程提取事件文档化，使用Bloomberg B-PIPE企业数据费率作为市场比较基准。
AI.findings: 自动化提取器通过持续同步行为暴露自身，这种行为在统计上与生物交互不兼容；能够检测非生物代理，区分偶然自动化与故意提取，并量化未补偿的基础设施使用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出从身份中心防御向时间问责制的范式转变，建立机器效率作为法证责任的理论框架，发展了检测非生物代理的统计方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可复现的检测框架，能够识别自动化数据提取，区分不同类型自动化活动，并基于市场费率计算基础设施使用价值，为机构提供实际防御工具。

title: The Brights in the Fog: How AI-Driven Compliance Amplifies Systemic Intent Shadows (SIS)

detail.title: The Brights in the Fog: How AI-Driven Compliance Amplifies Systemic Intent Shadows (SIS)
detail.abstract: In the contemporary regulatory landscape, the integration of high-velocity Artificial Intelligence (AI) into forensic oversight has inadvertently created an "Intensity Paradox." Building upon the empirical foundations established in the Forensic Intent Trilogy (Rodriguez, 2026), this paper codifies the Systemic Intent Shadow (SIS) Theory. It argues that administrative latency-the temporal gap between a financial action and its systemic recognition-creates a "Fog" in which AI-driven audits produce "Backscatter," misidentifying proactive compliance as fraudulent intent. This research proposes the Sunglasses Protocol as a diagnostic standard, shifting the forensic focus from surveillance intensity to temporal normalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"强度悖论"概念，指出AI驱动的法证监督中，行政延迟导致AI审计产生"反向散射"错误，将主动合规误判为欺诈意图。作者提出"太阳镜协议"作为诊断标准，将法证焦点从监控强度转向时间标准化。
AI.research_question: 在当代监管环境中，高速人工智能整合到法证监督中如何无意中创造了"强度悖论"？行政延迟如何导致AI驱动审计产生"反向散射"，将主动合规误判为欺诈意图？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术快速融入法证监督，监管机构面临新的挑战：AI审计可能因行政延迟而错误识别合规行为。这种"强度悖论"需要理论解释和解决方案，以确保监管有效性同时避免误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《法证意图三部曲》的实证基础，本文编纂了"系统性意图阴影理论"。该理论认为行政延迟（财务行动与系统识别之间的时间差距）创造了"迷雾"，导致AI审计产生"反向散射"现象。
AI.method: 论文采用理论构建方法，基于现有实证研究（法证意图三部曲）发展新的理论框架。通过概念分析和理论推导，提出系统性意图阴影理论和相应的诊断协议。
AI.findings: 研究发现行政延迟导致AI审计系统产生"反向散射"错误，将主动合规行为误判为欺诈意图。这种误判源于时间差距造成的"迷雾"效应，而非实际违规行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 主要理论贡献包括：1）提出"强度悖论"概念；2）编纂"系统性意图阴影理论"；3）识别行政延迟与AI审计误判之间的因果关系；4）为法证监督提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"太阳镜协议"作为诊断标准，帮助监管机构将法证焦点从监控强度转向时间标准化。这有助于减少误判，提高AI审计的准确性，优化监管资源配置。

title: Governance and Audit Trails for Algorithmic Systems in Tax Enforcement: A Framework and Control Matrix Proposal for the Brazilian Tax Administration
affiliations: University of Coimbra Institute for Legal Research

detail.title: Governance and Audit Trails for Algorithmic Systems in Tax Enforcement: A Framework and Control Matrix Proposal for the Brazilian Tax Administration
detail.abstract: The growing adoption of artificial intelligence and algorithmic systems in tax administration has increased the State’s capacity to detect inconsistencies, prioritize risks, and scale enforcement actions. This evolution, however, puts pressure on procedural guarantees, especially regarding reason-giving, contestability, data protection, and bias prevention. This paper proposes a governance and audit-trail framework for algorithmic systems used in tax enforcement, structured across the full model lifecycle: purpose definition, data governance, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, change management, and decommissioning. The study follows a legal-institutional and comparative approach grounded in specialized literature and international policy references on algorithmic governance, minimum explainability standards, and digital transformation. The main contribution is a control matrix specifying roles, checkpoints, minimum evidence, and audit routines, enabling tax efficiency to coexist with procedural safeguards and public accountability. The paper identifies recurring legal-institutional risks, including decisional opacity, discriminatory biases, diffusion of responsibility, and undermining of contestability, and demonstrates how lifecycle-structured controls can mitigate such risks. The paper concludes with an incremental implementation roadmap, emphasizing organizational governance, risk management, standardized documentation, periodic audits, review mechanisms, and internal capacity-building. It concludes that institutionalizing audit trails and governance controls is a prerequisite for the legitimacy and sustainability of algorithmic systems in tax enforcement, reducing litigation risks, indirect discrimination, and loss of trust, without requiring operational transparency incompatible with enforcement functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于税务执法算法系统的全生命周期治理与审计追踪框架，旨在平衡税收效率与程序保障，通过结构化控制矩阵缓解算法决策中的法律风险。
AI.research_question: 如何在税务执法中采用人工智能和算法系统的同时，确保程序保障（如理由说明、可争议性、数据保护和偏见预防）并建立有效的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 人工智能和算法系统在税务管理中的广泛应用增强了国家检测不一致性、优先处理风险和扩大执法行动的能力，但同时对程序保障（如理由说明、可争议性、数据保护和偏见预防）构成压力，需要建立相应的治理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于算法治理、最低可解释性标准和数字化转型的国际政策参考，采用法律制度和比较方法，构建全生命周期治理框架。
AI.method: 采用法律制度和比较方法，基于专业文献和国际政策参考（算法治理、最低可解释性标准、数字化转型），构建全生命周期治理框架。
AI.findings: 识别了算法系统在税务执法中的主要法律风险：决策不透明、歧视性偏见、责任分散和可争议性削弱；提出了包含目的定义、数据治理、开发、验证、部署、监控、变更管理和退役的全生命周期控制框架；开发了包含角色、检查点、最低证据和审计例程的控制矩阵。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统化的算法治理理论框架，将法律保障原则（如可争议性、理由说明）转化为具体的全生命周期控制机制；发展了算法问责的制度理论，强调审计追踪和治理控制对算法系统合法性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的控制矩阵和增量实施路线图，包括组织治理、风险管理、标准化文档、定期审计、审查机制和内部能力建设；为税务机构提供了可操作的工具，在保持执法功能的同时减少诉讼风险、间接歧视和信任丧失。

title: Ensuring Fairness in Collaborative Strategies for Mobile Battery Swapping Stations: A Cooperative Game Theoretic Model *
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad and Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad

detail.title: Ensuring Fairness in Collaborative Strategies for Mobile Battery Swapping Stations: A Cooperative Game Theoretic Model *
detail.abstract: This paper develops a cooperative game-theoretic framework to examine collaborative decision-making among mobile Battery Swapping Stations (BSS) in electric vehicle service networks. The model is designed to improve resource allocation and enhance overall market efficiency under spatial and capacity constraints. We introduce a proximity-based service allocation mechanism that incorporates battery availability and distance-dependent costs, alongside a penalty structure that discourages strategic manipulation through inefficient long-distance service provision. The analysis demonstrates that coordinated operation among BSS significantly reduces operational costs while improving service reliability, thereby mitigating consumer range anxiety commonly associated with electric vehicle usage. Overall, the results highlight the potential of cooperative strategies to simultaneously improve efficiency, fairness, and profitability within the evolving electric vehicle ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个合作博弈论框架来研究电动汽车服务网络中移动电池交换站的协作决策，通过邻近服务分配机制和惩罚结构优化资源配置，显著降低运营成本并提高服务可靠性。
AI.research_question: 在空间和容量约束下，移动电池交换站如何通过合作博弈实现最优资源配置和市场效率提升？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车使用中普遍存在的里程焦虑问题，以及分散的电池交换站运营导致的资源分配低效和成本高昂，需要通过协作决策来改善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合作博弈论框架，结合空间约束、容量限制和距离相关成本，引入邻近服务分配机制和战略操纵惩罚结构。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含电池可用性和距离相关成本的邻近服务分配机制模型，设计了惩罚结构以防止低效的长距离服务提供，通过合作博弈分析协调运营的效果。
AI.findings: BSS之间的协调运营显著降低了运营成本，提高了服务可靠性，有效缓解了消费者的里程焦虑，同时提升了效率、公平性和盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个针对移动电池交换站网络的新型合作博弈理论框架，扩展了空间约束下资源分配的合作博弈理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车服务网络运营商提供了具体的协作决策工具，通过优化资源配置降低运营成本，提高服务可靠性，促进电动汽车生态系统的发展。

title: To Tariff or Not to Tariff? The Supreme Court's Answer and Its Structural Consequences
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law and Texas A&M University School of Law

detail.title: To Tariff or Not to Tariff? The Supreme Court's Answer and Its Structural Consequences
detail.abstract: On February 20, 2026, the Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump dismantled the executive branch's $175 billion tariff regime, holding that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) authorizes the regulation of commerce but not the imposition of taxes. This Article analyzes the decision as a structural enforcement of the fiscal constitution, arguing that the Court effectively applied the Major Questions Doctrine to foreign economic policy. We contend that the executive's use of IEEPA was not merely an emergency trade measure but also a revenue-raising response to the 2024 fracture in the global tax order between the OECD and the United Nations. Finally, we detail the administrative aftershocks of the ruling, specifically the $200 billion liquidation crisis facing the Court of International Trade and the restoration of congressional primacy over the national purse.

AI.tldr: 最高法院在Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump案中推翻了1750亿美元的关税制度，认为《国际紧急经济权力法》授权监管商业但不授权征税。本文分析该判决是对财政宪法的结构性执行，认为法院实际上将"重大问题原则"应用于对外经济政策。
AI.research_question: 最高法院在Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump案中的判决如何体现财政宪法的结构性执行？法院如何将"重大问题原则"应用于对外经济政策领域？
AI.motivation: 2026年2月20日最高法院推翻了1750亿美元关税制度，这一重大判决涉及行政分支使用《国际紧急经济权力法》征税的合宪性问题，反映了2024年OECD与联合国之间全球税收秩序分裂背景下行政权力的扩张。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政宪法理论、重大问题原则、行政法理论、国际紧急经济权力法的法律解释框架、三权分立原则。
AI.method: 法律案例分析、历史分析、制度分析、政策分析，结合2024年全球税收秩序分裂的背景进行跨学科研究。
AI.findings: 1. 最高法院认为IEEPA授权监管商业但不授权征税；2. 法院实际上将"重大问题原则"应用于对外经济政策；3. 行政分支使用IEEPA不仅是紧急贸易措施，也是对全球税收秩序分裂的财政收入应对；4. 判决导致国际贸易法院面临2000亿美元清算危机；5. 恢复了国会对国家财政的优先权。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了"重大问题原则"的适用范围到对外经济政策领域；2. 深化了对财政宪法结构性执行的理解；3. 为行政权力在紧急经济权力下的界限提供了理论框架；4. 丰富了IEEPA法律解释的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 明确了行政分支使用IEEPA征税的违宪性；2. 为国际贸易法院处理2000亿美元清算危机提供法律指引；3. 恢复了国会财政权，加强了制衡机制；4. 为未来类似紧急经济权力使用设定了先例；5. 对全球税收秩序分裂下的政策应对有实践意义。

title: More Sports Participation, More Household Charitable Giving?
affiliations: , Macau University of Science and Technology and Macau University of Science and Technology

detail.title: More Sports Participation, More Household Charitable Giving?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflicts of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: We examine whether and how sports participation affects household charitable giving. Using data from three waves of the China Family Panel Studies (2014, 2016, and 2018), we find that sports participation increases the probability and the amount of household charitable giving, ceteris paribus. On average, each additional weekly sports participation by the household head increases the probability and the amount of household charitable giving by 1.64% and 2.88%, respectively. In particular, there is a noticeably larger promoting effect among high-income and young households. Further, we show that social networks and life satisfaction are two major transmission channels.

AI.tldr: 体育参与通过扩大社交网络和提高生活满意度，显著促进家庭慈善捐赠的概率和金额，尤其对高收入和年轻家庭影响更大。
AI.research_question: 体育参与是否以及如何影响家庭慈善捐赠？
AI.motivation: 理解体育参与的社会影响，特别是其对亲社会行为如慈善捐赠的促进作用，为促进社会公益提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论（社会网络）、主观幸福感理论（生活满意度）、亲社会行为理论
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）2014、2016、2018年三期面板数据，采用计量经济学方法分析体育参与对家庭慈善捐赠的影响
AI.findings:
1. 体育参与显著提高家庭慈善捐赠概率和金额（每周增加一次体育参与，捐赠概率提高1.64%，金额提高2.88%）
2. 对高收入和年轻家庭的促进作用更明显
3. 社会网络和生活满意度是两个主要传导渠道
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了体育参与与慈善捐赠的理论联系
2. 揭示了社会网络和生活满意度作为中介机制的作用
3. 丰富了亲社会行为和社会资本理论的研究
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为慈善组织提供了新的募捐策略（通过体育活动促进捐赠）
2. 为政策制定者提供了促进社会公益的新途径
3. 帮助理解不同家庭群体对体育参与的反应差异

title: Here Comes the Cloud: The Effect of Data Centers on Homeowners in Northern Virginia
affiliations: George Washington University

detail.title: Here Comes the Cloud: The Effect of Data Centers on Homeowners in Northern Virginia
detail.abstract: With the recent AI boom, data centers are rapidly becoming an increasingly necessary part of society. With data centers appearing in greater numbers all around the world, it is important to understand how exactly they are shaping the space around them. There is currently a lack of evidence on how new data center constructions affect the residential communities located next to them. In this paper, I study the effect the announcement of a new data center has on the sale prices of nearby houses. Using Loudoun County, an area in Northern Virginia with over 200 data centers, as my setting, I find that houses within 0.5 miles of an already announced data center sell for roughly 2.8% less than otherwise similar houses located slightly farther away.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在弗吉尼亚州劳登县，距离已宣布新建数据中心0.5英里范围内的房屋售价平均比稍远房屋低约2.8%
AI.research_question: 新建数据中心的宣布对附近房屋销售价格有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着AI热潮和数据中心数量激增，数据中心如何影响周边空间成为重要问题。目前缺乏关于新建数据中心对邻近住宅社区影响的实证证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 房地产经济学中的邻避效应理论，以及基础设施对周边房产价值影响的相关理论框架
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，以弗吉尼亚州劳登县（拥有200多个数据中心）为研究背景，比较距离已宣布数据中心0.5英里内房屋与稍远房屋的销售价格差异
AI.findings: 距离已宣布新建数据中心0.5英里范围内的房屋售价平均比类似但距离稍远的房屋低约2.8%
AI.theory_contributions: 为邻避效应理论提供了新的实证支持，扩展了基础设施对房地产价值影响的研究，特别是在数据中心这一新兴基础设施类型上
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产开发商、投资者和购房者提供决策参考，帮助城市规划者评估数据中心选址的社会成本，为政策制定者提供数据支持

title: Forensic Analysis of RenovaBio: Systemic Failures in Brazil’s Carbon Credit Program and Implications for the EU–Mercosur Agreement

detail.title: Forensic Analysis of RenovaBio: Systemic Failures in Brazil’s Carbon Credit Program and Implications for the EU–Mercosur Agreement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this dossier.

detail.abstract:
This dossier presents a forensic legal and technical analysis of Brazil’s RenovaBio program and its associated carbon credit system (CBIOs), with particular focus on environmental verification, methodological consistency, and compliance with international climate and trade law. Drawing on official UNFCCC Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1) data, Brazilian Securities Commission (CVM) filings, and judicial records from the Ministério Público Federal (MPF), the analysis evaluates whether the emissions accounting framework underpinning CBIO issuance meets minimum standards of measurability, verifiability, and legal certainty.

The findings identify systemic failures in emissions reporting and verification, including an estimated 87.4% uncertainty in gaseous fuel emissions, a 40.8% discrepancy in liquid fuel reporting between sectoral and reference datasets, and the absence of the audit methodology promised for implementation by 2025. As a result, CBIOs are shown to be traded as financial instruments without a demonstrable, audited physical carbon baseline.

From a legal and quantitative perspective, these deficiencies undermine the operational validity of claimed emissions reductions and raise significant questions regarding compliance with the Paris Agreement, the non-regression principle in environmental law, and the principle of legal certainty relied upon in the EU-Mercosur Agreement. The dossier concludes that, in the absence of verifiable emissions baselines, the environmental provisions associated with RenovaBio-linked carbon credits cannot be meaningfully implemented or enforced.

AI.tldr: 巴西RenovaBio项目及其碳信用系统存在系统性排放报告和验证缺陷，导致碳信用交易缺乏可验证的物理碳基线，引发对巴黎协定和欧盟-南方共同市场协定合规性的质疑。
AI.research_question: 巴西RenovaBio项目及其碳信用系统(CBIOs)的排放核算框架是否符合可测量性、可验证性和法律确定性的最低标准？
AI.motivation: 评估RenovaBio项目碳信用系统的环境验证、方法一致性和国际气候与贸易法合规性，识别系统性缺陷对碳市场有效性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于巴黎协定、环境法中的非退化原则、法律确定性原则（欧盟-南方共同市场协定）以及碳信用验证的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用法证法律和技术分析方法，结合UNFCCC两年透明度报告数据、巴西证券委员会文件和联邦检察院司法记录进行定量和定性分析。
AI.findings: 发现系统性排放报告和验证失败：气态燃料排放存在87.4%不确定性，液态燃料报告在部门与参考数据集间有40.8%差异，承诺的审计方法未实施，导致CBIOs作为金融工具交易但缺乏可验证的物理碳基线。
AI.theory_contributions: 为碳信用验证理论提供实证证据，揭示方法不一致性对碳市场完整性的影响，拓展了环境法非退化原则和巴黎协定合规性评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改进RenovaBio系统验证机制的建议，为投资者识别碳信用交易风险，为国际气候协议执行提供监管参考，促进碳市场透明度和可信度提升。

title: Inventing Green: Environmental Shocks and the Long-Term Reorientation of Innovation
affiliations: Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN)

detail.title: Inventing Green: Environmental Shocks and the Long-Term Reorientation of Innovation

declarations.funderStatement: I acknowledge financial support from the Jan Wallander and Tom Hedelius stiftelse, grant number W23–0009.

publicationDetails.detailsText: IFN Working Paper No. 1552
publicationDetails.journalName: Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How are preferences for innovation formed, and what determines the long-run direction of technological change? This paper shows that early-life exposure to environmental accidents can durably reorient inventive effort decades later, even in the absence of targeted policy. I study radioactive fallout from the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear accident across Sweden, exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in local exposure driven by rainfall. Combining municipality-level fallout data with Swedish patent records from 1967 to 2021, I find that more exposed areas experienced a persistent increase in green patenting, with no change in total patenting. The effect emerges only in the early 2000s, and is driven by individuals exposed during childhood: matching inventor-level data with detailed administrative records, I show that individuals exposed to fallout during their formative years are more likely to enter the patent system as green inventors and to begin their inventive careers with green technologies, consistent with a cohort-based entry mechanism. A simple model of directed technical change with formative exposure rationalizes these findings. In addition, the paper shows that green patents originating from more exposed areas do not have a lower number of citations than other patents, suggesting that the results are not driven by low-quality innovations.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，早期暴露于环境事故（如切尔诺贝利核事故）会持久地影响个人创新方向，导致更多绿色专利发明，且这种影响主要发生在童年暴露的人群中。
AI.research_question: 创新偏好是如何形成的？什么决定了技术变革的长期方向？
AI.motivation: 理解创新偏好的形成机制对于预测和引导技术发展方向至关重要，特别是环境冲击如何长期影响技术创新轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定向技术变革理论，结合童年暴露的持久影响机制（cohort-based entry mechanism）。
AI.method: 利用1986年切尔诺贝利核事故在瑞典的放射性沉降物作为自然实验，结合降雨驱动的外生变异。使用1967-2021年瑞典市级沉降数据和专利记录，进行个体层面的匹配分析。
AI.findings: 1. 暴露程度较高的地区绿色专利持续增加，但总专利数量不变；2. 效应仅在2000年代初期显现；3. 童年暴露的个体更可能成为绿色发明家，并以绿色技术开始创新生涯；4. 暴露地区产生的绿色专利质量不低（引用数量不减少）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出童年环境暴露对创新偏好的持久影响机制；2. 扩展了定向技术变革理论，纳入个体层面的形成性经历因素；3. 揭示了创新方向变化的代际传递机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为环境政策设计提供新视角：早期环境经历可能比针对性政策更持久地影响创新方向；2. 为预测绿色技术发展轨迹提供实证依据；3. 对创新人才培养和STEM教育有启示意义。

title: Principles To Be Applied In Administrative Sanctions From The Perspective Of The Protection Of Fundamental Rights
affiliations: Selcuk University

detail.title: Principles To Be Applied In Administrative Sanctions From The Perspective Of The Protection Of Fundamental Rights
detail.abstract: Administrative sanctions imposed by the administration against those who violate the administrative order, which are decided and implemented in accordance with administrative procedures without the intervention of a judicial decision, have been gaining increasing importance day by day. This is due to the transformation of certain acts of a criminal nature into administrative infringements and the regulation of various fields-primarily those related to the economic order-through administrative infringements and sanctions. Administrative sanctions, to which individuals are exposed in every sphere of life, must certainly be applied with due regard to certain rules and principles. Within this framework, the first chapter of this study explains the concepts of sanctions and administrative sanctions, identifies the characteristics of administrative sanctions, and classifies them; the second chapter addresses the rules and principles to be applied in administrative sanctions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了行政制裁的概念、特征、分类以及适用规则和原则，分析了行政制裁在现代社会日益重要的原因及其法律框架。
AI.research_question: 行政制裁的概念、特征、分类是什么？在适用行政制裁时应遵循哪些规则和原则？
AI.motivation: 行政制裁在现代社会中日益重要，因为许多原本具有刑事性质的行为被转化为行政违法行为，且经济秩序等多个领域主要通过行政违法和制裁来规范。行政制裁涉及个人生活的各个方面，必须遵循特定规则和原则来确保其正当适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法理论，特别是行政制裁理论，包括行政制裁的概念界定、特征分析、分类体系，以及行政程序中的规则和原则框架。
AI.method: 概念分析法、分类法和原则分析法。研究采用理论分析方法，首先厘清行政制裁的基本概念和特征，然后进行分类，最后探讨适用的规则和原则。
AI.findings: 1. 明确了行政制裁的概念和特征；2. 对行政制裁进行了系统分类；3. 确定了适用行政制裁时应遵循的具体规则和原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了行政制裁的理论框架；2. 建立了行政制裁的概念体系和分类标准；3. 明确了行政制裁适用的法律原则体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为行政制裁的实践应用提供了理论指导；2. 有助于确保行政制裁的合法性和正当性；3. 为行政相对人权利保护提供了法律依据。

title: Analysis of Economics and the Labor Market: With Implications to Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Analysis of Economics and the Labor Market: With Implications to Artificial Intelligence

declarations.funderStatement: Research was Independent with the use of publicly available data.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence viewed through a lens as a skill-biased technological innovation, with a special attention toward labor markets and productivity growth. Rather than AI being an unprecedented disruption, the analysis of the effects of it in real world situations situates recent developments within established economic frameworks related to automation and task substitution. Publicly available labor market and productivity data suggest AI adoption generates different effects across different occupations, complementing higher-skill labor while simultaneously increasing adjustment pressures with routine tasks. While productivity gains associated with AI may support long term economic growth, short-run labor market disruptions raise concerns regarding wage inequality and workforce adaptation. These dynamics underscore the importance of education, reskilling, and institutional responses in shaping the economic outcomes of artificial intelligence. 1. Introduction-Artificial intelligence has become increasingly common across many parts of the economy, changing how work is done and how firms produce output. AI tools are now used.

AI.tldr: AI作为技能偏向型技术创新，对劳动力市场和生产率增长产生差异化影响：AI与高技能劳动力互补，但替代常规任务，导致短期劳动力市场调整压力，长期可能促进经济增长，但需关注工资不平等和劳动力适应问题。
AI.research_question: AI作为技能偏向型技术创新如何影响劳动力市场和生产率增长？AI在不同职业中的差异化效应是什么？AI带来的生产率收益与劳动力市场调整压力如何平衡？
AI.motivation: AI技术在经济中日益普及，改变了工作方式和生产流程，但其对劳动力市场和生产率的影响尚未得到充分理解。需要将AI置于现有经济框架中分析，而非将其视为前所未有的颠覆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能偏向型技术进步理论、自动化与任务替代理论、劳动力市场分割理论、生产率增长理论、技术扩散与适应框架。
AI.method: 基于公开可得的劳动力市场和生产率数据分析，采用实证研究方法，分析AI采用对不同职业的差异化影响，考察AI与技能互补性及任务替代效应。
AI.findings: 1. AI对不同职业产生差异化影响：与高技能劳动力互补，但替代常规任务；2. AI带来生产率增长潜力，支持长期经济增长；3. 短期劳动力市场调整压力显著，可能导致工资不平等；4. 劳动力适应和技能调整是关键挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI纳入现有技能偏向型技术进步理论框架；2. 扩展自动化与任务替代理论在AI背景下的应用；3. 提供AI对劳动力市场差异化影响的理论解释；4. 连接短期调整压力与长期增长潜力的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI劳动力市场影响的实证依据；2. 强调教育和再培训的重要性；3. 提出应对AI相关工资不平等的政策建议；4. 为企业AI采用和劳动力管理提供指导；5. 为劳动力市场机构应对AI挑战提供框架。

title: Underbetting and Accounting Conservatism
affiliations: and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Accounting, Business Law & Taxation

detail.title: Underbetting and Accounting Conservatism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Information is what the user makes of it and different users will reach different probabilities from the same information. We consider how "naive" users, who overstate the firm's probability of success, inflate the asset price and harm both themselves and market efficiency by pricing "sophisticated" investors out of the market. Surprising results reveal how all investors benefit by "underbetting their beliefs" or betting as if they are more risk averse than they are. Drawing on models of underbetting developed by mathematicians, we explain how investors who accept that their probabilities are error prone react by investing conservatively, as if they discount indications that seem to warrant a larger "bet". While not raised in accounting theory, traditional accounting conservatism can induce underbetting with the same benefits that gamblers find, generally more so because the share price is lower in a more prudent or risk averse market.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了"天真"投资者如何因高估公司成功概率而推高资产价格，从而损害市场效率和自身利益。研究发现，所有投资者都能通过"低于信念下注"（即表现得比实际更风险规避）而受益。传统会计稳健性原则可以诱导这种低于信念下注行为，带来与赌博模型类似的好处。
AI.research_question: 信息如何被不同用户以不同方式解读？天真投资者对资产价格的扭曲效应是什么？投资者如何通过"低于信念下注"策略改善投资结果？会计稳健性原则如何影响投资者的下注行为和市场效率？
AI.motivation: 不同投资者对相同信息会得出不同的成功概率估计，这种认知差异导致市场效率问题。特别是"天真"投资者倾向于高估公司成功概率，推高资产价格，不仅损害自身利益，还将"精明"投资者挤出市场。需要探索能够改善所有投资者福利的投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 行为金融学中的认知偏差理论；2. 信息不对称和市场效率理论；3. 数学家开发的"低于信念下注"模型；4. 会计稳健性原则理论；5. 风险规避和投资决策理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，基于数学家的"低于信念下注"模型构建分析框架。通过分析不同投资者类型（天真vs精明）对信息的解读差异，研究其对资产价格和市场效率的影响。考察会计稳健性原则如何诱导保守投资行为。
AI.findings: 1. 天真投资者高估成功概率会推高资产价格，损害市场效率；2. 所有投资者都能通过"低于信念下注"策略（表现得比实际更风险规避）而受益；3. 投资者意识到自身概率估计存在误差时，会采取保守投资策略；4. 传统会计稳健性原则可以诱导低于信念下注行为，带来类似赌博模型的好处；5. 在更谨慎或风险规避的市场中，股价更低，但市场效率更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将数学家的"低于信念下注"模型引入金融投资领域；2. 解释了会计稳健性原则如何通过诱导保守投资行为改善市场效率；3. 提出了投资者认知偏差与市场效率之间的新理论联系；4. 扩展了行为金融学中关于投资者异质性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了"低于信念下注"的具体投资策略建议；2. 解释了为什么保守投资策略在实践中可能更有效；3. 为会计政策制定者提供了支持会计稳健性原则的新理由；4. 帮助投资者识别和纠正自身的认知偏差；5. 为市场监管者提供了改善市场效率的政策启示。

title: Good Faith as Integrity: Good Faith and the Nature of Voluntary Obligation
affiliations: Notre Dame Law School

detail.title: Good Faith as Integrity: Good Faith and the Nature of Voluntary Obligation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Theoretical Inquiries in Law (forthcoming)

detail.abstract: Good faith is a protean concept: it takes on different shades of meaning, and has been made to do many quite distinctive things, in private, public, and international law. These qualities have made good faith perplexing. Partly in consequence, conventional wisdom on good faith is decidedly anti-theoretical. Some have argued that good faith is indefinable. Others argue that the law knows no concept of good faith: reference to good faith is just a placeholder for its antonym, bad faith. In this essay, I suggest that the conventional wisdom is wrong. One can extract a coherent, generalizable, notion of good faith from the law. On the theory presented here, illustrated in respect of voluntary obligations, good faith consists in personal integrity with respect to juridical speech acts. To evince good faith in this sense is to demonstrate fidelity to the known legal significance (objective legal meaning) of one's speech acts and attendant jural relations. A person who acts in good faith behaves righteously in a specifically legal sense. Bad faith, correlatively, involves lack of integrity: iniquity. Iniquity implies a defect in one's deliberate behavior, and hence goes to character, consistent with the intuition that bad faith is morally culpable. But bad faith in law has distinctively legal upshots: it threatens to undermine the institutional integrity of law. Thus, good faith is properly considered an über-norm of foundational importance to law and to legality.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了关于"善意"的传统反理论观点，提出善意是一个连贯、可概括的法律概念，其核心是个人在司法言语行为中的诚信，表现为对自身言语行为法律意义的忠诚。
AI.research_question: 善意是否是一个连贯、可概括的法律概念？如果是，其本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 善意在私法、公法和国际法中具有多重含义和功能，使其变得令人困惑。传统观点认为善意无法定义或只是"恶意"的反义词，这种反理论立场需要被挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法言语行为理论；诚信与正直理论；法律制度的完整性理论
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构；以自愿义务为例进行阐释；通过对比传统观点建立新理论框架
AI.findings: 善意是一个连贯的法律概念，其核心是个人在司法言语行为中的诚信，表现为对言语行为客观法律意义的忠诚。恶意则涉及缺乏诚信（不公正），具有道德可责性并威胁法律制度的完整性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了善意的传统反理论观点；2) 提出了善意的统一理论框架；3) 将善意定义为司法言语行为中的诚信；4) 确立了善意作为法律基础性超规范的地位
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实践中理解和应用善意概念提供了清晰的理论基础；有助于法官、律师和立法者更一致地处理善意相关问题；为法律制度完整性的维护提供了理论支持

title: Separation of Powers or Division of Labor? Patent Interference Disputes, the Grand Narrative, and the History of the Administrative State, 1790-1940
affiliations: and University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Separation of Powers or Division of Labor? Patent Interference Disputes, the Grand Narrative, and the History of the Administrative State, 1790-1940

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.funderStatement: University of Michigan Law School

detail.abstract: We use the history of the Patent Office to challenge the Grand Narrative of separation of powers that the current Supreme Court is using to invalidate congressional designs for administrative agencies.  Focusing on the adjudication of patent interference disputes—cases in which two or more inventors applied for patents for essentially the same technology—we find that the division of labor between the Patent Office and the courts shifted repeatedly and dramatically over the century and a half preceding the Administrative Procedure Act.  Rather than worries about separation of powers, the main drivers of change were (1) the Patent Office’s efforts to curb inventors’ exploitation of interference procedures to delay the award of patents to rivals and (2) the need to manage the workload that interference appeals imposed on the overburdened Patent Office and courts.  Innovations in Patent Office procedures led to dramatic improvements in the efficiency of its frontline adjudication of interferences, but officials found it much more difficult to prevent losing parties from abusing appeals opportunistically.  At the behest of the Patent Office, Congress repeatedly revised the appeals process for interferences, trying out direct review by ad hoc arbitration panels, individual judges, and variously constituted courts.  It even eliminated direct appeals of interference decisions from 1870 until 1893, while continuing to provide for appeals from rejections of patent applications (where opportunistic delays posed less serious problems).  Although interference parties sometimes raised legal challenges to these review structures, they reached a dead end in the Supreme Court, which throughout the nineteenth century deferred to Congress’s authority to design the system.  Finally, in 1939, after a century of trial and error, the Patent Office convinced Congress to eliminate all internal appeals in interference cases within the Patent Office, to authorize the Patent Office to issue patents based on its frontline adjudications of priority, and to shift review of interference decisions entirely to the courts.  Again, this change did not apply to rejections of patent applications, which were still reviewed internally before they could be appealed to the courts. Both the great variety of appeal structures enacted over the years and the repeated divergence in the treatment of appeals of interferences and rejections support our emphasis on the primary role that pragmatic concerns played in the evolving division of labor between the Patent Office and the courts.  This history reveals flexible adaptation over time rather than conformity to a standard model of separation of powers traceable to the framers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过专利局历史挑战最高法院当前使用的权力分立宏大叙事，发现专利局与法院分工变化主要受实用主义考量驱动，而非权力分立担忧。
AI.research_question: 专利局与法院在专利争议裁决中的分工演变是由什么因素驱动的？权力分立理论是否能够解释这种历史演变？
AI.motivation: 挑战当前最高法院使用的权力分立宏大叙事，该叙事被用来否定国会为行政机构设计的制度安排。通过历史分析揭示实际驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力分立理论（separation of powers），行政法理论，制度变迁理论，实用主义理论
AI.method: 历史分析方法，聚焦专利干扰争议裁决的历史演变（专利干扰指两个或多个发明人对相同技术申请专利的争议）。分析150年历史数据，涵盖《行政程序法》之前的时期。
AI.findings: 1. 专利局与法院分工经历了反复剧烈变化；2. 主要驱动因素是实用考量：专利局遏制发明人滥用程序拖延竞争对手专利授予，以及管理超负荷工作量；3. 专利局程序创新提高了前线裁决效率，但难以防止败诉方滥用上诉；4. 国会多次修改上诉程序，尝试不同审查结构；5. 1870-1893年间甚至取消了干扰决定直接上诉；6. 最高法院在19世纪一直尊重国会设计制度的权威；7. 1939年最终改革将干扰案件审查完全转移给法院。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战权力分立的宏大叙事，显示历史演变主要由实用主义考量驱动；2. 揭示制度设计的灵活适应性而非对标准模式的遵从；3. 为行政法理论提供历史实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为当前行政机构设计提供历史借鉴；2. 揭示实用主义考量在制度设计中的重要性；3. 为国会和法院在行政机构设计方面提供历史视角。

title: Geotime (TG_BASE): A Trade-Secret-Safe Event-Time Transformation that Systematically Improves Normality Diagnostics Across Seven Futures Asset Classes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Geotime (TG_BASE): A Trade-Secret-Safe Event-Time Transformation that Systematically Improves Normality Diagnostics Across Seven Futures Asset Classes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Geotime-Helios, Inc., which holds proprietary rights to the TG_BASE transformation described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available market data and does not involve human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by Geotime-Helios, Inc.

detail.abstract: Financial returns particularly at high frequency are famously non-Gaussian, with heavy tails and persistent volatility dynamics that complicate risk measurement and statistical modeling (Mandelbrot, 1963; Cont, 2001; Engle, 1982; Bollerslev, 1986). This paper studies TG_BASE, an event-time transformation defined by observable properties (its implementation is proprietary): it replaces a fixed ∆t clock with an operational index built from causally detected geometric pivots that are confirmed with a finite delay to prevent repainting. The motivation comes from the broad time-change perspective in stochastic process theory, including the DambisDubinsSchwarz theorem and the operationaltime/subordination literature (Dambis, 1965; Dubins and Schwarz, 1965; Mandelbrot and Taylor, 1967; Clark, 1973; Ané and Geman, 2000). We propose an auditable evaluation protocol with two baselines standard clock-time returns, and clock-time returns sampled at event timestamps and a six-metric gate based on excess kurtosis, 3σ and 5σ tail exceedance rates, the Hill tail index (Hill, 1975), a volatility-dependence diagnostic, and a fair-matched outlier control. Experiments are conducted on 28 continuous instruments spanning FX, equity indices, energy, metals, rates, agriculture, and crypto futures, and on a 196-point symbol × timeframe grid. At the causal (base-sampling) layer, 24 of 28 symbols (85.7%) satisfy the gate, and 18 of 28 (64.3%) remain acceptable under robustness stress tests and adversarial integrity checks. We release derived tables, data manifests, and audit artifacts suffcient to verify reported aggregates, while withholding detector parameterization and event-definition thresholds. Cross-symbol aggregates are computed on a canonical overlap window (the intersection of data availability across symbols). Audit-ready reproducibility artifacts (data manifests, derived tables, and integrity summaries) are available in a public repository referenced in Section 9.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为TG_BASE的事件时间转换方法，用于处理高频金融数据的非高斯特性。通过基于几何枢轴的可观测事件时间替代固定时间间隔，该方法在28种金融工具上验证了其改善收益率分布特性的效果，85.7%的符号通过了六项指标的门槛测试。
AI.research_question: TG_BASE事件时间转换方法是否能有效改善高频金融收益率的分布特性，使其更接近高斯分布？
AI.motivation: 高频金融收益率具有非高斯特性（厚尾、波动率持续性），这给风险测量和统计建模带来挑战。传统固定时间间隔方法无法充分捕捉市场微观结构特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机过程理论中的时间变换视角，包括Dambis-Dubins-Schwarz定理和操作时间/从属理论，将物理时间转换为基于市场事件的操作时间。
AI.method: 提出可审计的评估协议：使用两个基准（标准时钟时间收益率、事件时间戳采样的时钟时间收益率）和六项指标门槛（超额峰度、3σ和5σ尾部超越率、Hill尾部指数、波动率依赖性诊断、公平匹配异常值控制）。在28种金融工具上进行实验。
AI.findings: 在因果（基础采样）层，28个符号中24个（85.7%）满足门槛要求，18个（64.3%）在稳健性压力测试和对抗性完整性检查下仍可接受。方法在多种资产类别中表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将时间变换理论应用于高频金融数据的事件时间构建；2）提出基于几何枢轴的事件检测方法；3）建立可审计的评估框架和六项指标门槛。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供改善高频收益率分布特性的实用方法；2）开源可复现的审计工件（数据清单、衍生表、完整性摘要）；3）为风险管理和统计建模提供更稳健的基础。

title: First-Mover Advantage in Funds Revisited
affiliations: and

detail.title: First-Mover Advantage in Funds Revisited

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series Vol. 2024, No. 6
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We investigate the first-mover advantage that motivates occasional run-like redemptions from mutual funds with liquidity mismatches. The role of such behavior in amplifying financial crises and the necessity for its regulation remain subjects of ongoing debate. This paper examines the presence and impact of first-mover advantage flows using detailed data from a substantial cohort of EU-regulated funds. We confirm that corporate bond funds, unlike equity funds, exhibit a concave flow-to-performance relationship, with the outflow response to poor performance being more pronounced than the inflow response to good performance. During the exogenous shock in March 2020, corporate bond funds with prone-to-run characteristics, despite not holding more illiquid assets, experienced significantly larger increases in net outflows. These patterns align with greater strategic complementarities in corporate bond funds and indicate a fragility concern. Furthermore, after controlling for asset liquidity and several other asset characteristics, as well as time-varying fundamental information, bonds and equities with larger ownership exposure to prone-to-run funds suffered greater price impacts. The findings collectively support the existence of strategic complementarities arising from mutual fund structures and demonstrate how the resulting redemption behaviour can amplify crisis dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧盟共同基金中"先动优势"引发的赎回行为，发现公司债券基金存在流动性与业绩的凹性关系，在2020年3月疫情冲击中，具有易挤兑特征的基金经历了更大的净流出，且这些基金持有的资产价格受到更大冲击，证实了共同基金结构导致的战略互补性会放大危机动态。
AI.research_question: 共同基金中的"先动优势"是否导致战略互补性赎回行为，从而放大金融危机？
AI.motivation: 流动性错配的共同基金中偶尔出现的挤兑式赎回行为在放大金融危机中的作用及其监管必要性存在争议，需要实证证据来理解这种行为的机制和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 先动优势理论、战略互补性理论、流动性错配理论、共同基金赎回行为理论
AI.method: 使用欧盟监管基金的大规模详细数据，分析公司债券基金和股票基金的流动性与业绩关系，利用2020年3月疫情作为外生冲击，检验易挤兑特征基金的表现，并控制资产流动性、资产特征和时变基本面信息。
AI.findings: 1. 公司债券基金（而非股票基金）存在凹性的流动性与业绩关系，即业绩不佳时的流出反应比业绩良好时的流入反应更强烈；2. 2020年3月疫情冲击期间，具有易挤兑特征的公司债券基金尽管未持有更多非流动性资产，却经历了显著更大的净流出增加；3. 控制多种因素后，易挤兑基金持有的债券和股票遭受了更大的价格冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了共同基金结构中存在战略互补性，提供了先动优势导致赎回行为的实证证据，深化了对流动性错配基金脆弱性的理解，为金融稳定理论提供了微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别易挤兑基金提供实证依据，有助于制定更有效的流动性风险管理政策，为投资者评估基金风险提供参考，对预防和缓解金融危机有重要政策意义。

title: Administrative Meets Survey Data: Measuring Household Indebtedness in Ireland
affiliations: and Central Bank of Ireland

detail.title: Administrative Meets Survey Data: Measuring Household Indebtedness in Ireland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 2, 2024
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The 2020 Household Finance and Consumption Survey (HFCS) marked the first time that survey data from Irish households was supplemented with administrative data from the Central Bank’s Central Credit Register (CCR). Using household level data from the panel component of the survey, weighted to the full population in 2018, we develop a simple approach for estimating measurement error and applying it, find at least one third of households hold “revealed debt” worth almost 13 per cent of the value of total debt outstanding in 2020. Revealed debt is debt which was previously not reported in the HFCS but has come to light with the inclusion of the CCR. In doing so, we show that incorporating the CCR into the HFCS has helped to correct for under-reporting and improved the overall quality of liabilities data in the survey. Controlling for demographic and income characteristics, we find that households with more complex balance sheets are more likely to hold revealed debt. The results suggest that incorporating administrative data into surveys can help alleviate issues surrounding recall bias and other human errors that may generate initial misreporting.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用爱尔兰家庭财务与消费调查（HFCS）与中央信贷登记系统（CCR）的行政数据，开发了一种测量误差估计方法，发现至少三分之一的家庭持有"揭示债务"，占2020年总债务的13%，表明行政数据能有效改善调查数据质量。
AI.research_question: 如何利用行政数据（中央信贷登记系统）来识别和纠正家庭财务调查中的债务报告误差？行政数据的整合对改善家庭债务数据质量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统家庭财务调查存在回忆偏差和人为错误导致的债务报告不准确问题，需要探索行政数据整合来改善数据质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量误差理论、调查数据质量评估框架、行政数据与调查数据整合理论
AI.method: 使用2020年HFCS调查数据与CCR行政数据的面板数据，开发简单的测量误差估计方法，采用人口加权（基于2018年全人口），进行回归分析控制人口和收入特征。
AI.findings: 1. 至少三分之一家庭持有"揭示债务"（之前未报告但通过CCR发现的债务）；2. 揭示债务占2020年总债务的13%；3. CCR整合有效纠正了债务低估问题；4. 资产负债表更复杂的家庭更可能持有揭示债务。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了行政数据与调查数据整合的测量误差估计方法；2. 为理解家庭债务报告偏差提供了实证证据；3. 丰富了调查数据质量评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的家庭债务数据；2. 展示了行政数据改善调查数据质量的实际价值；3. 为其他国家的类似数据整合提供了方法参考；4. 有助于金融机构更准确评估家庭信贷风险。
